  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除技术（CETs）在增强擦除鲁棒性时往往损害非目标概念的模型效用，且因依赖静态概念库而容易受到触发器干扰，导致目标概念重现或邻近良性概念被抑制。

Method: 提出无训练框架PARSE：1. 利用无分类器引导动态发现诱导目标的擦除概念及邻近保留概念；2. 采用感知保护的投影编辑交叉注意力值空间，移除目标方向同时保留保留方向；3. 针对词汇表外触发器，通过文本逆演化迭代搜索并自适应扩展擦除子空间，确保不冲突于保留语义；4. 引入平衡擦除效用得分（BEUS）评估鲁棒性与效用。

Result: 在NSFW、艺术风格和物体擦除任务上的大规模实验表明，PARSE能够以多种攻击下的鲁棒性成功擦除多个概念，同时未牺牲编辑后的模型效用，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: PARSE通过动态感知和自适应扩展机制，有效解决了概念擦除中鲁棒性与效用难以兼得的难题，实现了更可靠的模型编辑。

Abstract: Concept erasure techniques (CETs) edit text-to-image diffusion models to erase undesired targets such as NSFW content or copyrighted styles, while preserving model utility on benign concepts. Current CETs face a trade-off between erasure robustness and utility: stronger edits erase the target more reliably but degrade utility on non-target concepts, and vice versa. This stems from how existing methods define what to erase and what to preserve. Many CETs rely on static concept banks specified manually, generated by LLMs, or selected by CLIP image-text similarity. Such banks do not model how prompts steer the model during denoising, leaving it vulnerable to triggers that reintroduce the target while suppressing nearby benign concepts. We present Preservation-aware Adaptive Ranked Subspace Expansion (PARSE), a training-free framework for robust concept erasure in latent diffusion models. Given a target, PARSE queries the diffusion model with classifier-free guidance to dynamically discover target-inducing erase concepts and nearby retain concepts in the model vocabulary. It then edits the cross-attention value space with a preservation-aware projection that removes target directions while leaving retain directions intact. For triggers beyond this vocabulary-indexed space, PARSE iteratively searches for re-emergence triggers by textual inversion and adaptively expands the erased subspace only when a new trigger direction does not conflict with retain semantics. We also introduce the Balanced Erasure Utility Score (BEUS), which combines robustness (ASR under multiple attacks) and utility preservation (FID) via bounded monotone transforms and harmonic mean aggregation. Experiments on NSFW, artistic style, and object erasure, with a large-scale robustness-utility analysis over many CET baselines, show that PARSE erases multiple concepts robustly without sacrificing post-edit utility.

</details>


### [79] [Token-Region Guided Cross-Attention Fusion for Multimodal Affect Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23493)
*Musa Tur Farazi,Nufayer Jahan Reza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种多模态交叉注意力融合框架，用于检测孟加拉语网络迷因中的政治意图。通过视觉语言模型提取文本，利用交叉模态多头注意力机制融合图文特征，并引入政治词汇作为知识先验，在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上达到了0.94的Macro-F1性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体中多模态内容的自动化分析对于理解公众情绪和信息传播至关重要。然而，由于视觉线索与嵌入文本（尤其是低资源语言如孟加拉语）之间复杂的相互作用，对网络迷因进行分类仍具有计算挑战性。

Method: 1. 使用视觉语言模型从嘈杂的迷因图像中提取高保真OCR文本；2. 编码视觉和文本特征，并通过跨模态多头注意力机制进行合成，以对齐语义令牌与视觉区域；3. 探索将领域特定的政治词典作为知识先验进行整合。

Result: 在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上的实验表明，基于注意力的融合方法显著优于单模态基线和标准拼接方法，实现了约0.94的SOTA Macro-F1分数。可解释性分析证实模型能有效将文本语义锚定在视觉证据上。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的多模态交叉注意力融合框架有效解决了低资源语言下网络迷因政治意图检测难题，提升了分类精度并增强了模型的可解释性。

Abstract: Automated analysis of multimodal content on social networks has become a critical task for understanding public sentiment and information diffusion in the digital age. However, classifying internet memes remains computationally challenging due to the intricate interplay between visual cues and embedded, often stylized, text, particularly in low-resource languages like Bengali Language. This paper addresses the detection of political intent in Bengali memes by introducing Multimodal Cross-Attention Fusion framework. We first leverage a Vision-Language Model to extract high-fidelity OCR text from noisy meme images. Subsequently, we encode visual and textual features and synthesize them through a cross-modal multi-head attention mechanism that aligns semantic tokens with visual regions. We also investigate the integration of a domain-specific political lexicon as a knowledge prior. Experimental evaluation on the PoliMemeDecode1 dataset shows that our attention-based fusion significantly outperforms unimodal baselines and standard concatenation methods, achieving a state-of-the-art Macro-F1 of approximately 0.94. Interpretability analyzes further confirm that the model effectively learns to ground textual semantics in visual evidence.

</details>


### [80] [MemVLN: Episodic and Procedural Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23504)
*Yuqi Liu,Shengju Qian,Tianyuan Qu,Mingxian Lin,Zixuan Wang,Xin Wang,Bei Yu,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MemVLN框架，结合视觉编码器、LLM和两种记忆机制（情景记忆与程序记忆），在连续环境视觉-语言导航任务中实现实时推理效率与SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频的VLN方法难以同时满足长视域轨迹一致性（需维护长期视觉历史）和低延迟动作执行的需求。

Method: 1. 使用视觉编码器处理连续观测，LLM解释指令并生成动作；2. 引入金字塔分辨率的情景记忆管理，聚焦即时感知并压缩长期历史；3. 设计程序记忆，通过紧凑的原子中级动作词汇表绕过自回归解码延迟。

Result: 在VLN-CE基准上，MemVLN-4B相比基线Qwen3-VL-4B在R2R任务上SR提升5.8%，在RxR任务上SR提升9.7%，且推理延迟降低7倍（达到14 FPS）。

Conclusion: MemVLN通过创新的双记忆机制有效平衡了计算效率与导航性能，实现了实时高效的连续环境视觉-语言导航。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to maintain long-horizon visual history for trajectory consistency while executing actions with low latency. Existing video-based VLN approaches typically struggle to satisfy both demands simultaneously. To address these challenges, we propose MemVLN, a novel VLN framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance with real-time inference efficiency (14 FPS). MemVLN utilizes a visual encoder to process continuous observations and a Large Language Model (LLM) to interpret instructions and generate actions. Central to our approach is an Episodic Memory management that applies pyramidal resolutions. This mechanism concentrates computation on immediate percepts while retaining compressed long-term history. Complementing to this design, we introduce Procedural Memory for fast action with a compact vocabulary of atomic mid-level actions to bypass auto-regressive decoding latency. Experiments on VLN-CE show that MemVLN-4B surpasses the baseline Qwen3-VL-4B architecture by 5.8\% SR in R2R and 9.7\% SR in RxR, while achieving a 7$\times$ speedup in inference latency.

</details>


### [81] [MOJITO: Modal Joint Learning for Unified End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23511)
*Zhijing Cheng,Xuancheng Zhang,Donglin Di,Lei Fan,Baorui Ma,Hao Li,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MOJITO框架，通过移除感知-规划级联接口并采用模态联合注意力机制，实现端到端自动驾驶中多模态特征的直接交互，在NAVSIM数据集上刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统采用的级联两阶段流水线（感知压缩后传给规划器）会导致细粒度细节丢失，且限制了现代视觉基础模型丰富表征的利用。

Method: 提出基于模态联合学习的统一传感器到动作框架MOJITO。该方法移除级联接口，执行块状模态联合注意力（Modal Joint Attention），同步更新动作、图像和LiDAR特征，使规划器能在动作生成过程中直接访问多模态特征。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1数据集上PDMS达到88.9，在更具挑战性的NAVSIM v2数据集上EPDMS达到88.4，创下了新的最先进水平（SOTA）。实验还展示了其强大的可扩展性、指令遵循能力和多样化的轨迹生成能力。

Conclusion: MOJITO通过打破感知与规划的单向信息流，有效保留了细粒度多模态信息，显著提升了端到端自动驾驶系统的性能上限。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems commonly follow a cascaded two-stage pipeline where a perception stage compresses multi-modal sensor inputs into a compact context and a downstream planner predicts trajectories conditioned on this context. We argue that this one-way perception-to-planning interface forces sensor inputs into a compact representation, losing the fine-grained details critical for planning. Moreover, by constraining the planner to this compressed context, it is difficult to leverage the rich representations offered by modern vision foundation models. To address these issues, we propose MOJITO, a unified sensor-to-action framework for end-to-end autonomous driving built on modal joint learning. MOJITO removes the cascaded interface and instead performs block-wise Modal Joint Attention that simultaneously updates action, image, and LiDAR features, allowing the planner to directly access multi-modal features during action generation. MOJITO achieves 88.9 PDMS on the NAVSIM v1 dataset and 88.4 EPDMS on the more challenging NAVSIM v2 dataset, setting a new state-of-the-art. Extensive experiments further demonstrate strong scalability, instruction following, and diverse trajectory generation. Code and models are available at https://github.com/mumucc01/MOJITO.

</details>


### [82] [Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23517)
*Chaonan Ji,Jinwei Qi,Peng Zhang,Bang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种实时人体中心的世界模型，用于上半身交互生成。通过连续-离散联合控制方案（连续人体状态+离散交互状态），实现协调的身体、手部及面部运动与可控的人机物体交互，支持25 FPS的实时推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在合成以人为中心的连贯局部世界动态，解决现有方法在协调身体、手部和面部运动方面以及可控人机物体离散交互方面的不足，从单纯的动作重播迈向实时的、以人为中心的世界建模。

Method: 1. 采用连续-离散联合控制架构：包含连续人体状态和离散交互状态两个互补组件。
2. 连续人体状态控制：引入基于多尺度运动编码的统一隐式表示，将上半身、手部和面部的运动潜在变量融合到共享潜在空间，无需显式重定向即可直接控制。
3. 离散交互状态控制：使用少量语言编码的离散交互状态（如“无接触”、“抓握”）表示物体接触，文本作为显式的交互状态指令而非开放式生成提示；构建专用渲染管道监督此类离散交互状态。
4. 模型蒸馏以实现高效的流式实时推理。

Result: 1. 实现了25 FPS的实时推理速度（在两块H100 GPU上）。
2. 实验表明，该方法提高了细粒度运动的保真度。
3. 实现了更真实的手部-物体协调效果。
4. 实现了有效的实时交互，并能控制附近场景状态的改变。

Conclusion: 该模型通过结合连续隐式人体状态控制和离散交互状态控制，精确模拟了人与局部环境的运动及交互方式，为实时以人为中心的世界建模提供了实用的进展。

Abstract: We present a real-time human-centric world model for upper-body interactive generation, aiming to synthesize coherent local world dynamics centered on a person, where coordinated body, hand, and facial motions evolve jointly with controllable human-object discrete interaction. To this end, we adopt a continuous-discrete joint control scheme with two complementary components: a continuous human state and a discrete interaction state. For continuous human-state control, we introduce a unified implicit representation based on multi-scale motion encoding, in which motion latents from the upper body, hands, and face are fused into a shared latent space. This multi-scale design improves expressiveness across different spatial scales, captures fine-grained human dynamics more effectively, and enables direct control without explicit retargeting. For discrete object interaction-state control, we represent object contact using a small set of language-encoded discrete interaction states, where text serves as an explicit interaction-state command, such as \emph{no contact} or \emph{grasp}, rather than an open-ended generation prompt, and we further construct a dedicated rendering pipeline for human-object interaction data to supervise such discrete interaction states. By combining continuous implicit human-state control with discrete interaction-state control, our model enables precise modeling of how a person moves and interacts with the local environment, including controllable changes to nearby scene states. Finally, we distill the model for efficient streaming real-time inference, achieving 25 FPS on two H100 GPUs. Experiments demonstrate improved fine-grained motion fidelity, more realistic hand-object coordination, and effective real-time interaction, establishing a practical step beyond motion reproduction toward real-time human-centric world modeling.

</details>


### [83] [ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23522)
*Le Huu Son Hai,Nguyen Chi Hai,Truong Viet Vu,Nguyen Phuc Nguyen,Nguyen Thai Anh,Ngo Hoang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，通过在ATCNet中集成轻量级通道整合注意力模块（CIAM）来增强运动想象脑电解码性能。该模型在多个数据集和协议下验证，显著提升了跨会话分类的准确性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决基于运动想象的脑机接口中因个体差异和跨会话非平稳性导致的稳健解码难题。

Method: 构建ATCNet-CIAM框架，将轻量级通道整合注意力模块嵌入ATCNet，以改进通道空间特征表示；在BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b及WBCIC-MI数据集上进行标准、会话内及跨会话协议评估，并进行消融实验。

Result: 在BCI IV-2a上准确率达86.32%，BCI IV-2b上达87.96%；在WBCIC-MI会话内测试中，2C和3C类别分别达到89.46%和83.64%。模型在会话变化条件下表现出更高的分类稳定性和鲁棒性，消融实验证实了各组件的贡献。

Conclusion: ATCNet-CIAM通过引入CIAM有效改善了运动想象解码的特征表示，增强了模型在复杂多变条件下的鲁棒性和准确性，为提升脑机接口的实用性提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decoding remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced attention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module (CIAM) into the ATCNet framework to improve channel-spatial feature representation for MI decoding. The proposed model is evaluated on BCI Competition IV-2a, BCI Competition IV-2b, and the multi-day WBCIC-MI dataset under standard, within-session, and cross-session protocols. Experimental results show that ATCNet-CIAM achieves 86.32% accuracy on BCI IV-2a and 87.96% on BCI IV-2b under the standard protocol, while reaching 89.46% and 83.64% in the within-session WBCIC-MI on 2C and 3C, respectively. The proposed framework consistently improves classification stability and robustness under session-varying conditions, and ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of the proposed architectural components.

</details>


### [84] [Geometry Meets Semantics: Fractional Gradient Stabilization for Semantic-Driven Bounding Box Optimization in Visual Detection Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23530)
*Qi Ming,Haitian Yang,Xudong Zhao,Mingjing Zhao,Liuqian Wang,Nanqing Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FrSIoU损失函数，通过引入语义相似度和分数阶微积分解决IoU优化中忽略语义信息和方向梯度不稳定的问题，实现统一的语义-几何学习与梯度稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于IoU的边界框回归优化存在两个关键问题：1) 仅依赖几何属性而忽略语义线索；2) 方向优化中梯度不稳定导致收敛震荡。

Method: 1. 设计语义相似度度量以引导IoU优化，构建带有自适应梯度门控机制的语义IoU损失（SIoU loss）。2. 将SIoU扩展为分数阶形式，构建分数语义IoU损失（FrSIoU loss），通过累积历史IoU状态来正则化优化过程中的异常梯度。

Result: 在不同边界框格式和多样化视觉检测任务中，该方法均实现了稳定的性能提升。

Conclusion: FrSIoU loss有效解决了IoU驱动优化的语义缺失和梯度不稳定问题，提升了视觉检测任务的鲁棒性和准确性。

Abstract: Bounding boxes are fundamental for object localization in visual detection tasks. Among them, oriented bounding boxes are widely used in visual detection tasks, which provide a more precise directional representation. Generally, IoU-based losses are widely adopted to optimize box regression. However, we observed that IoU-driven box optimization suffers from two key issues: (1) it relies solely on geometric properties while ignoring semantic cues; (2) orientation optimization suffers from unstable gradients, causing oscillations in orientation convergence. In this paper, we propose a Fractional Semantic IoU loss to achieve unified semantic-geometric learning with gradient stabilization. First, we design a semantic similarity metric to guide IoU optimization, building a Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss) with an adaptive gradient gating mechanism. Then, we revisit the gradient instability issue in oriented box optimization and extend the SIoU loss to a fractional-order formulation to build the \textbf{Fr}actional \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{IoU} \textbf{loss} (FrSIoU loss). The FrSIoU loss accumulates historical IoU states to regularize abnormal gradients during bounding box optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves stable performance gains across different bounding box formulations and diverse visual detection tasks. The code will be available on GitHub.

</details>


### [85] [GaitFace: A Multimodal Dataset for Long-Range Person Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23542)
*Alain Komaty,Luis S. Luevano,Vidit Vidit,Anjith George,Zeina Al Amine,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GaitFace数据集，包含远距离面部和步态数据，旨在解决边境控制中因低分辨率和高视角导致的生物识别技术瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边境管控面临拥堵和等待时间长的问题，生物识别技术被广泛部署以提高效率。然而，现有技术在远距离监控、恶劣大气条件和图像质量下降的情况下存在局限性，且高质量框架（如BRIAR）通常仅限于特定政府机构使用，缺乏公开的基准测试。

Method: 构建GaitFace公共数据集，采用“预注册”（通过移动设备注册）和“野外捕获”（远距离、多角度、多摄像头拍摄）的方式收集真实边境场景下的面部和步态数据，并对当前最先进的面部和步态模型进行基准测试。

Result: 基准测试显示，尽管在光学辅助下表现良好，但当前的面部和步态架构在低分辨率和高视角条件下性能显著下降。GaitFace揭示了这些关键弱点，为更鲁棒、无约束的生物识别研究提供了严格的公开基准。

Conclusion: GaitFace数据集填补了公开生物识别基准的空白，有助于推动在复杂、非受控环境下更稳健的生物识别技术发展，从而提升边境通行效率。

Abstract: Efficient border control is becoming a significant global challenge, mainly due to severe congestion and extended passenger waiting times. To mitigate these bottlenecks and facilitate passenger flow, biometric technologies are increasingly deployed to streamline identity verification and enhance crossing efficiency. Technical limitations frequently impede biometric identification, particularly in long-range surveillance, where systems must deal with adverse atmospheric conditions and degraded image quality. While high-quality frameworks like BRIAR exist, they are frequently restricted to specific government agencies. This paper introduces GaitFace, a new public dataset that contains face and gait data captured at long distances. To ensure that the research reflects authentic border scenarios, we use Pre-Enrollment data, where a traveler registers via a mobile device, and "In-the-Wild" captures, which records individuals at a distance across multiple viewing angles and different cameras. Benchmarking SOTA face and gait models reveals that current architectures fail under low-resolution and elevated viewpoints despite success with optical assistance. GaitFace exposes these critical vulnerabilities, providing a rigorous public benchmark to drive more robust, unconstrained biometric research.

</details>


### [86] [D3O: Dynamic Distribution Distillation for Ordinal Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23575)
*Chunlai Dong,Yaojun Hu,Yuyang Xu,Haochao Ying,Jian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出D3O框架，通过动态分布蒸馏和自蒸馏解决序数回归中因主观标注导致的边界模糊和噪声问题，利用视觉-语言对齐增强标签分布，并通过跨层交互确保序数结构一致性，在多个任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的序数回归方法依赖固定的监督目标，但在实际应用中，序数标签是通过主观人类判断对连续语义进行离散化得到的，导致边界模糊和标注噪声。这种不确定性使得依赖固定目标的方法可能在主观标注下强化错误的排序偏差。

Method: 提出D3O（Dynamic Distribution Distillation for Ordinal regression），一个动态分布蒸馏框架。具体包括：1）对比序数感知标签增强模块，利用视觉-语言对齐恢复能捕捉类间模糊性和实例级不确定性的细化标签分布；2）基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制，在网络层级间传播累积序数结构，确保中间表示中的序数几何一致性。

Result: 在四个通用序数回归任务上的广泛实验表明，D3O consistently 优于现有方法，特别是在严重的类别不平衡和嘈杂监督条件下表现突出。

Conclusion: 动态监督在超越固定目标学习鲁棒序数表示方面是有效的。代码将公开。

Abstract: Ordinal regression is widely used in scenarios where labels are discrete yet inherently ordered. In practice, however, ordinal labels are often obtained by discretizing underlying continuous semantics through subjective human judgment, resulting in ambiguous boundaries and annotation noise. Such uncertainty challenges existing methods that rely on fixed supervision targets, which may reinforce biased ordering under subjective annotations. To address this limitation, we propose D3O, a dynamic distribution distillation framework that replaces static supervision with training-driven evolution of ordinal label distributions via self-distillation. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive ordinal-aware label enhancement module that leverages vision-language alignment to recover refined label distributions capturing both inter-class ambiguity and instance-level uncertainty. Furthermore, we design a CDF-based cross-layer interaction distillation mechanism to propagate cumulative ordinal structure across network hierarchy, ensuring consistent ordinal geometry in intermediate representations. Extensive experiments on four general ordinal regression tasks demonstrate that our proposed D3O consistently outperforms existing approaches, particularly under severe class imbalance and noisy supervision. These results highlight the effectiveness of dynamic supervision in learning robust ordinal representations beyond fixed targets. The code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [87] [Neuromorphic Object Detection: An In-Depth Study and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23576)
*Jianing Li,Dianze Li,Arren Glover,Xiaopeng Fan,Guoqi Li,Chiara Bartolozzi,Ryad B. Benosman,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对神经形态相机在高速运动模糊和低光环境下物体检测的优势，指出当前缺乏统一基准和深入理解的问题。通过全面综述现有算法、数据集及评估指标，并从事件表示、时间建模等多角度分析代表性模型，提供详细对比结果与未来研究方向，旨在为研究者提供有价值的资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统帧基相机在高速运动模糊或低光环境中面临显著挑战；尽管神经形态相机提供了高时间分辨率和宽动态范围的异步视觉流，但在神经形态物体检测领域，目前仍缺乏对现有方法的深入理解以及标准化的基准测试来评估进展和解决关键挑战。

Method: 1. 提供问题描述，回顾可用数据集并重新审视评估指标；2. 从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟处理和节能计算等多个视角探讨现有的神经形态物体检测方法；3. 评估一系列具有代表性的神经形态物体检测模型，并对比较结果进行详细分析；4. 讨论未决问题并提出潜在的未来研究方向。

Result: 完成了一份全面的神经形态物体检测算法综述与基准测试，包括对多种代表性模型的评估和详细的对比分析结果，明确了当前的技术现状和性能表现。

Conclusion: 该综述和基准测试将为研究人员提供宝贵资源，并为神经形态物体检测领域的未来发展提供指导，有助于推动该领域技术的进步和应用拓展。

Abstract: Conventional frame-based cameras face significant challenges in detecting objects under high-speed motion blur or in low-light environments. Neuromorphic cameras provide asynchronous visual streams with high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range, offering a promising solution for object detection under challenging conditions. Despite the development of numerous models and the emergence of various applications in neuromorphic object detection, there is still a lack of deep understanding and standardized benchmarks to assess progress and address key challenges. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and benchmark of existing neuromorphic object detection algorithms. Specifically, we first present a problem description, review the available datasets, and revisit the evaluation metrics. We then explore existing neuromorphic object detection approaches from various perspectives, including event representation, temporal modeling, multimodal fusion, asynchronous processing, low-latency processing, and energy-efficient computing. Furthermore, we evaluate a wide range of representative neuromorphic object detection models and offer detailed analyses of the comparative results. Finally, we discuss unresolved issues in neuromorphic object detection and propose potential future research directions. We hope this survey and benchmark will be a valuable resource for researchers and provide guidance for future advancements in neuromorphic object detection.

</details>


### [88] [SketchMamba: A Lightweight State-Space Model for Joint Progressive Sketch Classification and Stroke Auto-Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23580)
*Kavish Jhaveri,Arya Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SketchMamba，一种基于选择性状态空间模型的单一因果序列模型，能够同时实现草图的流式识别和连续生成。在Quick, Draw!数据集上取得94.93%的最终准确率，且仅需70%笔画即可达到最终准确率的90%，参数量仅为155万，性能超越循环和卷积基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有矢量草图模型将识别与生成分为独立任务，无法有效支持需要在绘制过程中实时理解草图的流式交互界面。

Method: 构建了一个单一的因果序列模型，采用选择性状态空间（Selective State-Space）作为骨干网络，并应用密集的逐步骤分类损失函数，使模型能在处理部分前缀时持续进行分类，同时生成后续内容。

Result: 在58类Quick, Draw!子集上，最终步骤准确率达94.93%，渐进准确率AUC为0.706；在参数量匹配的比较中，其性能与因果Transformer持平，优于RNN和CNN基线；消融实验证实密集监督机制是实现早期预测能力的关键。

Conclusion: 单一因果隐藏状态可以统一渐进式识别和自回归生成，无需辅助编码器或特定任务的分支结构，证明了该架构在流式草图理解中的有效性。

Abstract: Existing vector-sketch models treat recognition and generation as separate tasks, leaving a gap for streaming interfaces that must understand a drawing as it is being made. We present SketchMamba, a single causal sequence model that continuously classifies a sketch from any partial prefix while simultaneously generating its continuation. We achieve this by applying a dense per-step classification loss to a selective state-space backbone. Evaluated on a 58-class subset of the Quick, Draw! dataset, SketchMamba yields 94.93% final-step accuracy and a progressive-accuracy Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.706, crossing 90% of its final accuracy by the time 70% of the strokes are drawn. In a matched-budget comparison, the 1.55 million-parameter backbone ties a causal Transformer while outperforming recurrent and convolutional baselines. Ablations confirm that the dense supervision regime, rather than the architecture alone, drives the early-prediction capability. The results demonstrate that a single causal hidden state can unify progressive recognition and autoregressive generation without auxiliary encoders or task-specific branching.

</details>


### [89] [JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23588)
*Yunlong Lin,Zixu Lin,Zhaohu Xing,Biqiang Li,Chenxin Li,Haonan Wang,Haitao Wu,Hengyu Liu,Jianghai Chen,Kaituo Feng,Kaixin Li,Shawn Chen,Shijue Huang,Sixiang Chen,Tsung-Yi Ho,Wenxuan Huang,Xiangyan Liu,Xiaomeng Hu,Xuanhua He,Yan Sun,Yunqing Zhao,Zhiqin Yang,Zehan Wang,Zhengyang Tang,Tianyu Pang,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出JarvisHub，一种基于画布的创意代理框架，用于支持长周期、多模态的创作过程，解决现有系统在中间上下文管理和人工干预方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的创意工作涉及复杂的迭代过程（如参考、草稿、版本关系、人工反馈等），而现有的提示词、聊天或节点式生成系统往往丢弃中间上下文或依赖线性流程，无法有效支持这种 evolving project state（演进式项目状态）。此外，商业系统的封闭架构阻碍了对代理如何表示上下文、选择工具和保持一致性的研究。

Method: 引入JarvisHub，一个原生画布式的创意代理引擎。其核心设计包括：1. 将可编辑画布作为用户工作区、代理外部记忆、动作空间和共享项目状态；2. 使用类型化的画布节点和链接来表示多模态工件、依赖关系、版本和反馈；3. 采用三层架构（画布状态、协议桥接、代理运行时）使代理能够在可检查、可编辑的创意状态下行动。

Result: 实现了从孤立的工具使用向持续的、人类可引导的创意自动化的转变。代理能够逐步规划、生成、修订和组织多模态项目，同时允许用户在过程中进行检查、指导和干预，从而维持长期创作的一致性。

Conclusion: JarvisHub通过结构化地管理创意项目的复杂状态，填补了开放研究环境与商业黑盒系统之间的空白，为长周期多模态创意生产提供了可扩展且透明的解决方案。

Abstract: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an evolving project state. Existing prompt-based, chat-based, and node-based generation systems only partially support this state, as they often discard intermediate context, rely on linear conversations, or require manually specified workflows. Recent commercial systems indicate a shift toward agent-assisted creative production, but their closed architectures make it difficult to study how agents represent context, choose tools, revise artifacts, recover from failures, and maintain consistency over time. To address this gap, we introduce JarvisHub, a canvas-native creative agent harness for long-horizon multimodal creation. JarvisHub treats an editable canvas as the user workspace, the agent's external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing multimodal artifacts, dependencies, versions, and feedback as typed canvas nodes and links. Through a three-layer architecture of canvas state, protocol bridge, and agent runtime, JarvisHub enables agents to act within an inspectable and editable creative state. This design moves creative agents beyond isolated tool use toward sustained, human-steerable creative automation, where agents can progressively plan, generate, revise, and organize multimodal projects while users remain able to inspect, guide, and intervene throughout the process.

</details>


### [90] [Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23594)
*Nao Sugeta,Kaito Shiku,Shinnosuke Matsuo,Ryoma Bise*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于多重实例学习（MIL）的框架，利用临床常用的幻灯片级Gleason评分标签，逆向估计出罕见的实例级Gleason模式标注，从而解决前列腺癌病理图像中实例级学习数据匮乏的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在前列腺癌组织病理学中，Gleason评分依赖于主要（Primary）和次要（Secondary）Gleason模式的频率确定。虽然幻灯片级标签在临床上常规可用，但实例级标注极为罕见，导致现有的补丁级（patch-level）学习方法面临挑战。

Method: 构建了一个MIL框架，依据Gleason评分的临床定义进行建模：将实例预测聚合为类别计数，并显式地对主要模式、次要模式及其主导关系进行建模，从而从幻灯片级标签推断实例级模式。

Result: 实验结果表明，该提出的公式化方法实现了有效的实例级学习，并在SICAP-MIL数据集上优于现有的MIL方法。

Conclusion: 该方法通过结合临床定义的Gleason评分逻辑与MIL技术，成功解决了缺乏实例级标注时的学习难题，提升了模型性能。

Abstract: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.

</details>


### [91] [ConFusion: Continuous Fusion Space Learning for Fine-Grained Controllable Infrared and Visible Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23600)
*Guo Yurong,He Yufei,Li Yonghao,Chang Dongliang,Zhang Ke,Ma Zhanyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ConFusion框架，通过高斯条件空间感知调制学习连续融合空间，实现实例级细粒度可控的红外观与可见光图像融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖预定义的离散控制条件，导致控制空间稀疏，无法满足细粒度调制需求。

Method: 采用双分支架构解耦模态不变和模态特定表示；利用Grounded SAM生成的实例掩码和高斯条件变量，通过掩码引导的特定特征调制器进行细粒度调制；使用文本驱动的不变特征增强器提升语义一致性；推理时利用多模态大语言模型解析用户意图生成调制变量。

Result: 在多个指标上实现了最先进的融合质量和下游任务性能，支持细粒度可控图像融合。

Conclusion: ConFusion有效解决了离散控制条件的局限性，实现了灵活、细粒度的红外-可见光图像融合。

Abstract: Controllable infrared-visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary thermal and structural information with flexible region-aware modulation, producing fused images that adapt to diverse user requirements and downstream tasks. However, existing methods typically rely on predefined discrete control conditions, leading to a sparse space that fails to support fine-grained modulation demands. To address this, we propose ConFusion, a novel framework that learns the continuous fusion space via Gaussian-conditioned spatial-aware modulation, enabling instance-level fine-grained controllable infrared and visible image fusion. ConFusion employs a dual-branch architecture to disentangle modality-invariant and modality-specific representations under joint reconstruction and text-guided semantic alignment. Gaussian-conditioned instance modulation variables coupled with Grounded SAM-based instance masks guide instance-level fine-grained modulation through the Mask-Guided Specific Feature Modulator, while the Text-Driven Invariant Feature Enhancer improves semantic consistency and enhances fusion. During inference, the multimodal large language model parses user intents into instance-level modulation variables to guide image fusion. Extensive experiments show that ConFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics in both fusion quality and downstream tasks, while supporting fine-grained controllable image fusion. Our code is available at https://github.com/HeyufeiAnto/Confusion

</details>


### [92] [Markerless Motion Capture in Routine Clinical Upper Limb Assessments: Validity and Insights Beyond Ordinal Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23608)
*Tim Unger,Olivier Lambercy,Roger Gassert,Andreas R. Luft,R. James Cotton,Chris Easthope Awai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究评估了基于AI的无标记动作捕捉（MMC）在临床常规ARAT评估中的应用，证明其能准确重建上肢运动并提供比传统序数评分更具敏感性和特异性的客观运动学指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的行动研究手臂测试（ARAT）虽广泛使用，但其序数评分具有主观性，且灵敏度和特异性有限，难以捕捉细微的运动恢复差异。

Method: 对20名混合神经系统疾病患者进行了47次会话、共1,174项ARAT任务的评估；利用嵌入临床常规的AI无标记动作捕捉技术进行生物力学重建，并分析运动学指标的有效性及纵向变化。

Result: 生物力学重建在不同损伤水平下均准确稳健；运动学指标展现出结构效度预期的区分模式；在纵向案例中，该方法揭示了同等ARAT增益下的患者特异性恢复谱系（提高特异性），并在ARAT评分饱和后仍能检测到运动学改善（提高敏感性）。

Conclusion: 将MMC整合到临床常规中，可提供有效、客观、高敏感和高特异的运动学测量，作为传统序数评分的有力补充。

Abstract: The Action Research Arm Test (ARAT) is a widely-used upper limb outcome measure in neurorehabilitation, but its ordinal scoring is subjective and suffers from limited sensitivity and specificity. We evaluated whether artificial-intelligence (AI)-based markerless motion capture (MMC), embedded into ARAT assessments during clinical routine, accurately reconstructs upper limb movement and yields valid, objective kinematic metrics carrying clinically meaningful information beyond the ordinal score. Across 47 sessions from 20 mixed-neurological patients (1,174 ARAT tasks), biomechanical reconstruction was accurate and robust across impairment levels, and kinematic metrics showed the discrimination pattern expected of a construct-valid measure. In longitudinal case studies, the metrics added the specificity and sensitivity the ordinal score lacks: a domain decomposition exposed patient-specific recovery profiles underlying equal ARAT gains (specificity), and kinematic improvement continued to be detected after the ARAT had saturated (sensitivity). MMC in clinical routine can thus provide valid, objective, sensitive, and specific kinematic measurement complementing ordinal scoring.

</details>


### [93] [PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23631)
*Jingzhi Chen,Landi He,Zehong Chen,Peihang Wu,Lijian Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为PathSelect的解耦路由框架，作为插件集成到预训练的SlideChat模型中。通过可微分的Soft Top-K和方差保持噪声门控解决WSI标记剪枝的非可微性问题，在推理时仅使用训练好的Scorer进行确定性硬Top-K选择。该方法在保持编码器和大语言模型冻结的情况下，实现了74.00%的SlideBench准确率，并将空间标记数量减少了约36.6倍（平均仅保留44.86个标记），显著优于基于采样的现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 吉像素全切片图像（WSIs）因序列长度极端巨大，对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）构成计算瓶颈。现有的空间采样或免训练剪枝方法容易稀释微弱但具有信息量的信号，由于病理线索的空间弥散性，导致关键诊断证据丢失。

Method: 将WSI标记剪枝重构为顺序选择过程，使模型能自主学习最优路由策略而非依赖静态启发式规则。提出PathSelect模块：1）引入方差保持噪声门控，通过可微分的Soft Top-K算子调节每个patch的信息流，提供连续梯度以支持非可微剪枝操作的训练；2）结合对角注意力去噪器（diagonal-attention Denoiser）恢复受扰表示，防止语义泄漏。该模块作为活跃插件集成到完全预训练的SlideChat基座模型中，保持幻灯片编码器和大型语言模型冻结。

Result: 在推理阶段，PathSelect模块完全脱离，仅依赖训练好的Scorer执行确定性Hard Top-K操作，实现自适应、数据依赖的轨迹终止。在最大约束K=128下，实证平均仅使用44.86个标记。在SlideBench (TCGA)上达到74.00%的整体准确率，相比未压缩基线平均实现了约36.6倍的空间标记减少，并持续优于基于采样的替代方案。

Conclusion: 所提出的解耦路由框架通过自主学习的动态标记选择机制，有效解决了WSI处理中的计算瓶颈和信息丢失问题，在大幅降低序列长度的同时保持了高精度的诊断性能，为高效处理大规模病理图像提供了新范式。

Abstract: Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) present a fundamental computational bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs) due to extreme sequence lengths. Existing approaches predominantly rely on spatial sampling or training-free pruning, which risk diluting weak but informative signals, leading to the loss of critical diagnostic evidence due to the spatially diffuse nature of pathological cues. We reformulate WSI token pruning as a sequential selection process, enabling the model to autonomously learn an optimal routing strategy rather than relying on static heuristics. We herein propose a decoupled routing framework integrated as an active plugin into the fully pre-trained SlideChat base model, leaving both the slide encoder and large language model frozen. To provide continuous gradients for the non-differentiable pruning operation during training, we introduce PathSelect. PathSelect employs a variance-preserving noise gate to modulate each patch's information flow via a differentiable Soft Top-K operator, paired with a diagonal-attention Denoiser that recovers the perturbed representations without semantic leakage. At inference, the PathSelect module is entirely detached. Relying solely on the trained Scorer, a deterministic Hard Top-K operator executes adaptive, data-dependent trajectory termination, significantly accelerating downstream generative processing with exceptionally low sequential token selection latency. Driven by an empirical average of only 44.86 tokens under a maximum constraint of K = 128, our framework achieves 74.00% overall accuracy on SlideBench (TCGA), representing an approximate 36.6x spatial token reduction relative to the uncompressed baseline average while consistently outperforming sampling-based counterparts.

</details>


### [94] [WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23638)
*Junfei Shi,Haojia Zhang,Yu Cheng,Yuke Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WGDNet，一种结合Wishart统计特性与几何感知机制的深度网络，解决PolSAR分类中传统方法适应性差、现有深度学习忽略统计特性及固定卷积难以捕捉多尺度地形模式的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PolSAR分类方法存在三大局限：1) 传统Wishart方法依赖刚性手工算子，适应性有限；2)主流深度网络忽视PolSAR固有的Wishart散射统计特性；3) 固定卷积窗口无法有效捕捉多尺度、多方向的地形模式，影响边界检测和微小目标识别。

Method: 提出WGDNet（Wishart-guided geometric-aware deep network），包含三个核心设计：(1) 具有方向核的可学习Wishart卷积，用于提取多尺度统计边缘特征；(2) 方向先验聚合模块，估计局部主导方向和置信度以自适应优化方向性Wishart输出；(3) GAnet，一种尺度-方向自适应几何感知卷积，通过动态重塑采样网格来建模各向异性地形并保留细节。

Result: 在四个真实PolSAR数据集上的评估表明，WGDNet在分类精度和边界保真度方面均优于现有的最先进（SOTA）方法。

Conclusion: 该研究通过引入可学习的Wishart统计建模、方向先验特征聚合以及几何自适应卷积，有效提升了PolSAR图像的分类性能，特别是在处理复杂地形和精细边界方面表现显著。

Abstract: Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) classification underpins all-weather Earth observation. Conventional Wishart methods depend on rigid handcrafted operators with limited adaptability, while mainstream deep networks ignore PolSAR native Wishart scattering statistics. Additionally, fixed convolution windows fail to capture multi-scale, multi-directional terrain patterns, harming boundary detection and small-object characterization. To mitigate these drawbacks, we propose WGDNet, a Wishart-guided geometric-aware deep network. It integrates three core designs: (1) learnable Wishart convolutions with directional kernels for multi-scale statistical edge feature extraction; (2) an orientation-prior aggregation module that estimates dominant local directions and confidences to refine directional Wishart outputs adaptively; (3) GAnet, a scale-direction adaptive geometric-aware convolution that dynamically reshapes sampling grids to model anisotropic terrain and retain fine details. Our contributions lie in learnable Wishart statistical modeling, orientation-prior feature aggregation, and geometry-adaptive convolution. Evaluations across four real PolSAR datasets verify WGDNet surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches in classification accuracy and boundary fidelity.

</details>


### [95] [GRAPE: Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23657)
*Yunfei Liu,Lijian Lin,Ye Zhu,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRAPE框架，通过构建含颈部的肖像参数模型(PPM)和渐进式解剖对齐网络(PAA)，解决现有3DMM在头部姿态、下颌与表情解耦方面的局限，显著提升单目肖像网格重建质量及下游任务效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于3D形态可变形模型(3DMM)的方法存在三大缺陷：1) 面部-centric模型缺乏颈部运动学导致“漂浮头部”假设；2) 身体-centric模型缺乏高保真面部表情能力；3) 难以分离下颌关节与表情混合形状，常错误依赖表情控制张嘴动作。这些限制使得单目肖像恢复在表示、监督和参数估计上面临困难。

Method: 1. 构建肖像参数模型(PPM)：建立从躯干到头的显式运动学链，并通过标准注入步骤融合FLAME面部模型与SMPL-X躯干模型。2. 提出渐进式解剖对齐(PAA)网络：包含预训练肖像编码器、分级掩码路由器(Routed Mask Router)以及遵循解剖先验的由粗到细专家模块。3. 多源监督训练：结合稀疏解剖关键点、特征蒸馏、前景掩码约束和相对几何约束进行优化。

Result: GRAPE在肖像网格重建质量、姿态对齐精度以及下颌-表情解耦方面均优于先前方法。实验还证明该方法能有效提升音频驱动说话头生成和3D肖像生成等下游任务的性能。

Conclusion: GRAPE通过引入显式颈部运动学和渐进式解剖对齐机制，有效解决了传统3DMM在全身与面部细节平衡及解剖结构解耦上的难题，为高精度3D肖像理解与生成提供了更优解决方案。

Abstract: Articulated portrait mesh estimation is fundamental to 3D understanding, avatar generation, and immersive interaction. Existing approaches primarily rely on 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs). However, face-centric models suffer from the "floating head" assumption, conflating head pose with global rotation due to the lack of neck kinematics. Conversely, body-centric models lack high-fidelity facial expression capabilities. Furthermore, current methods struggle to disentangle jaw articulation from expression blendshapes, often over-relying on expressions for mouth opening. These limitations make monocular portrait recovery difficult across representation, supervision, and anatomical parameter estimation. To address these limitations, we introduce GRAPE(Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation). We build a Portrait Parametric Model (PPM) with an explicit torso-to-head kinematic chain and a canonical injection step to merge FLAME and the SMPL-X torso. We propose a Progressive Anatomical Alignment (PAA) network, which is composed of a pretrained portrait encoder, a Graduated-Mask Router, and coarse-to-fine experts that follow the portrait anatomical prior. We then train this network with multi-source supervision that combines sparse anatomical keypoints, feature distillation, foreground mask constraints, and relative geometry constraints. Experiments show that GRAPE improves portrait mesh recovery quality, pose alignment, and jaw--expression disentanglement over prior methods. We also demonstrate that our method can benefit the downstream tasks of audio-driven talking-head generation and 3D portrait generation.

</details>


### [96] [XMatchAD: A Cross-Modal Matching Perspective on Reconstruction-based Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23658)
*Mingxiu Cai,Zhe Zhang,Gaochang Wu,Tianyou Chai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出XMatchAD框架，通过伪跨模态匹配机制和自适应频率感知融合模块，解决无监督异常检测中细微异常难以捕捉及边界模糊的问题，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于重建的无监督异常检测方法（UAD）在处理复杂多类场景时，难以捕捉细微异常且产生的异常边界模糊，限制了其有效性。

Method: 1. 使用预训练特征提取器编码判别性表示；2. 引入注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制，将输入与重建图像视为互补模态，匹配局部异常相关模式并互相细化特征；3. 设计自适应频率感知融合模块，通过耦合跨模态多尺度表示中的高频成分来 delineate 锐利的异常边界。

Result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD基准上的综合评估表明，该方法在多类异常检测和定位方面 consistently 取得优越性能，优于当前最先进的方法。

Conclusion: XMatchAD通过重新解释任务为伪跨模态匹配，有效提升了异常检测的敏感度和定位精度，特别是在处理形状多样和细微偏差的异常时效果显著。

Abstract: The remarkable success of reconstruction-based methods in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) lies in their ability to identify and localize anomalies by modeling discrepancies between input images and their reconstructed counterparts. However, these approaches often struggle to capture subtle anomalies and tend to produce blurred anomaly boundaries, which significantly limits their effectiveness, particularly in complex multi-class scenarios. To address these issues, we present XMatchAD, a novel UAD framework that reinterprets the task from a pseudo cross-modal matching perspective. Specifically, the input and reconstructed images are treated as two complementary modalities and their matching relationships are precisely exploited for anomaly detection. First, a pre-trained feature extractor is employed to encode discriminative representations. Second, an attention-guided cross-modal matching mechanism is introduced to match local inter-modal anomaly-related patterns while mutually refining the features. This enhances the sensitivity to anomalies with diverse shapes and subtle deviations and significantly improves the precision of anomaly detection and localization. Third, we design an adaptive frequency-aware fusion module that further delineates sharp anomaly boundaries through the coupling of high-frequency components from cross-modal multi-scale representations. Comprehensive evaluations on MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in multi-class anomaly detection and localization. The code will be released at https://github.com/Mingxiu-Cai/XMatchAD.

</details>


### [97] [RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23669)
*Junyue Li,Ye Zheng,Yifan Chen,Zhe Sun,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RRTrack，一种结合2D-6D闭环跟踪与DINOv2模板匹配的鲁棒物体6D位姿追踪器，有效解决动态遮挡和快速运动问题，在合成基准上性能显著提升且保持实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单帧估计器计算昂贵，而当前跟踪器因依赖连续可见性，难以应对快速运动和完全遮挡场景，导致跟踪失效。

Method: 1. 采用2D-6D闭环策略：2D分支利用基于记忆的VOS维持目标定位，6D分支验证几何一致性以更新记忆；2. 开发基于DINOv2的双库模板匹配模块，联合利用离线合成模板和在线观测锚点以恢复丢失目标；3. 构建包含快速运动和全遮挡场景的合成RGB-D基准。

Result: 在合成基准上，相比FoundationPose，RRTrack的equal-subset mean ADD-S AR提升66.3%，ADD-S AUC提升65.7%，并达到55.2 FPS的实时速度；真实实验验证了其在噪声感知条件下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: RRTrack通过创新的闭环跟踪机制和模板匹配策略，实现了在复杂动态及遮挡环境下的鲁棒、高效6D位姿跟踪，为机器人系统提供了可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Robust object 6D pose tracking is critical for robotic systems operating in dynamic and occluded scenes. Per-frame estimators are accurate but computationally expensive, while current trackers struggle with fast motion and complete occlusion due to their reliance on continuous visibility. To address these challenges, we present RRTrack, an efficient, recoverable object 6D pose tracker that enables robust tracking through fast motion and target disappearance--reappearance. RRTrack introduces a 2D--6D closed-loop tracking strategy that integrates memory-based video object segmentation (VOS) with 6D pose refinement. The 2D branch maintains target localization, and the 6D branch verifies geometric consistency before memory updates. In addition, a DINOv2-based dual-bank template matching module is developed to recover lost targets by jointly exploiting offline synthetic templates and online observation anchors while maintaining real-time efficiency. We also introduce a synthetic RGB-D benchmark comprising three robotic scenarios with fast motion and full occlusion. Experimental results on the synthetic benchmark demonstrate that RRTrack improves equal-subset mean ADD-S AR by 66.3\% and ADD-S AUC by 65.7\% over FoundationPose while achieving 55.2 FPS. Real-world experiments further validate the robustness of RRTrack under noisy sensing conditions. Project page: https://github.com/7kevin24/RRTrack

</details>


### [98] [Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23673)
*Yu Zhang,Wenda Zhao,Haojun Tang,Haipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于对比参数解耦的多模态遥感图像生成框架，通过单一文本提示生成光学、红外和SAR图像，实现了语义一致性和结构对齐性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感图像生成方法主要局限于单模态合成，未能利用多模态图像中固有的互补信息。

Method: 1. 引入对比参数解耦模块：在正交核心子空间中，于参数层面将共享语义与模态特定属性分离。2. 解耦优化策略：约束LoRA适配器的参数矩阵A通过多模态对比目标捕获模态不变语义，并引导多个参数矩阵B在文本条件下学习模态特定属性。3. 查询-键结构转移机制：在推理期间联合建模多模态采样轨迹，通过将锚点模态的结构相关性先验转移到其他模态来确保结构对齐。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐性方面优于最先进的遥感图像生成方法，并在下游物体分类任务中取得了优越性能。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了多模态遥感图像生成中的语义不一致和结构不对齐问题，提升了生成图像的多样性和下游任务性能。

Abstract: Existing remote sensing image generation methods are largely confined to single-modality synthesis and therefore fail to exploit the complementary information inherent in multimodal imagery. To address this limitation, we propose a contrastive parameter disentanglement framework for multimodal remote sensing image generation, which generates semantically consistent and structurally aligned images across multiple modalities, including optical, infrared, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR), from a single text prompt. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive parameter disentanglement module that disentangles shared semantics from modality-specific attributes at the parameter level within an orthogonal core subspace. Based on this module, we develop a disentangled optimization strategy that first constrains the parameter matrix A of the LoRA adapter to capture modality-invariant semantics through a multimodal contrastive objective and then guides multiple parameter matrices B to learn modality-specific attributes under text conditioning. This strategy enables the simultaneous generation of multimodal images with consistent semantic content and distinct modality characteristics. Furthermore, to ensure structural alignment across the generated images, we devise a query-key structure transfer mechanism that jointly models multimodal sampling trajectories during inference by transferring structural correlation priors from an anchor modality to the remaining modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art remote sensing image generation approaches in terms of generation quality, semantic consistency, and structural alignment, while also achieving superior performance in the downstream object classification task.

</details>


### [99] [Perturbation-Aware Diffusion-Guided Hybrid Segmentation for Robust and Annotation-Efficient Plant Stress Phenotyping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23680)
*Gurbhit Chaurakoti,Soumyashree Kar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种扩散引导的混合语义分割框架，结合传统骨干网络与扩散模型（DDPM/潜在扩散）进行掩码细化。通过在PlantSegV3数据集上的系统性评估，证明了该框架在低标注数据、外观扰动及跨域场景下的鲁棒性和高效性，显著提升了农业图像分割的结构精度和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有农业图像语义分割多在域内协议下评估，缺乏对实际部署中所需的外观扰动鲁棒性、有限标注资源适应性以及跨域分布偏移的处理能力。

Method: 1. 构建扩散引导的混合分割框架：使用U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer生成粗掩码，再由去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散模型进行细化。
2. 执行3x3架构筛选研究及边界约束优化。
3. 进行扰动引导的重训练、低数据评估及受限超参数筛选。
4. 实施受控的跨域适应实验。

Result: 1. 最佳混合模型在PlantSegV3上达到71.83%的细化mIoU和26.10%的细化Boundary-F1。
2. 模型在大幅减少监督信号时保持稳定，显示强标注效率。
3. 识别出灰度转换、雾、粗略丢弃和阴影为最具破坏性的外观变化，相应的增强策略显著提升了重训练时的鲁棒性。
4. 适配后的模型在有限目标监督下能有效迁移至外部农业数据集。

Conclusion: 精心匹配的骨干网络-细化器配对，结合感知扰动的重训练，能够在现实资源和分布约束下改善结构描绘并提高鲁棒性。扩散细化和边界感知优化提供了可转移的结构先验知识。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation in agricultural imagery is often evaluated under in-domain protocols, yet practical deployment requires robustness to appearance perturbations, limited annotations, and cross domain shift. This paper presents a diffusion-guided hybrid segmentation framework in which U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer backbones generate coarse masks that are refined by Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), latent diffusion, or semantic-guided diffusion. The framework is evaluated through a 3x3 architectural screening study on PlantSegV3, followed by boundary-constrained optimization, perturbation-guided retraining, low-data evaluation, constrained hyperparameter screening, and controlled cross-domain adaptation. On PlantSegV3, the best selected hybrid model achieves 71.83% refined mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) and 26.10% refined Boundary-F1, and the selected models remain stable under substantially reduced supervision, demonstrating strong annotation efficiency. Perturbation analysis identifies grayscale conversion, fog, coarse dropout, and shadow as the most disruptive appearance shifts, and the resulting augmentation policy substantially improves robustness during retraining. The adapted models further show effective transfer to external agricultural datasets under limited target supervision, indicating that diffusion refinement and boundary-aware optimization provide transferable structural priors. Overall, the results show that carefully matched backbone-refiner pairings, combined with perturbation-aware retraining, can improve structural delineation and robustness under realistic resource and distribution constraints.

</details>


### [100] [GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23687)
*Stylianos Ploumpis,Jan Bednarik,Gaspard Zoss,Ruslan Guseinov,Luca Prasso,Prashanth Chandran,Oliver Boyne,Vasileios Choutas,Timo Bolkart,Daoye Wang,Menglei Chai,Di Qiu,Sebastian Winberg,Gilles Rainer,Lewis Bridgeman,Delio Vicini,Jérémy Riviere,Yannick Boetzel,Alexander Koumis,Jay Busch,Cynthia Herrera,Jacob Still,Scott Ysebert,Peter Lincoln,Sergio Orts Escolano,Christoph Rhemann,Erroll Wood,Thabo Beeler,Stefanos Zafeiriou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了名为生成人类学模型（GNM）的新参数化头部模型，该模型涵盖了头、脸、颈、眼球、牙齿和舌头，解决了现有公开模型解剖范围有限及几何质量低的问题，并在3D人脸拟合上达到SotA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的公开参数化头部模型通常仅限于外部几何结构，忽略了口腔内和眼部结构，且常因低精度输入数据集导致几何质量下降，难以满足对精细空间控制的需求。

Method: 构建了一个包含头、面、颈、眼球、牙齿和舌头的综合参数化模型（GNM）。该模型基于高分辨率3D扫描数据库以及高质量的人工制作解剖样本进行训练，并设计了专门针对眼部和口腔内部结构的子模型架构。

Result: GNM在拟合目标3D人脸扫描数据方面达到了当前最佳（SotA）性能。完整的GNM框架已公开发布以促进社区创新。

Conclusion: GNM通过提供更全面的人体解剖结构和更高的几何保真度，为计算机视觉和图形学中的动画、渲染、重建及生成式大模型的 conditioning signals 提供了更强大的工具支持。

Abstract: Parametric models of the human head are essential tools traditionally used in computer vision and graphics for animation, rendering, and reconstruction. More recently, they serve as crucial conditioning signals within generative large vision models, allowing for tight spatial control of generated imagery. However, existing publicly available models are typically limited in anatomical scope, modeling only outer geometry while ignoring intra-oral and ocular structures, and frequently suffer from reduced geometric quality stemming from low-fidelity input datasets. In this report we introduce a new parametric model dubbed Generative aNthropometric Model (GNM), named as a homophone of the human genome. GNM encompasses the head, face, neck, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue, and it is built on an extensive database of high-resolution 3D scans combined with high-quality anatomy specific artist-made samples. This report details the data provenance, the model architecture including the specialized sub-models for the ocular and intra-oral structures, and shows its SotA performance on fitting target 3D face scans. To foster community innovation, the complete GNM framework is made publicly available.

</details>


### [101] [Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM3 for Prompt-Driven Surgical Concept Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23694)
*Changjing Liu,Yiming Huang,Beilei Cui,Liangjing Shao,Long Bai,Yanheng Li,Haoxuan Che,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于SAM3的参数高效低秩自适应（LoRA）方法，用于手术概念分割。通过仅微调提示编码器、检测器和跟踪器中的低秩适配器（冻结视觉主干），将参数量优化至0.98%，在单张消费级GPU上即可训练。该方法解决了现有医学SAM模型计算成本高及域差异导致的精度下降问题，性能优于零样本SAM3及其他基线，并能直接支持下游机器人手术场景重建与物理仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Prompt驱动的基础模型（如SAM3）在自然图像分割上表现优异，但手术数据与其预训练数据存在域差异，导致分割精度下降。此外，现有的医学SAM方法通常需要全参数微调，造成巨大的计算消耗和低效率。

Method: 提出一种针对SAM3的参数高效LoRA适配方案。具体做法是将低秩适配器注入到提示编码器（prompt encoder）、检测器（detector）和跟踪器（tracker）中，同时完全冻结视觉主干（vision backbone）。该策略仅优化总模型参数的0.98%，并支持在单张消费级GPU上进行训练。

Result: 综合实验表明，该方法一致性地优于零样本SAM3和其他主流基线模型。生成的分割结果可以直接部署以支持下游的机器人手术场景重建和物理仿真流水线。

Conclusion: 该工作通过参数高效的LoRA适配技术，有效克服了手术分割中的域差异和计算效率瓶颈，为临床诊断、术中监测及机器人辅助手术提供了高效且高精度的解决方案。

Abstract: Efficient surgical segmentation empowers clinical diagnosis, intraoperative monitoring, and downstream robotic pipelines for reconstruction and simulation. Although prompt-driven foundation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) achieve strong segmentation performance on natural images, surgical data exhibits domain gaps against its pre-training data, resulting in degraded segmentation accuracy. Furthermore, existing medical SAM methods require full-parameter fine-tuning, incurring heavy computational consumption and low efficiency. To address these limitations, this work proposes a parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adaptation of SAM3 for surgical concept segmentation. We inject low-rank adapters into the prompt encoder, detector and tracker while fully freezing the vision backbone, which only optimizes 0.98% of the total model parameters and supports training on a single consumer GPU. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms zero-shot SAM3 and other mainstream baselines, and the generated segmentation results can be directly deployed to support downstream robotic surgical scene reconstruction and physical simulation pipelines.

</details>


### [102] [DAP-Pose: Deep Temporal Alignment and Physics-aware Cross-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23755)
*Jianhan Lin,Yuchu Qin,Jiateng Yuan,Wenbo Zhang,Shuai Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DAP-Pose模型，通过双模态融合、深度时间对齐和物理约束实现多传感器鲁棒姿态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决复杂环境下自主车辆和移动机器人系统中，多模态传感器（视觉、惯性、GNSS）姿态估计的鲁棒性和准确性问题，特别是处理异步数据流和时间偏移挑战。

Method: 构建端到端模型，包含：1) 双层跨模态融合(BCF)模块提取语义和几何运动线索；2) 深度时间对齐(DTA)模块在潜在空间对齐异步流；3) 引入流形几何和GNSS引导的绝对度量尺度作为物理感知约束。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上达到SOTA性能，平均平移误差(t_rel)为1.31%，旋转误差(r_rel)为0.46°；在严重人工注入的时间错位下仍保持稳健性能。

Conclusion: DAP-Pose通过联合优化跨模态特征、时间对齐及物理约束，显著提升了多传感器姿态估计的精度与鲁棒性，无需严格硬件同步即可实现相干运动建模。

Abstract: Robust and accurate pose estimation with multi-modal sensors is fundamental for autonomous vehicles and mobile robotic systems in complex environments. In this paper, we propose DAP-Pose, a unified end-to-end model for robust multi-modal pose estimation. DAP-Pose introduces a Bi-level Cross-modal Fusion (BCF) module that captures complementary semantic and geometric motion cues from visual, inertial, and GNSS measurements. To handle temporal offsets, we designed a Deep Temporal Alignment (DTA) module that explicitly aligns asynchronous streams in latent space, enabling coherent motion modeling without strict hardware synchronization. Furthermore, we incorporate physics-aware constraints via manifold geometry and GNSS-guided absolute metric scale, enforcing motion consistency and mitigating drift. Experiments upon the public KITTI benchmark dataset were conducted to evaluate the performance of DAP-Pose against existing methods. DAP-Pose achieved the state-of-the-art performance, with the lowest average translation error ($t_{rel}$) of 1.31% and rotation error ($r_{rel}$) of 0.46$^{\circ}$. Furthermore, it accurately estimates poses and maintains robust performance under severe artificially injected temporal misalignment.

</details>


### [103] [RoadVGGT: Road-Structure-Aware Feed-Forward Road Surface Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23758)
*Han Jiao,Chen Liu,Jiakai Sun,Zhanjie Zhang,Mengyuan Yang,Yimeng Li,Mofan Zhou,Kun Zhan,Lei Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoadVGGT，一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式道路表面重建框架，利用几何基础模型和密集高斯属性预测，实现可扩展、高质量的道路重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有道路专用优化方法需逐场景训练及依赖轨迹的场景覆盖设计，限制了在新收集道路上的大规模可扩展重建能力。

Method: 引入RoadVGGT框架：1) 使用几何基础模型结合多视图图像、位姿和深度观测；2) 通过学习的高斯头预测稠密像素对齐的高斯属性；3) 将预测值对齐至一致的世界坐标系，并通过置信度加权网格融合在道路对齐XY平面上合并冗余高斯；4) 采用类别感知分组和路缘保护机制以维护脆弱道路结构。

Result: 实现了紧凑高斯表示下的完整道路表面重建，支持RGB和语义鸟瞰图、高程估计及新视角合成；消除了逐场景优化需求，提升了图像质量、语义映射和高程精度。

Conclusion: 几何基础模型在可扩展的前馈式道路表面重建中具有巨大潜力，RoadVGGT有效解决了现有方法的可扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: Large-scale road surface reconstruction supports high-definition mapping, autonomous-driving perception, annotation, and simulation. Existing road-specialized optimization methods can produce high-quality road representations, but they typically require per-scene training and scene-dependent coverage design around the driving trajectory, limiting scalable reconstruction over newly collected roads. To address these limitations, we introduce RoadVGGT, a road-structure-aware feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact Gaussian road surfaces without test-time per-scene optimization. RoadVGGT uses a geometric foundation model to exploit multi-view images together with provided pose and depth observations, and predicts dense pixel-aligned Gaussian attributes through a learned Gaussian head. To make these dense predictions usable for large road surfaces, we align them into a consistent metric world coordinate system and fuse redundant Gaussians on the road-aligned XY plane through confidence-weighted grid fusion. Category-aware grouping and road--sidewalk junction protection further control fusion around vulnerable road structures. The resulting representation supports RGB and semantic bird's-eye-view maps, elevation estimation, and novel view synthesis. RoadVGGT eliminates the need for per-scene optimization in prior methods, reconstructs complete road surfaces with a compact Gaussian representation, and improves image quality, semantic mapping, and elevation accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the potential of geometric foundation models for scalable feed-forward road surface reconstruction.

</details>


### [104] [PathScale-R1: Cross-scale Reasoning for Pathological Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23794)
*Chi Phan,Tianyi Zhang,Yufeng Wu,Qiaochu Xue,Jiajie Zhang,Linghan Cai,Zeyu Liu,Sudong Wang,Yueming Jin,Dan Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PathScale-VQA基准和PathScale-R1模型，通过对抗性文本筛选和结构控制干扰采样解决病理多尺度推理中的捷径依赖问题，实现跨尺度视觉理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基准和视觉语言模型(VLMs)主要基于单尺度设置，无法有效学习具有临床意义的多放大倍率推理；且传统的视觉问答(VQA)任务易受纯文本或表面视觉捷径的影响，导致对视觉理解能力的评估不可靠。

Method: 1. 设计“对抗性纯文本筛选策略”用于语义推理问题，以及“结构控制的干扰采样策略”用于视觉定位问题，迫使模型依赖跨尺度视觉证据。
2. 构建PathScale-VQA基准（含10,373个多选题，覆盖1,368条诊断路径）。
3. 开发PathScale-R1模型：先进行难度驱动的推理蒸馏监督微调，再结合基于“尺度感知推理结构奖励”的强化学习进行优化。

Result: PathScale-R1在跨尺度推理任务上达到了最先进(SOTA)性能，并能有效迁移至传统的单尺度病理VQA任务。

Conclusion: 该框架成功解决了病理图像分析中多尺度推理的难点，提升了模型对跨尺度视觉证据的利用能力，为更可靠的病理AI评估提供了新标准。

Abstract: Pathological diagnosis is inherently multi-scale, requiring the integration of global tissue architecture at low magnification with cellular morphology at higher magnification. However, existing pathology benchmarks and vision-language models (VLMs) are still largely developed under single-scale settings, limiting their ability to learn clinically meaningful multi-magnification reasoning. Moreover, naively constructed visual question answering (VQA) tasks may be susceptible to text-only or superficial visual shortcuts, leading to unreliable assessments of visual understanding. To address these limitations, we introduce a benchmark and training framework for shortcut-resistant cross-scale pathology reasoning. We design an Adversarial Text-only Screening strategy for semantic reasoning questions and a Structure-controlled Distractor Sampling strategy for visual grounding questions, encouraging models to rely on cross-scale visual evidence. Based on this pipeline, we construct PathScale-VQA, a high-quality cross-scale pathology VQA benchmark with 10,373 multiple-choice questions grounded in 1,368 diagnostic paths across multiple magnification levels. Building on the semantic reasoning set, PathScale-R1 is optimized through Difficulty-driven Reasoning Distillation supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a Scale-aware Reasoning Structure reward, which encourages the use of evidence across magnifications. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of PathScale-R1 on cross-scale reasoning tasks and effective transfer to conventional single-scale pathology VQA. Our code is available at https://github.com/iMVR-PL/PathScale-R1.

</details>


### [105] [Beyond Appearance: A Multi-cue Framework and Large-scale Benchmark for Pedestrian Association and Tracking on Mobile Aerial-Ground Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23803)
*Ruiqi Wu,Bingliang Jiao,Ruize Han,Hangzheng Yu,Xunkai Jiang,Shining Wang,Yuanqi Hu,Wenxuan Wang,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FUSION框架解决多视角多目标关联与跟踪（MvMoAT）中的视角变化问题，并构建大规模基准数据集RealMvMoAT以推动该领域研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的多目标跟踪难以应对多平台协同感知中频繁出现的视角变化，这会导致外观失真，进而破坏跨视角关联和时序跟踪的准确性。

Method: 提出FUSION框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 多线索自适应组合（MAC）模块，自适应融合视角不变特征与外观特征以增强跨视角关联；2) 在线多视角特征同步（OMFS）模块，聚合历史及跨视角帧的特征以实现时序一致的跟踪。同时构建了包含7台相机（5架无人机、2个地面视角）、10个场景、50.49万帧数据的大规模基准数据集RealMvMoAT。

Result: 在自建的大型数据集RealMvMoAT及六个公开基准上的实验表明，FUSION方法取得了最先进的性能（SOTA）。RealMvMoAT是目前已知最大的MvMoAT数据集，具有显著的视角多样性和复杂的平台运动特性。

Conclusion: FUSION框架通过统一特征有效解决了视角变化带来的挑战，而RealMvMoAT数据集为未来多视角多目标跟踪研究提供了全面且极具价值的资源。

Abstract: Multi-view Multi-object Association and Tracking (MvMoAT) associates objects across camera views and tracks them over time, supporting identity persistence and forensic trajectory reconstruction in multi-platform cooperative perception. Unlike conventional multiple object tracking, MvMoAT faces frequent viewpoint shifts that distort appearance and undermine cross-view association and temporal tracking. We propose FUSION, a viewpoint-robust Feature Unification framework for multi-view aSsociation and IdentificatiON. Its Multi-cue Adaptive Combination (MAC) module adaptively integrates viewpoint-invariant cues with appearance features to improve cross-view association, while Online Multi-view Feature Synchronization (OMFS) aggregates pedestrian features across historical and cross-view frames for temporally consistent tracking. We also introduce RealMvMoAT, a large-scale benchmark featuring substantial inter- and intra-camera viewpoint variation. It contains 504.9K frames from 7 cameras (5 UAV and 2 ground views) across 10 scenes, with over 7.3M identity-labeled bounding boxes. All cameras exhibit random and substantial motion. To the best of our knowledge, RealMvMoAT is the largest MvMoAT dataset to date. Its scale, viewpoint diversity, complex platform motion, and realistic trajectories provide a comprehensive resource for future research. Experiments on RealMvMoAT and six public benchmarks show that FUSION achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [106] [Consistent Evidence, Robust Recognition: Faithful Attribution Regularization under Geometric Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23835)
*Xianghao Jiao,Ruoyu Chen,Wei Wang,Jiazi Hu,Jiawei Liang,Shangquan Sun,Shiming Liu,Qunli Zhang,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于子模搜索的无标注归因正则化框架，通过提取紧凑的证据作为监督信号，解决现有自监督方法因归因不忠实导致的变换鲁棒性不足问题，在保持精度的同时显著提升归因稳定性和模型对几何变换的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有归因方法在标签保持的几何变换下存在不一致性，且常用的基于梯度的自监督方法（如Grad-CAM）缺乏忠实度，导致归因一致性无法保证底层决策过程的一致性，从而未能有效解决变换鲁棒性问题。

Method: 提出基于图像区域子模搜索的无标注归因正则化框架。通过测量候选子集对模型输出的影响，提取紧凑的类判别性证据作为监督信号。引入包含路径一致性和终止对齐项的子模排序损失，以对齐配对搜索轨迹上的空间对应候选排名，并促使变换后的轨迹在目标终止步满足停止准则，为最终归因和离散证据选择过程提供可微代理。

Result: 在ImageNet-100上，ViT-B/16模型的归因稳定性、插入得分（Insertion）和删除得分（Deletion）显著提升，准确率仅下降0.28点；ViT-L/16也有类似增益。在ImageNet-1K上，ResNet-50和ConvNeXt-B的变换输入准确率提升，干净准确率下降限制在0.30点内，证明证据依赖更一致且性能损失最小。

Conclusion: 该方法通过子模搜索提供的可靠监督信号，有效提升了视觉Transformer和卷积神经网络的归因一致性及对几何变换的鲁棒性，实现了模型行为改进与性能保持之间的良好平衡。

Abstract: Attribution methods are widely used to characterize the evidence underlying model predictions, yet their potential to improve model behavior remains underexplored. Attribution inconsistency under label-preserving geometric transformations may indicate transformation-sensitive evidence reliance, motivating attribution regularization. However, such supervision is valid only when attribution faithfully reflects the evidence driving predictions. Existing self-supervised methods typically align gradient-based maps such as Grad-CAM, whose limited faithfulness means that attribution consistency need not imply consistency of the underlying decision process, leaving transformation robustness unresolved. We propose an annotation-free attribution regularization framework based on submodular search over image regions. By measuring how candidate subsets affect model outputs, the search extracts compact, class-discriminative evidence as search-derived supervision. We further introduce a submodular ranking loss with path-consistency and termination-alignment terms that respectively align spatially corresponding candidate rankings along paired search trajectories and encourage the transformed trajectory to satisfy the stopping criterion at the target terminal step. The loss provides a differentiable surrogate for regularizing both final attributions and the otherwise discrete evidence-selection process. Experiments on ImageNet-100 show that our method substantially improves attribution stability, Insertion, and Deletion on ViT-B/16 with only a 0.28-point accuracy drop, with similar gains on ViT-L/16. On ImageNet-1K, it improves transformed-input accuracy on ResNet-50 and ConvNeXt-B while limiting the clean-accuracy drop to 0.30 points, demonstrating more consistent evidence reliance with minimal performance loss. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [107] [STEER: Steerable Dyadic Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23840)
*Kartik Teotia,Helge Rhodin,Hyeongwoo Kim,Marc Habermann,Christian Theobalt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STEER，一种可控制的3D双人对话运动先验模型。该模型将对话行为分解为对视线、头部节奏和情感的显式控制，解决了现有方法难以精确控制非语言交流通道的问题。通过自建的伪标签标注管道和因果流匹配Transformer，实现了高保真Gaussian头像的可控动画生成，无需重新训练底层模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语音驱动面部动画方法主要关注唇形同步，往往将对话行为视为音频的副产品或仅提供粗粒度的情感控制，导致视线接触、头部节奏和情感等关键非语言通道的显式控制变得困难。

Method: 1. 构建跟踪与标注管道：从野外双人视频中恢复行为伪标签以解决标注数据缺失问题。
2. 开发因果流匹配Transformer：学习基于音频、伙伴动作、情感及提出的行为控制（视线、头部节奏、情感）的条件目标运动。
3. 集成到头像管线：扩展通用高斯头部头像先验，建立从追踪参数化运动到头像驱动空间的映射，实现无需重训的高保真可控动画。

Result: STEER在运动质量、动态性和多样性方面优于近期的双人运动基线，在伙伴耦合方面保持竞争力，并支持视线、头部节奏和情感的编辑。模型已部署用于交互式实时演示，且代码和数据集标注已公开。

Conclusion: STEER成功实现了具有显式控制能力的3D双人对话头像动画，填补了非语言交流通道精细控制的空白，为高保真、可交互的虚拟人物提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Facial movement and expression are central to face-to-face communication, conveying turn-taking, attention, agreement, and engagement alongside speech. While speech-driven facial animation has made strong progress in lip synchronization and audio-conditioned motion generation, most methods treat conversational behavior as an emergent byproduct of audio, or expose only coarse sequence-level affect control. As a result, key non-verbal channels such as gaze contact and aversion, rhythmic head motion, and emotion remain difficult to explicitly control. We present STEER, a controllable 3D dyadic motion prior for reactive conversational head avatars. STEER factorizes conversational behavior into explicit controls for gaze, head rhythm, and emotion, allowing users to steer how an avatar listens, reacts, and engages with a conversation partner. Since temporally aligned annotations for these behaviors are not available in public dyadic corpora, we introduce a tracking and annotation pipeline that recovers behavioral pseudo-labels from in-the-wild dyadic video. A causal flow-matching transformer then learns partner-aware target motion conditioned on audio, partner motion, emotion and the proposed behavioral controls. We further embed STEER in a photorealistic avatar pipeline by extending a Universal Gaussian Head-Avatar Prior with a learned mapping from tracked parametric motion into its avatar-driving space. This enables controllable animation of high-fidelity Gaussian head avatars without re-training the underlying avatar model. STEER outperforms recent dyadic motion baselines on motion quality, dynamics, and diversity, remains competitive on partner coupling, and enables gaze, head-rhythm, and emotion edits together with an interactive live deployment. We make our code and dataset annotations available at our webpage.

</details>


### [108] [OmniCache: Multidimensional Hierarchical Feature Caching For Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23844)
*Zhaoyuan He,Muhammad Muaz,Lili Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniCache框架，通过利用中间扩散特征的多维冗余（帧内、帧间、运动、去噪步），在不重训练的情况下显著降低高分辨率图像/视频扩散模型（如SD3, FLUX）的推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像和视频扩散模型生成质量高，但推理成本高，主要因为需要在多个采样步骤中重复评估计算密集的注意力机制。

Method: 提出OmniCache统一分层缓存框架，包含Token Cache、Frame Cache、Block Cache和Layered Cache四个组件。采用相似度匹配选择可缓存特征而非平均合并，跳过冗余计算并恢复位置一致的激活值，实现时空特征在空间/时间层间的复用及跨步骤冗余捕捉。

Result: 在SD3、SVD-XT和Latte模型上，推理延迟分别降低35%、25%和28%，同时保持视觉保真度和运动连贯性，且为免训练（training-free）设置。

Conclusion: 通过挖掘并利用扩散过程中的多维特征冗余，OmniCache能有效提升扩散模型的推理效率，无需修改模型权重或重新训练即可实现显著的加速效果。

Abstract: High-resolution image and video diffusion models, including SD3, FLUX, and recent video diffusion transformers, have substantially improved generative quality but remain expensive at inference time because they repeatedly evaluate attention-heavy denoisers over many sampling steps. We address this inefficiency by exploiting redundancy in intermediate diffusion features rather than changing model weights or retraining. We identify four complementary redundancy sources in image and video generation: intra-frame, inter-frame, motion, and denoising-step redundancy. Based on this analysis, we propose OmniCache, a unified hierarchical caching framework that performs multidimensional feature reuse through Token Cache, Frame Cache, Block Cache, and Layered Cache. Unlike token-merging baselines that average matched features, OmniCache uses similarity matching to select cacheable features, skips redundant computation, and restores positionally consistent cached activations, preserving feature order and spatial-temporal structure. The resulting framework reuses spatial features in temporal layers and temporal features in spatial layers, while Layered Cache captures cross-step redundancy at the model-layer level. Across SD3, SVD-XT, and Latte, OmniCache reduces inference latency by up to 35%, 25%, and 28%, respectively, while maintaining visual fidelity and motion coherence in a training-free setting.

</details>


### [109] [Bigger or Cheaper? Scale and Quantization Effects on Uncertainty Signals in Vision-Language Models Under Image Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24440)
*M M Asif Ferdous*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在固定内存预算下，对于Qwen2-VL模型，选择“较大尺寸的4-bit量化模型”优于“较小尺寸的全精度模型”。研究表明，模型规模扩大能显著提升内部不确定性信号（AUROC从0.80升至0.98），但自然语言置信度提升微弱；而4-bit量化虽对准确率影响极小（-1.6分），却严重损害置信度信号。因此，7B-4bit配置在准确率和不确定性检测上表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署在消费级硬件上的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）需要具备判断何时回答、何时回避的能力，这依赖于能够跟踪正确性的置信度信号。研究人员面临在固定内存预算下的权衡：是使用全精度的小模型、量化的同尺寸小模型，还是量化的大模型。这三种配置对置信度信号的影响截然不同，需要明确最优配置以支持选择性预测部署。

Method: 研究使用Qwen2-VL系列模型，对比了三种配置：小模型全精度、小模型4-bit量化、大模型4-bit量化（均适配相同内存足迹）。在包含5,700个预测样本的数据集上进行测试，涵盖六种真实照片退化及其三种严重程度。评估了两个置信度信号：1) 模型用自然语言表达的置信度；2) 生成答案的平均token概率（内部不确定性信号）。主要指标为错误检测AUROC和校准误差。

Result: 1. **规模效应**：模型规模增大（从2B到7B）显著改善内部不确定性信号（AUROC从0.80提升至0.98），但自然语言置信度依然较弱且接近随机水平（均值0.61至0.69），知识与表达间的差距随规模扩大而拉大。
2. **量化影响**：4-bit量化对准确率影响微乎其微（仅下降1.6分），但对置信度信号代价高昂：内部AUROC从0.95降至0.80，且自然语言置信度的解析率从99%暴跌至64%。
3. **最终推荐**：在固定内存预算下，7B-4bit配置同时提供了最佳的准确率（与较小全精度模型相当或更好）和最佳的内部不确定性信号（AUROC 0.98），优于其他两种配置。

Conclusion: 对于资源受限的VLM部署，应优先选择较大尺寸的量化模型而非较小尺寸的全精度模型，以获得更可靠的选择性预测能力。此外，研究指出错误检测AUROC比校准误差更能揭示内部信号与自然语言置信度之间的差异，建议将其作为评估置信度信号质量的主要指标。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) deployed on consumer hardware must decide when to answer and when to defer, and that decision depends on having a confidence signal that tracks correctness. A practitioner with a fixed memory budget faces a choice between a small model at full precision, the same small model quantized, and a larger model quantized into the same footprint -- three configurations that push the confidence signal in opposing directions. We measure, on identical inputs, how model scale and 4-bit quantization affect two confidence signals in the Qwen2-VL family: the confidence a model states in natural language, and its own mean token probability over the answer it generates. Across 5,700 predictions spanning six realistic photographic degradations at three severities, we find that scale sharply improves the model's internal uncertainty signal (mean error-detection AUROC 0.80 to 0.98 from 2B to 7B) while its verbalized confidence stays weak and often at chance (mean 0.61 to 0.69): the gap between what the model knows and what it says widens rather than closes with size. We find that 4-bit quantization is nearly free for accuracy (-1.6 points) but expensive for the confidence signal (internal AUROC 0.95 to 0.80, and the verbalized-confidence parse rate collapses from 99% to 64%). For a fixed memory budget the recommendation is therefore to prefer a larger quantized model over a smaller full-precision one: 7B-4bit gives both the best accuracy and the best uncertainty signal (internal AUROC 0.98) of the three configurations that fit. We frame the results as selective-prediction operating points so they translate directly into a deployment recommendation, and we argue that error-detection AUROC, not calibration error, is the metric that exposes the difference between the two signals.

</details>


### [110] [Head Avatars with Dynamic Explicit Hair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23861)
*Vanessa Sklyarova,Haonan Chen,Berna Kabadayi,Tobias Kirschstein,Zicong Fan,Xi Wang,Gerard Pons-Moll,Matthias Nießner,Marc Pollefeys,Michael J. Black,Justus Thies*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DynHair，一种基于结构化3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）和时序网络的新方法，用于从视频重建具有动态发丝级表现力的人头数字人，通过角速度、加速度及重力条件实现物理合理的头发动力学模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸区域可通过依附于3D头部模型的3D高斯点建模，但头发具有复杂的动态运动效果，难以用传统方式处理，因此需要一种专门针对动态发丝变形进行建模的方法。

Method: 1. 使用结构化3D高斯泼溅从视频重建显式发丝表示的头部数字人；2. 采用LSTM编码运动历史，结合FiLM条件调制（输入包括头部角速度、加速度和相对重力），通过MLP生成相对于规范发型（canonical hairstyle）的物理合理位移；3. 联合优化头发的运动和外观表示，与基于3DGS的面部区域表示一起，通过可微分高斯泼溅结合光度、几何和物理约束进行监督训练。

Result: 实现了训练视频数据的头发跟踪，并生成了具有可控头发动力学的可动画头部数字人；在头发动力学、时间一致性和跨主体泛化方面达到最先进（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: DynHair有效解决了动态头发建模难题，提供了高质量、物理合理且可控制的头发动画生成方案，适用于人头数字人的真实感重建。

Abstract: We present DynHair, a novel method for tracking and modeling dynamic hair for human head avatars. From video input, we reconstruct a dynamic head avatar with an explicit strand-based hair representation using structured 3D Gaussian Splatting. In contrast to the face region of human head avatars, which can be modeled with 3D Gaussians that are attached or generated with respect to some expressive 3D head model, hair is particularly challenging as it exhibits dynamic motion effects. Therefore, we present a novel method that models the dynamic deformations of the hair strands using a temporal network that is conditioned on angular velocity and acceleration of the head, as well as relative gravity. Specifically, an LSTM encodes the motion history and modulates per-point strand features via FiLM conditioning which further used by MLP to produce physically plausible displacements to canonical hairstyle. We jointly optimize this motion and appearance representation of the hair, with a 3DGS-based representation of the face-region, via differentiable Gaussian splatting with photometric, geometric, and physics-based supervision. As a result of our method, we retrieve hair tracking of the training video data and an animatable head avatar with controllable hair dynamics. In our experiments, we demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of hair dynamics, temporal consistency, and generalization across subjects.

</details>


### [111] [Long-Tailed Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23883)
*Nathanael Ren,Saagar Arya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对医学图像分类中因长尾分布导致的罕见病诊断偏差问题，本文通过实施数据增强等深度学习技术优化模型，旨在提升对罕见病的识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决标准技术在处理医学图像分类时面临的长尾分布难题，即由于罕见病症样本极少，导致模型倾向于诊断常见疾病而忽略罕见疾病，产生诊断偏差。

Method: 讨论并实现结合数据增强（augmentation）等技术的深度学习模型以最小化误差，特别是针对罕见病的预测误差；使用AP、F1分数、AUROC和损失函数在验证集上评估多种不同模型。

Result: 最佳模型取得了令人鼓舞的测试结果，有效改善了分类性能。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法在医疗领域具有潜在的应用价值，为改善罕见病诊断提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we examine the difficulties of using standard techniques for medical image classification due to long-tailed distributions (wherein rarer conditions have very few samples) resulting in bias towards diagnosing common diseases and away from rarer diseases. We then discuss and implement deep learning models with techniques such as augmentation to minimize error, especially from rarer diseases. We evaluate various different models with AP, F1 score, AUROC, and loss (all on the validation set). We conclude with the promising results from our best model, and potential applications in the healthcare space.

</details>


### [112] [Embeddings based Anomaly Detection for Cleaning Global Crop Type Reference Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23908)
*Syed Roshaan Ali Shah,Kristof Van Tricht,Christina Butsko,Jeroen Degerickx,Zoltan Szantoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于预训练地球观测编码器嵌入的局部感知异常检测框架（EBA），用于识别和清洗作物类型映射中参考数据里的噪声标签，显著提升了WorldCereal模型的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量参考数据是作物类型制图的关键瓶颈。现有操作化系统（如WorldCereal）整合了来源异构、存在偏差和未知标签噪声的数据，且简单的全局规则因区域和季节差异而失效。

Method: 利用预训练地球观测编码器的嵌入表示，构建局部感知的嵌入基异常（EBA）检测框架。通过比较同一地区同类作物的样本嵌入得分来标记异常点，并测试在模型训练前移除或降低这些异常点的权重是否有效。

Result: 1. 合成数据验证：检测器对注入标签错误的集中度比随机水平高2.5-5倍（AUROC高达0.84）。2. 真实数据验证：移除或加权处理被标记的保留点提高了作物类型和土地覆盖模型的精度。3. 实际应用：在世界Cereal模型的五个宏观区域评估中，保守的数据清洗策略提升了模型性能，但过度清洗有害。

Conclusion: EBA检测器方法具有可复现性和可扩展性，不仅适用于作物制图，还可作为清洗大规模、含噪地球观测参考数据集的通用模板。

Abstract: High quality reference data remain a critical bottleneck for crop-type mapping at any spatial and temporal scale. Operational systems such as WorldCereal aggregate labels from heterogeneous sources such as parcel registers, national databases, field surveys, and map-derived products, each with their own biases, coverage gaps and unknown label noise. Simple global rules are inadequate, since crop phenology and observation conditions vary strongly across regions and seasons.
  In this study, we focus on a single, operationally relevant question: whether embeddings produced through geospatial foundation models are a viable basis for cleaning the reference data. We propose a practical, locality-aware, embedding-based anomaly (EBA) detection framework that operates on the embeddings of a pretrained Earth-observation encoder. We score each labelled sample against other samples of the same crop in the same area using a pretrained embedding, flag the ones that stand out, and test whether removing or down-weighting them before training yields a better model.
