  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代表性可能世界（RPW）研究主要关注单个节点特征（如度或三角形度），但许多挖掘任务（如链接预测）依赖于两个节点之间的共同邻居数量这一成对特征。现有方法无法直接高效地处理这类成对结构关系的保留需求，导致需要执行计算昂贵的枚举或采样过程。

Method: 1. 定义CRPW问题：寻找最能保留节点对之间共同邻居期望数量的可能世界，并证明该问题是NP-hard的。
2. 开发两阶段基础算法：首先快速初始化一个可能世界，然后迭代优化它。
3. 加速策略：用高效的整数计数策略替换昂贵的浮点评估，因为只需判断改进是否有益，无需计算精确幅度。
4. Beta自适应终止方法：自动在达到所需质量时停止优化，防止过度或不足执行。

Result: 在真实世界的不确定图上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的算法在各种挖掘任务中均有效。特别是在与共同邻居相关的任务中，该方法在所有对比方法中取得了最佳性能。

Conclusion: 通过将代表性可能世界的概念从节点级扩展到成对级，并引入高效的整数计数和自适应终止机制，本研究成功解决了在不确定的图中高效保留共同邻居统计信息的问题，为链接预测等任务提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: A representative possible world (RPW) is a deterministic graph derived from an uncertain graph $\mathcal{G}$ where a designated structural feature closely approximates its expected value in $\mathcal{G}$. Serving as a proxy for $\mathcal{G}$, the RPW allows conventional deterministic algorithms to be directly executed on it for mining tasks targeting this feature, thereby avoiding computationally expensive enumeration or sampling on $\mathcal{G}$. Existing studies on RPWs primarily focus on individual node features, e.g., degree or triangle degree. However, many mining tasks, such as link prediction, critically rely on the number of common neighbors between two nodes, which is a pairwise feature. To bridge this gap, we study the \underline{C}ommon-neighbor-count-based \underline{R}epresentative \underline{P}ossible \underline{W}orld (CRPW) problem, extending RPWs from preserving node-level statistics to preserving pairwise structural relationships. The problem seeks the possible world that best preserves the expected numbers of common neighbors between node pair, and we prove that is NP-hard. To address it, we develop a two-stage basic algorithm that quickly initializes a possible world and then refines it iteratively. We next accelerate the refinement by replacing its costly floating-point evaluation with an efficient integer counting strategy, as the refinement only requires determining whether a change is beneficial, rather than computing its exact magnitude. Moreover, we design a Beta-based adaptive termination method to automatically stop the refinement once the desired quality of the possible world is reached, preventing over- or under-execution. Extensive experiments on real-world uncertain graphs demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithms on diverse mining tasks. Especially on common-neighbor-related tasks, we achieve the best performance among all compared methods.

</details>


### [254] [ABISS: Evaluating Text-to-SQL Systems Through Agent Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23340)
*Giovanni Sullutrone,Luca Sala,Sania Aftar,Georgia Koutrika,Sonia Bergamaschi*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出ABISS基准，通过多智能体生成管道和动态交互模拟环境，解决Text-to-SQL在现实世界中处理模糊或不可回答问题时的不足。研究发现模型在子类别分类和澄清后SQL生成方面存在瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在精选的Text-to-SQL基准上表现优异，但在现实场景中，用户常提出模糊或无法回答的问题，而现有系统对此处理不佳。当前进展受到三个相互关联的差距阻碍：不完整的分类法、缺乏反映真实场景的现实基准生成方法，以及静态的用户交互模式。

Method: 1. 构建涵盖8类模糊及不可回答问题的统一分类法；2. 开发基于两阶段流程（自然语言问题生成 followed by SQL落地）及显式“类别一致性”验证的多智能体生成管道，利用本地开源模型委员会对来自任意数据库的问题进行验证；3. 建立ABISS（Ambiguity Benchmark using Interaction-Simulated Sessions），这是一个动态模拟环境，允许Text-to-SQL代理与风格感知的模拟用户在多轮对话中进行交互。

Result: 在ABISS-BIRD和ABISS-Spider上对八个开源模型的实验揭示了两个根本性瓶颈：一是子类别分类困难，模型能识别问题有问题但难以 pinpoint 具体子类别；二是澄清条件下的SQL生成失败，即使获得有用信息，模型在最后解决步骤仍常失败。提供真值类别可显著提升执行率和反馈，但在模糊问题执行率方面，即使使用Oracle类别标签也依然较低。

Conclusion: 现有Text-to-SQL系统在应对现实世界的模糊性和交互性时存在显著局限，特别是在精确分类和基于澄清信息的最终解析能力上。研究强调了从静态测试转向动态交互模拟评估的重要性，并开源了代码和数据以推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate high performance on curated Text-to-SQL benchmarks; nevertheless, real-world users frequently pose ambiguous or unanswerable questions that current systems handle poorly. Three interconnected gaps hinder progress: incomplete taxonomies, realistic benchmark generation for real-world settings, and static user interaction. We address all of the above issues through three contributions: (1) a unified taxonomy of 8 categories covering ambiguous and unanswerable questions; (2) a multi-agent generation pipeline with a two-stage process (NLQ generation followed by SQL grounding) and an explicit Category Conformance validation stage, producing questions from arbitrary databases validated by a council of local open-source models; and (3) ABISS (Ambiguity Benchmark using Interaction-Simulated Sessions), a dynamic simulation environment where Text-to-SQL agents interact with style-aware simulated users across multi-turn dialogues. Experiments with eight open-source models on ABISS-BIRD and ABISS-Spider reveal two fundamental bottlenecks. The first is subcategory classification: models detect that a question is problematic yet struggle to pinpoint the specific subcategory. The second is clarification-conditioned SQL generation: even after receiving useful user information, models often still fail in the final resolution step. Providing the ground truth category yields large gains in both execution and feedback across both datasets, yet ambiguous-question execution remains low even under oracle category labels. We release our code for data generation and benchmark on GitHub (https://github.com/giosullutrone/ABISS-Evaluating-Text-to-SQL-Systems-Through-Agent-Interaction).

</details>


### [255] [The Atoms of the Score: Record-Level versus In-Engine Composite Evaluation of Clinical Quality Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23619)
*Angelo Kastroulis*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Mercury 是一个专为CQL评估设计的数据库引擎，通过将CQL评估视为数据库问题而非内存解释，实现了高性能的患者级和群体级临床质量评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CQL引擎主要服务于决策支持（单患者）和质量测量（群体评分）。然而，复合分数本身并非最终产品，关键在于能够检查、归因和行动于构成该分数的个体判断。现有架构在聚合发生的位置上存在分歧：一种在引擎内部计算复合分数（无数据移动），另一种评估单个记录并在外部汇总，保留所有中间结果以便审查。

Method: 提出并评估了Mercury 2.0.1，这是一种基于第二种架构目的的CQL数据库引擎。其核心方法是将CQL评估建模为数据库问题：使用紧凑的二进制编码以患者为主键存储FHIR数据；利用从CQL检索中派生的索引进行过滤；采用规划器选择访问路径；将CQL作为查询语言。将其与目前最快的CQL评估器之一Blaze 1.10.1进行对比，使用Blaze发布的基准测试套件，在相同的AWS硬件上对包含11230万资源的10万患者Synthea语料库进行评估。

Result: 通过严格的基准测试比较了Mercury 2.0.1与Blaze 1.10.1的性能表现，验证了Mercury在处理大规模FHIR数据时的效率。

Conclusion: Mercury通过重新定义CQL评估为数据库查询问题，提供了一种能够保留中间结果且高效处理大规模患者数据的架构，优于传统的内存解释方法。

Abstract: Clinical Quality Language (CQL) engines serve two axes: decision support (evaluate one patient, now) and quality measurement (score a population). The composite score is rarely the end product, because the individual determinations behind it are what let a score be inspected, attributed, and acted on. Two architectures follow from where aggregation happens: one computes the composite inside the engine over the whole store (no data movement); the other evaluates individual records and lets the composite be totaled externally, keeping every intermediate available.
  Mercury is a purpose-built CQL database engine of the second kind. It treats CQL evaluation as a database problem -- FHIR stored in a compact binary encoding keyed patient-first, indexes derived from what CQL retrieves filter on, a planner selecting access paths, CQL as the query language -- rather than as in-memory interpretation over a generic FHIR store. We evaluate Mercury 2.0.1 against Blaze 1.10.1, among the fastest CQL evaluators, using Blaze's own published benchmark suite on identical AWS hardware over a 100,000-patient Synthea corpus (112.3M resources).

</details>


### [256] [Order in Desbordante: Techniques for Efficient Implementation of Order Dependency Discovery Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23632)
*Yakov Kuzin,Dmitriy Shcheka,Michael Polyntsov,Kirill Stupakov,Mikhail Firsov,George Chernishev*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本研究针对序依赖（OD）发现算法，通过C++重写FASTOD和ORDER算法并结合优化技术，在Desbordante工具中实现了最高10倍的性能提升和2.9倍的内存降低，推动了OD发现的工业应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OD发现方法仅关注算法层面，忽视了实现层面的计算密集型问题，限制了其在工业界的应用潜力。

Method: 使用C++重新实现FASTOD和ORDER两种针对不同公理化体系的OD发现算法，分析其性能瓶颈并提出多项优化技术，最终集成到高性能开源数据探查工具Desbordante中进行评估。

Result: 重写的算法版本性能提升了最高3倍；结合提出的优化技术后，性能提升最高达10倍；内存消耗降低了最高2.9倍。

Conclusion: 重视算法的工程实现与性能优化对于将序依赖发现从理论研究推向工业实际应用至关重要。

Abstract: Science-intensive data profiling focuses on discovery and validation of various patterns in datasets. This study considers discovery of one such pattern - order dependency (OD). Simply put, OD states that some list of columns is ordered according to another one. It is of use for database query optimization, data cleaning and deduplication, anomaly detection, and much more.
  Existing discovery methods have approached this problem solely from the algorithmic standpoint, without focusing on the implementation side. At the same time, this problem is very computationally intensive, and therefore this part should not be ignored, as it brings ODs closer to industrial use.
  In this paper, we study two algorithms for OD discovery which target different OD axiomatizations - FASTOD and ORDER. We start by reimplementing these algorithms in C++ in order to speed them up and lower their memory consumption. We then analyze their bottlenecks and propose several techniques which improve their performance even further.
  To perform evaluation, we have implemented these algorithms inside Desbordante - a science-intensive, high-performance, and open-source data profiling tool developed in C++. Experiments have demonstrated a performance improvement of up to 3x obtained by reimplemented versions, and, with the application of our techniques, up to 10x. Memory consumption has been lowered by up to 2.9x.

</details>


### [257] [Extending Desbordante with Probabilistic Functional Dependency Discovery Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23636)
*Ilia Barutkin,Maxim Fofanov,Sergey Belokonny,Vladislav Makeev,George Chernishev*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文针对数据清洗等场景中传统函数依赖（FD）对脏数据适应性差的问题，重点研究了概率函数依赖（pFD）。通过在高性能工具Desbordante中实现pFD发现算法，并与近似函数依赖（AFD）进行理论与实证对比，分析了pFD的优势、性能开销及两者间的可互换性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统函数依赖（FD）定义严格，难以适应现实世界中普遍存在的脏数据；虽然近似函数依赖（AFD）被广泛使用，但概率函数依赖（pFD）作为一种更灵活的替代方案研究较少，且尚未在主流高性能数据 profiling 工具中得到充分支持。

Method: 1. 理论分析：评估不同 pFD 与 AFD 的差异，找出 pFD 优于 AFD 的场景。
2. 系统实现：在 C++ 开源工具 Desbordante 中实现 pFD 发现算法。
3. 性能评估：测量并分析该算法的运行时间和内存消耗。
4. 对比实验：将实现的 pFD 算法与 AFD 发现算法进行对比，并探究两种算法输出结果的可互换性。

Result: 1. 明确了 pFD 相比 AFD 具有优势的具体案例。
2. 成功实现了高效的 pFD 发现算法并集成至 Desbordante 工具。
3. 提供了关于 pFD 算法运行效率和资源消耗的实证数据。
4. 验证了 AFD 与 pFD 算法输出结果之间是否存在直接转换或互用关系。

Conclusion: pFD 是处理脏数据的有效模式，本研究不仅填补了 pFD 在高性能工具中支持的空白，还通过对比分析揭示了 pFD 与 AFD 的适用边界及相互关系，为数据 profiling 任务提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Data profiling aims to extract complex patterns from data for further analysis and use that data in domains such as data cleaning, data deduplication, anomaly detection, and many more.
  Functional dependencies (FDs) are one of the most well-known patterns. However, they are poorly suited for these tasks, as real data is usually dirty, and the rigid definition of FDs does not allow algorithms to locate them. For this reason, there are several formulations aimed at relaxing FDs to support dirty data, with approximate functional dependency (AFD) being the most popular one. Another formulation is the Probabilistic Functional Dependency (pFD), which we aim to support inside Desbordante - a science-intensive, high-performance and open-source data profiling tool implemented in C++. However, pFDs are relatively poorly studied, compared to AFDs.
  In this paper we study pFDs, both analytically and empirically. We start by assessing how different pFDs and AFDs are by studying cases in which pFDs have an edge over AFDs. Then, we implement the algorithm for pFD discovery, as well as study its run time and memory consumption. We also compare it with an AFD discovery algorithm. Lastly, we study the output of both algorithms to learn whether or not it is possible to use AFD discovery algorithm to get pFDs and vice versa.

</details>


### [258] [Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23815)
*Hojae Son,Md Ashraful Islam,Huy Gia Cao,Hui Guan,Marco Serafini*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Kalypso提出了一种关系型LLM服务抽象，通过感知语义查询结构并利用KV缓存复用，显著提升了非结构化数据处理的执行效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语义查询处理系统采用以请求为中心的LLM服务， unaware of the query plan（不了解查询计划），导致大量性能机会未被利用。

Method: 引入“关系型LLM服务”抽象，使LLM服务感知语义查询结构；提出Kalypso系统，暴露语义查询计划API，并采用自适应、内存感知的调度算法，在GPU内存压力下管理KV缓存复用，平衡上游并行度、下游进度和GPU利用率。

Result: 在不同工作负载下，Kalypso相比基于请求中心的基线系统，查询完成时间最高加速4.57倍，证明了查询感知的LLM服务能显著提高语义查询执行的效率。

Conclusion: 将LLM服务与查询计划结合，通过管道化执行和KV缓存复用，能有效解决现有系统的性能瓶颈，为语义查询处理提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The key opportunity is pipelined execution across semantic operators: when intermediate tuples flow directly from one operator to the next, their KV-cache state can be reused instead of recomputed.
  We present Kalypso, a relational LLM serving system that exposes an API for semantic query plans and executes them using an adaptive, memory-aware scheduling algorithm. Kalypso addresses a new online scheduling problem in which pipelined operator execution is coupled with GPU memory pressure management to reuse KV-cache state in the serving engine before eviction. Its scheduler continuously adjusts memory allocations to balance upstream parallelism, downstream progress, and GPU utilization. Our evaluation shows that Kalypso improves query completion time over baselines using request-centric LLM serving, with speedups up to 4.57x across diverse workloads, demonstrating that query-aware LLM serving can substantially improve the efficiency of semantic query execution.

</details>


### [259] [Answering Conjunctive Queries with Aggregations under Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23881)
*Qichen Wang,Xiao Hu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文研究了在正交换半环上进行聚合时，连接查询（CQ）的动态可维护性。发现插入-only更新下可维护类从free-connex收缩为新的strong-connex类；提出了统一算法框架，实现了强连通查询在插入下的O(1)摊销维护和q-层次查询在任意更新下的O(1)维护（需特定半环条件），并给出了相应的下界证明，确立了基于查询结构和半环的二分法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代分析应用涉及多种聚合操作（如计数、SUM/COUNT、溯源等），这些均可建模为正交换半环上的连接查询评估。已知在布尔语义下CQ的可维护性类别已明确，但尚不清楚引入聚合是否会改变动态维护的复杂度边界及可维护的查询类别。

Method: 1. 理论分析：通过OuMv/OMv/k-clique等计算复杂性假设，推导聚合对动态维护复杂度的影响，区分任意更新和仅插入更新两种场景。2. 算法设计：将CROWN框架适配到注释关系（annotated relations），提出统一的维护算法。3. 复杂度证明：结合上界算法和下界归约，建立参数化的二分法。

Result: 1. 任意更新下：聚合不降低难度，维护难度至少与布尔半环相同。2. 仅插入更新下：可维护类边界退缩至“强连通”（strong-connex）类，满足 q-hierarchical ⊊ strong-connex ⊊ free-connex ⊊ acyclic。3. 对于携带合适单调序列的有序半环，非强连通的free-connex CQ在给定假设下无法在O(|D|^(1/2-ε))时间内维护。4. 提出的算法框架能在插入更新下以O(1)摊销时间维护所有强连通CQ；在任意更新下，若半环支持O(1)删除聚合，则能以O(1)摊销时间维护所有q-层次CQ。

Conclusion: 聚合确实改变了动态查询维护的理论边界，特别是在仅插入更新场景下显著缩小了高效可维护的查询类。研究建立了基于查询结构（如q-层次、强连通）和半环特性的精确二分法，不仅恢复了布尔情况下的经典结论，还量化了聚合带来的额外硬度，为现代分析型数据库系统的动态查询优化提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Dynamic query processing keeps query answers up to date during insertions and deletions. For conjunctive queries (CQs) under set semantics, the maintainable classes are known exactly: the $q$-hierarchical CQs under arbitrary updates, widening to the free-connex CQs under insertion-only updates. But modern analytics aggregates, including bag counting, SUM/COUNT, provenance, access control, and shortest paths---all captured by evaluating a CQ over a positive commutative semiring. We ask whether aggregation changes what can be maintained efficiently, and if so, when.
  Under arbitrary updates, it does not: maintenance is at least as hard as over the Boolean semiring. Under insertion-only updates, it does: the boundary retreats from free-connex to a new class we call strong-connex, with $q$-hierarchical $\subsetneq$ strong-connex $\subsetneq$ free-connex $\subsetneq$ acyclic. For every ordered semiring carrying a suitable monotone sequence (e.g., sum-product and tropical), no free-connex but non-strong-connex CQ is maintainable in $O(|D|^{1/2-ε})$ time under the OuMv and OMv conjectures. We further strengthen this lower bound into a family parameterized by the height and dimension of the query, under the combinatorial $k$-clique and generalized OuMv conjectures; these quantify how far the annotated hardness grows as the queries scale.
  On the algorithmic side, a single framework matches these boundaries by adapting CROWN to annotated relations. It maintains every strong-connex CQ in $O(1)$ amortized time under insertion-only updates, regardless of the underlying semiring. Moreover, under arbitrary updates, it maintains every $q$-hierarchical CQ in $O(1)$ amortized time if the semiring has $O(1)$-deletable aggregations. Together, the upper and lower bounds give query- and semiring-parameterized dichotomies that recover the Boolean picture and pinpoint the hardness aggregation adds.

</details>


### [260] [EviDC: A Violation-Guided Algorithm for Incremental Denial Constraint Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24021)
*Qian Zhou,Xixian Han,Xiaolong Wan*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出EviDC算法，通过DCTrie结构组织现有约束并利用违规路径指导证据扩展，有效减少动态数据集中增量发现拒绝约束时的中间证据量和运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态数据集中，新插入的数据可能使现有的拒绝约束（DCs）失效，需要更新约束集。现有增量DC发现方法因未利用现有DC的结构信息构建证据，导致产生大量中间证据，效率低下。

Method: 提出EviDC算法，将现有DC组织为前缀树（DCTrie），其中根到叶的路径代表潜在违规路径。在增量处理中，仅沿可达违规路径扩展证据，并尽早剪枝无关分支。

Result: 在真实和合成数据集上的评估表明，EviDC减少了中间证据量，提高了大多数场景下的运行时效率。随着插入率和数据集规模的增加，性能提升更加显著。

Conclusion: 基于违规路径引导的证据构建方法具有有效性和可扩展性，能显著提升动态环境下拒绝约束发现的效率。

Abstract: Denial Constraints (DCs) are an important class of integrity constraints and have been widely used in data quality management. In dynamic datasets, newly inserted tuples may invalidate existing DCs and require the constraint set to be updated. Existing incremental DC discovery methods still generate a large amount of intermediate evidence because they do not exploit the structural information of existing DCs during evidence construction. We propose EviDC, a violation-guided incremental DC discovery algorithm. EviDC organizes existing DCs into a prefix tree structure called DCTrie, in which each path from the root to a leaf represents a potential violation path. During incremental processing, evidence is expanded only along reachable violation paths, while irrelevant branches are pruned as early as possible. We evaluate EviDC on real-world and synthetic datasets. The results show that EviDC reduces intermediate evidence and improves runtime efficiency in most scenarios. The performance gain becomes more pronounced as the insertion ratio and dataset size increase, showing the effectiveness and scalability of violation-guided evidence construction.

</details>


### [261] [TEmBed-T: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Table-Level Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24130)
*Ayeen Poostforoushan,Liane Vogel,Carsten Binnig*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文通过扩展TEmBed测试平台，对表格级嵌入进行了系统性评估。研究发现没有单一模型能在所有任务中表现最优，表明仅靠检索任务无法全面衡量表格嵌入质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格级嵌入在表格检索、数据湖发现和表格分类等应用中至关重要，但目前缺乏对不同嵌入方法在各任务中表现的深入理解及系统性评估。

Method: 扩展了近期提出的TEmBed测试平台，将其覆盖范围从单一的检索任务扩展到多个互补的任务维度，以捕捉下游有效性所需的各种属性。

Result: 通过对TEmBed模型池的实证研究证实，没有任何单一模型在所有任务中都表现出色；表格级嵌入的质量不能简化为仅看检索效果。

Conclusion: 表格级嵌入的有效性需要多维度评估，单一任务（如检索）不足以全面反映嵌入模型的整体性能，需根据具体应用场景选择合适的模型。

Abstract: Tabular data is the dominant structured-data modality, and learning table representations has become a core research direction. Table-level embeddings in particular underpin a wide range of applications, including table retrieval, data lake discovery, and table classification. Despite their importance, there is still limited understanding of how different embedding approaches behave across tasks, making systematic evaluation and analysis essential. In this work, we introduce a systematic evaluation of table-level embeddings that captures several complementary properties required for downstream effectiveness. We realize this evaluation by extending TEmBed, a recently proposed testbed for tabular embeddings, whose table-level coverage is currently limited to a single retrieval task. An empirical study over the TEmBed model pool confirms that no single model excels across all tasks, demonstrating that table-level embedding quality cannot be reduced to retrieval alone.

</details>


### [262] [Domain-Specific Data Quality Analysis Using Technology-Independent Query Templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24151)
*Arno Kesper,Lukas Sebastian Hofmann,Markus Matoni,Gabriele Taentzer*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出QPM框架，通过模型驱动方法让领域专家无需技术背景即可独立定义数据质量分析模板，解决传统流程中因缺乏查询语言技能而依赖技术人员的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据质量分析通常依赖领域专家定义需求，但专家缺乏查询语言技能；而技术人员介入导致工作流资源密集且效率低下，阻碍了领域专家独立管理数据质量。

Method: 提出质量模式模型（QPM）框架，这是一种与特定数据库技术和应用领域无关的模型驱动方法，用于定义数据质量分析模板。并在XML、RDF和Neo4j三种数据库技术上进行了概念验证实现。

Result: 1. QPM的表达力匹配甚至超过常见的数据库查询语言；2. 在文化遗产领域的应用及领域专家的可用性评估表明，该工具使领域专家能够独立定义基于模板的质量分析，无需IT专家支持。

Conclusion: QPM框架有效降低了数据质量分析的门槛，实现了领域专家对数据质量的自主管理，提高了工作效率并减少了对专业技术人员的依赖。

Abstract: In an increasingly data-driven world, effectively working with data depends heavily on its quality. Quality analysis is a central aspect of data quality management. As data quality is typically domain- and context-specific, the definition of quality requirements is primarily the responsibility of domain experts. However, domain experts often lack the query language expertise needed to implement quality analyses. Therefore, the process of defining quality analyses results in a resource-intensive workflow that requires the involvement of technical experts, effectively excluding domain experts from independently managing data quality. To address this challenge, we present the Quality Pattern Model framework (QPM), a model-driven approach to define templates for data quality analyses that are independent of specific database technologies and application domains. QPM can eliminate the need for deep technical expertise and prevent the need for defining quality analyses several times for different database technologies. We present a proof-of-concept implementation of this approach for three database technologies: XML, RDF, and Neo4j. We evaluate the expressiveness of our approach, its applicability in the cultural heritage domain, and its usability by domain experts. For this purpose, we conducted a qualitative user study and empirically collected quality problems in a catalog. Our findings suggest that QPM matches and even exceeds the expressiveness of common database query languages. Furthermore, the results indicate that our tool enables domain experts to define template-based quality analyses independently, without requiring support of IT experts.

</details>


### [263] [Simple and Fast Algorithm for Graph-based Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (Full Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24173)
*Reon Uemura,Keito Kido,Daichi Amagata*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出一种新的算法，用于解决过滤近似最近邻搜索（Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search）问题，该问题结合了向量相似度和属性过滤，旨在提高处理任意查询向量和属性组合时的搜索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在电商等现实应用中，对象不仅包含高维向量，还包含类别、颜色、品牌等属性。用户需要既能指定查询向量又能指定特定属性值进行筛选的搜索功能。现有技术在处理任意属性和向量组合时存在搜索速度慢和难以应对复杂属性组合的问题。

Method: 提出一种新的算法来解决过滤近似最近邻搜索问题。该算法旨在克服现有技术无法高效接受预先未知的任意查询向量和属性值的局限性，特别是针对任意属性组合的处理难点。

Result: 通过广泛的实验验证了所提算法的效率，结果表明该算法在处理结合向量相似度和属性过滤的搜索任务时具有显著的性能优势。

Conclusion: 新提出的算法有效解决了过滤近似最近邻搜索中的效率挑战，特别是在处理动态且任意的查询条件和属性组合方面表现优异，为实际应用提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: It has been common to represent many objects as high-dimensional vectors due to the proliferation of machine learning-based embedding techniques. One of the most important functions for analyzing high-dimensional vectors is approximate nearest neighbor search, which, given a query vector, retrieves the vector that is approximately the most similar to the query vector. In many real-world applications, such as e-commerce, objects have not only vectors but also attributes, e.g., category, color, and brand, and they require a scenario where users can specify a query vector and a value for each attribute of interest. This problem, called filtered approximate nearest neighbor search, retrieves approximate nearest neighbors from a set of objects that have the specified attribute values. Efficiently solving this problem is challenging because it has to accept arbitrary query vectors and attribute values, which are not known in advance. Existing techniques suffer from slow search performance and difficulty in dealing with arbitrary combinations of attributes. This work overcomes these challenges and proposes a new algorithm for this problem. We conduct extensive experiments, and the results demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithm.

</details>


### [264] [Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24688)
*Zeyu Zhang,Xue Li,Iacer Calixto,Paul Groth,Sebastian Schelter*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 通过针对Qwen3家族的受控因子实验，揭示了模型变体对双编码器至关重要，交叉编码器具有一致优势但大模型可缩小差距，生成式匹配器在分布偏移下表现更佳，且大模型易依赖捷径学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决以往研究中混淆匹配器架构与模型骨干、变体及规模差异的问题，从而孤立并识别性能提升的真正来源。

Method: 基于Qwen3家族，进行涵盖三种匹配器架构、三种模型变体、三种模型规模及九个数据集的1,215次微调受控因子实验，并评估跨数据集迁移性和计算成本。

Result: 1. 模型变体对双编码器关键，嵌入导向变体提供更优初始化和表征几何；2. 交叉编码器因联合编码具有一致优势，但大模型可缩小此差距；3. 生成式匹配器并非普遍优于交叉编码器，其优势集中在分布偏移（如模式差异、跨数据集迁移）场景；4. 大模型更依赖捷径学习，未必表现更好。

Conclusion: 研究澄清了匹配器架构间性能差异的根本因素，主张未来研究应解耦架构选择与模型级因素，并显式评估分布偏移和跨数据集迁移性。

Abstract: Entity matching identifies records that refer to the same real-world entity. Language models can be adapted to this task through bi-encoder, cross-encoder, and generative matcher architectures. However, prior studies often conflate matcher architecture with differences in model backbone, model variant(reflecting different pretraining objectives), and model size, making it difficult to isolate the sources of performance gains. We address this issue through a controlled factorial study spanning three matcher architectures, three model variants and three model sizes from the Qwen3 family, and nine datasets, totaling 1,215 fine-tuning runs. We also evaluate cross-dataset transferability and computational cost.
  Our results show that model variant is critical for bi-encoders: embedding-oriented variants provide stronger initialization and more favorable representation geometry predictive of downstream matching performance. Cross-encoders retain a consistent advantage over bi-encoders because they jointly encode record pairs rather than representing each record independently, although larger models partially narrow this gap. Generative matchers do not universally outperform cross-encoders. Instead, their advantages concentrate under distribution shift, including subtle unseen differences in record schemas and cross-dataset transfer. We further find that larger models rely more heavily on shortcut learning and therefore do not necessarily perform better. These findings clarify the factors underlying performance differences across matcher architectures and motivate future research and benchmark designs that better disentangle architectural choices from model-level factors while explicitly evaluating distribution shift and cross-dataset transferability. We release our experimental results, code, training scripts, and evaluation data at https://github.com/Jantory/llm-trained-matcher.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [265] [Language-Routed RAG and Direct Option Scoring for Multilingual Financial QA: DS@GT at FinMMEval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22841)
*Justice Ayela,Kabir Sahni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DS@GT团队提出了一种针对FinMMEval 2026多语言金融考试问答任务的检索增强系统。该系统通过BGE-M3嵌入和FAISS索引实现语义检索，采用RADS评分策略（基于候选选项的对数概率而非自由文本生成），并结合加权 reciprocal rank fusion 优化低资源语言表现。模型选择根据语言路由：Qwen3-14B用于阿拉伯语、中文和印地语；Qwen2.5-14B用于英语；Llama-3.1-8B用于希腊语。实验发现思维链提示显著降低希腊语准确率，且开启默认思考模式导致阿拉伯语性能崩溃，表明多语言金融推理需语言感知的检索、模型路由及评分策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准NLP基准无法捕捉CFA、EFPA、CPA等金融认证考试所需的结构化领域推理能力，且在检索和表示基础设施薄弱的语言中这一挑战更为严峻。

Method: 构建基于LangGraph的检索增强流水线：1) 检测查询语言并从30,209条目的多语言知识库中检索相关示例（使用BGE-M3嵌入和FAISS）；2) 采用检索增强直接评分（RADS），通过读取候选选项字母的下一个token对数概率进行评分，而非生成自由格式输出；3) 对低资源语言融合单语和跨语言检索索引（加权互惠秩融合）；4) 根据实证消融实验结果进行语言路由模型选择（Qwen3-14B/Chinese/Hindi/Arabic, Qwen2.5-14B/English, Llama-3.1-8B/Greek）。

Result: 系统成功应对了多语言金融考试问答任务。关键发现包括：思维链提示使希腊语准确率从90.7%骤降至20.9%；启用Qwen3的默认思考模式使阿拉伯语RADS性能降至接近随机水平。

Conclusion: 有效的多语言金融推理需要结合语言感知的检索机制、针对性的模型路由策略以及谨慎设计的评分方法，以避免大模型在特定语言和推理模式下出现性能退化。

Abstract: We present DS@GT's submission to FinMMEval 2026 Task 1, a multilingual financial exam question answering benchmark spanning English, Spanish, Greek, Chinese, and Hindi. Financial certification exams such as the CFA, EFPA, and CPA demand structured domain reasoning that standard NLP benchmarks do not capture, and this challenge compounds across languages where retrieval and representation infrastructure is underdeveloped. We build a retrieval-augmented pipeline on LangGraph that detects query language and retrieves semantically relevant exemplars from a 30,209-entry multilingual knowledge base using BGE-M3 embeddings and FAISS indexing. The system then scores answers via Retrieval-Augmented Direct Scoring (RADS), reading next-token log-probabilities over candidate option letters rather than generating free-form output. For low-resource languages, we fuse per-language and cross-lingual retrieval indices using weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Model selection is language-routed: Qwen3-14B for Arabic, Chinese, and Hindi; Qwen2.5-14B for English; and Llama-3.1-8B for Greek, a routing derived from empirical ablations that reveal substantial language-asymmetric performance gaps. Notably, chain-of-thought prompting significantly degrades Greek accuracy (90.7% to 20.9%), and enabling Qwen3's default thinking mode collapses Arabic RADS performance to near-chance levels. Our results indicate that effective multilingual financial reasoning requires language-aware retrieval, model routing, and deliberate scoring strategy selection.

</details>


### [266] [Beyond Exact Match: How Evaluation Methodology Dominates Model Choice in LLM-Based Product Attribute Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22949)
*Ayush Dwivedi,Ashvi Soni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实证研究对比了四种提示策略在两个主流大语言模型上的表现，发现评估方法和数据质量对结果的影响远超模型选择和提示工程本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 practitioners 在不同模型、数据集和提示策略下报告的性能差异巨大问题，探究影响结构化产品属性提取性能的关键因素。

Method: 在MAVE基准上，对GPT-4o-mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash两种生产级LLM进行实证研究；比较zero-shot、few-shot、schema-guided和definition-augmented四种提示策略；评估6,400个属性级预测（精确与模糊匹配）；对ground truth标签进行严格的噪声审计；分解F1方差并执行配对置换检验。

Result: 评估方法论产生的方差是模型选择的约23倍、提示策略的5倍；MAVE基准存在23.2%的ground truth噪声率；协议间F1差距高度显著（p<0.0001），Cohen's kappa为0.769。

Conclusion: 在生产级属性提取管道中，评估方法论和数据质量对性能的影响主导于模型选择和提示工程。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a default choice for structured product attribute extraction in e-commerce pipelines, with practitioners reporting widely varying performance across models, datasets, and prompting strategies. This paper presents a controlled empirical study comparing four prompting strategies -- zero-shot, few-shot, schema-guided, and definition-augmented -- across two production-grade LLMs (GPT-4o-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash) on the MAVE benchmark. We evaluate 6,400 attribute-level predictions using both exact and fuzzy string matching, and conduct a rigorous noise audit of the ground truth labels. We formally decompose F1 variance across four experimental factors and find that evaluation methodology produces variance approximately 23 times larger than model choice and 5 times larger than prompting strategy choice. We further establish that the MAVE benchmark exhibits a 23.2% ground truth noise rate against modern LLM outputs. Paired permutation tests (B=10,000) confirm that the inter-protocol F1 gap is highly significant (p<0.0001) and Cohen's kappa of 0.769 between protocols indicates substantial agreement. We conclude that for production attribute extraction pipelines, evaluation methodology and data quality dominate the impact of model selection and prompt engineering.

</details>


### [267] [When Does Few-Shot Prompting Help? A Systematic Empirical Study of Shot-Count Effects Across Model Scale, Architecture, and Output Parsing Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22969)
*Ayush Dwivedi,Ashvi Soni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过对5种大语言模型在AG News数据集上不同少样本数量（0-8个示例）的受控研究，揭示了少样本提示效果与模型规模、架构及输出格式合规性之间存在复杂且非单调的关系，并发现了一种导致性能被严重低估的系统性解析伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管少样本提示（Few-shot prompting）是NLP中广泛采用的推理技术，但现有研究缺乏对示例数量如何与模型规模、架构及输出格式合规性相互作用从而影响分类性能的系统性调查。

Method: 对Gemini Flash Lite、GPT-4o-mini、Llama 3.1 8B、Llama 3.3 70B和Llama 4 Scout 17B这5个涵盖专有和开源系列的模型，在AG News四分类基准上进行6种少样本配置（k∈{0,1,2,3,5,8}）的实验。报告宏观平均F1分数、95%置信区间、置换检验p值和Cohen's d效应量，并诊断和修正了系统性的解析伪影。

Result: 发现四种截然不同的行为模式：(1)零样本已校准良好的模型增益微小且不显著；(2)零样本灾难性失败但在单示例下大幅恢复的模型；(3)零样本最优且随示例增加性能单调下降的模型；(4)呈现U型曲线的模型。此外，识别并修正了一个使Llama 3.3 70B性能人为降低高达206%的解析伪影。

Conclusion: 少样本数量与分类性能之间的关系既不是单调的，也不是普遍的，不能仅从模型规模来预测。这一研究为LLM评估实践提供了重要的方法论贡献。

Abstract: Few-shot prompting, the practice of prepending a small number of input-output demonstration pairs to a query before presenting it to a large language model (LLM), is among the most widely adopted inference-time techniques in NLP. Yet little systematic work investigates how shot count interacts with model scale, architecture, and output format compliance in determining classification performance. This paper presents a controlled study of five LLMs across six shot-count configurations (k in {0,1,2,3,5,8}) on the AG News four-class benchmark (n=200). Our models span proprietary and open-source families: Gemini Flash Lite, GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Llama 4 Scout 17B. We report macro-averaged F1 with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (B=10,000), permutation-test p-values, and Cohen's d effect sizes across all 30 configurations. Our findings reveal four qualitatively distinct behavioral regimes: (1) models already well-calibrated at zero-shot that show modest, statistically insignificant gains (Gemini, GPT-4o-mini); (2) models that undergo catastrophic zero-shot failure but recover dramatically with a single example (Llama 3.1 8B, d=10.98, p<0.0001); (3) models optimal at zero-shot that degrade monotonically with additional examples (Llama 4 Scout); and (4) models exhibiting a U-shaped curve (Llama 3.3 70B: 0-shot F1=0.907, 2-shot F1=0.635, 5-shot F1=0.785 with parser corrected). We additionally identify, diagnose, and correct a systematic parsing artifact that artificially deflated Llama 3.3 70B performance by up to 206%, constituting a methodological contribution to LLM evaluation practice. Our results demonstrate that the relationship between shot count and classification performance is not monotonic, not universal, and not predictable from model scale alone.

</details>


### [268] [VecTree-RAG: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework Combining Vector and Tree Retrieval for Efficiency and Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23006)
*Xinyan Zhong,Yuwei Shi,Yuqi Wei,Chen Shen,Tianhang Zhou,Zhenghao Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出VecTree-RAG框架，结合向量搜索和树遍历解决科学问答中的文献定位与证据检索问题，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索增强生成（RAG）通过固定长度段落的相似度搜索处理科学问答，导致文档结构扁平化，割裂了科学主张与其方法论及论证背景的关联。

Method: VecTree-RAG是一个智能体框架：利用向量搜索对文档和章节表示进行全局排序，并通过推理引导的源验证章节树遍历来局部化证据；全文保留在页面存储中，仅在结构定位后逐步暴露。

Result: 在QASPER、LitQA2和MOSAIC三个基准上，VecTree-RAG的得分均高于Dense RAG、RAPTOR等基线模型；在QASPER上证据页面精度显著领先（0.274 vs 0.046-0.071）；消融实验显示该架构比无树导航或无向量路由的变体消耗更少的推理token。

Conclusion: 向量检索缩小了语料库级搜索空间，树导航将阅读集中在结构相关的证据上；尽管多轮推理成本较高，但VecTree-RAG为科学文献问答提供了一种结构感知且可追溯的架构。

Abstract: Scientific question answering requires a retrieval system to solve two distinct problems: identifying which papers are relevant and locating the supporting evidence within those papers. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation typically addresses both through similarity search over fixed-length passages, flattening document structure and separating scientific claims from their methodological and argumentative context. We present VecTree-RAG, an agentic framework that assigns these tasks to complementary retrieval mechanisms. Vector search ranks compact document and section representations across the corpus, whereas reasoning-guided traversal of source-verified section trees localizes evidence within shortlisted papers. Full text is retained in a page store and exposed progressively only after structural localization. We evaluate VecTree-RAG on 300 QASPER questions, an open-access subset of 54 LitQA2 questions, and 49 multi-document MOSAIC questions. Compared with Dense RAG, reranked Dense RAG, RAPTOR, and Search-o1, VecTree-RAG obtained the highest observed answer score on all three benchmarks, reaching 0.800 LLM-judge correctness on QASPER, 0.925 accuracy on LitQA2, and a 0.547 composite score on MOSAIC. On QASPER, its evidence-page precision was 0.274, compared with 0.046--0.071 for the baselines. LitQA2 ablations further showed that the complete vector--tree architecture required fewer inference tokens than variants without tree navigation or corpus-level vector routing. These results indicate that vector retrieval narrows the corpus-level search space and tree navigation concentrates reading on structurally relevant evidence. Although multi-turn inference remains more expensive than single-call retrieval, VecTree-RAG provides a structure-aware and traceable architecture for scientific literature question answering.

</details>


### [269] [EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23038)
*Xiaodong Liu,Congfei Zhang,Hsiang-wei Chao,Siman Wang,Tong Zhao,Xiao Bai,Vincent Zhang,Jingxiao Ma,Zhe Liu,Wenfeng Zhuo,Zichu Li,Jitin Krishnan,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出EGR框架，利用单一共享LLM在统一嵌入空间中联合学习物品和用户表示，通过密集向量索引和对比训练解决生成式检索在推荐系统中的对齐难题，显著提升线上转化率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索方法存在实际复杂性：Semantic-ID依赖量化、可变词汇表和词到物品的映射；基于嵌入的方法将物品编码器与查询生成器分开训练，限制了用户-物品对齐效果。

Method: 提出EGR（Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval）框架，使用单个共享大语言模型（LLM）从物品元数据中学习物品表示，从交互历史中学习用户表示，使二者处于同一嵌入空间。物品直接作为密集向量索引，用户历史编码为密集检索查询，并通过联合对比训练实现相关物品分组及查询与目标物品的对齐。

Result: 在Amazon Reviews上优于基线模型；在Snap DPA数据集上随数据规模扩展能力强，能处理冷启动物品，且受益于多模态输入；在生产环境中部署后，转化率提升2.91%。

Conclusion: EGR简化了系统架构，同时提高了检索质量和广告表现，证明了端到端嵌入原生生成式检索在大规模推荐和广告系统中的有效性。

Abstract: Generative retrieval is increasingly popular in large-scale recommendation and advertising systems, yet current methods introduce practical complications. Semantic-ID methods rely on quantization, mutable identifier vocabularies, and token-to-item grounding; embedding-based pipelines train the item encoder separately from the query generator, which limits user-item alignment. We propose EGR, an Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval framework for recommendation and advertising. EGR uses a single shared LLM to learn item representations from item metadata and user representations from interaction histories in one embedding space. Items are indexed directly as dense vectors, and user histories are encoded as dense retrieval queries. Joint contrastive training groups related items and aligns queries with their target items. We evaluate EGR on public benchmarks, industrial data, and live deployment. EGR outperforms published baselines on Amazon Reviews; on Snap DPA, it scales with data, handles cold-start items, and benefits from multimodal input. In production, EGR delivers a +2.91% conversion-rate lift, simplifying system design while improving retrieval quality and ad performance.

</details>


### [270] [SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23121)
*Congfei Zhang,Jingxiao Ma,Xiaodong Liu,Hsiang-wei Chao,Siman Wang,Ge Liu,Shantanu Aggarwal,Vincent Zhang,Meghana Missula,Rachel Liao,Zichu Li,Xiao Bai,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Zhe Liu,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SMART框架，结合规则查询与LLM生成查询，通过轻量级质量门控机制，以90%的LLM成本降低实现27.6%的广告转化率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态产品广告（DPA）需在大规模商品目录中平衡再营销（Retargeting）和探索新兴趣（Prospecting）。传统嵌入模型语义能力弱，而直接部署大语言模型（LLM）成本高且存在词汇不匹配问题。

Method: 提出SMART（语义感知自适应检索）方法：1. 利用BM25索引处理基于规则的查询以优化再营销；2. 利用密集ANN索引处理LLM生成的查询以优化探索；3. 设计轻量级质量门控，仅将约10%存在覆盖缺口的用户路由至LLM路径，其余使用低成本关键词结果。

Result: 离线评估显示该方法在保持竞争性再营销性能的同时，捕获了大部分语义探索的收益，并将LLM推理成本降低90%。Snap平台为期2周的在线A/B测试表明，相比强嵌入基线，广告转化率提升+27.6%。

Conclusion: 通过分解检索任务并自适应路由，SMART有效解决了LLM在大规模广告检索中的成本与效果平衡问题，显著提升了业务指标。

Abstract: Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) require retrieving relevant items from multi-million product catalogs, balancing two competing objectives: retargeting (re-surfacing known interests) and prospecting (discovering new categories). While Large Language Models (LLMs) capture semantic intent better than traditional embedding models, deploying them at scale introduces prohibitive inference costs and lexical mismatch issues. Through controlled experiments on millions of users, we demonstrate a critical retrieval decomposition: rule-generated queries excel at retargeting on a lexical BM25 index, while LLM-generated queries excel at prospecting on a dense ANN index. Building on this, we propose SMART (SeMantic-aware Adaptive ReTrieval). To manage costs, a lightweight quality gate identifies coverage gaps in initial keyword results, adaptively routing only the ~10% of users who benefit from semantic prospecting to the LLM path. Offline evaluation demonstrates that this gated approach captures the bulk of semantic prospecting gains in Relevance Score while maintaining competitive re-targeting performance at a 90% reduction in LLM costs. Finally, in a 2-week online A/B test at Snap, SMART improved the ad conversion rate by +27.6% over a strong embedding-based baseline.

</details>


### [271] [Statistically Supported LLM Ingredient and Recipe Data Collection in Computational Nutrition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23273)
*James Izzard,Hassan Eshkiki,Fabio Caraffini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出了一种受控的LLM流水线，通过统计估计、不变性检查和网络回退机制，解决营养数据库中成分数据不完整和不一致的问题，显著提高了数据准确性并降低了误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的营养数据库不完整、不一致且主要为人类参考设计而非自动化推理；单次LLM输出不可靠，可能引入静默错误，影响下游计算。

Method: 构建了一个质量控制的LLM流水线：1) 对重复LLM查询结果视为样本分布，应用稳健点估计器和归一化置信度评分；2) 设置不变性守卫层确保营养和逻辑自洽；3) 使用线性规划修复轻微数值不一致，重大违规则通过网页证据修复或人工审核。

Result: 在30种成分的参考集上，该流水线实现了98.4%的营养标志精确匹配率，将营养比率的中位绝对百分比误差从基线的31.9%降低至10.1%（减少21.8个百分点），每个成分API成本约1美元。

Conclusion: LLM辅助的数据库构建应被视为一种可控的数据工程工作流，通过将不确定性纳入操作层面而非简单丢弃，实现高质量、自动化的成分数据获取。

Abstract: Computational nutrition needs precise ingredient data, but current databases are incomplete, inconsistent, and built for human reference rather than automated reasoning. LLMs could help fill these gaps, but single-pass outputs are unreliable and can introduce silent errors into downstream computation. We present a quality-controlled LLM pipeline for ingredient data acquisition that combines robust statistical estimation, domain-specific invariant checks, and a web-fetch fallback. An illustrative Heap's Law fit to 233 recipes suggests that unique-ingredient growth is sub-linear and front-loaded: the projected ratio of unique ingredients to recipes falls from 1.74 at 100 recipes to 0.19 at 5,000. For each ingredient attribute, repeated LLM queries are treated as samples from a model-induced answer distribution, and we apply robust point estimators and normalised confidence scores across numerical, Boolean, multiple-choice, open categorical, and optional integer types. An invariant guard layer enforces nutritional and logical self-consistency within each ingredient record. Minor numeric inconsistencies are reconciled via a linear program that minimises worst-case percentage deviation while preserving semantic zeros, and major violations are escalated to web-evidence-grounded repair, then human review only if that fails. On a curated 30-ingredient reference set, the pipeline achieves 98.4% exact match on nutrient flags and cuts median absolute percentage error on nutrient ratios from 31.9% for the median-aggregated baseline to 10.1%, a reduction of 21.8 percentage points, at an API cost of about $1 per ingredient. This frames LLM-assisted database construction as a controlled data-engineering workflow that makes uncertainty operational rather than discarding it.

</details>


### [272] [Choosing a Text Embedding Model: A Practical Benchmarking and Decision Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23507)
*Madhav S Baidya*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本报告提出一个基于证据的嵌入模型选择框架，通过基准测试比较商业API模型T3EM与开源替代方案在英语检索任务中的表现，并结合MTEB多任务评估，从索引、搜索到分块策略的全链路视角提供针对任务、延迟、成本和部署约束的实用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在选择文本嵌入模型时，尽管这是构建检索或搜索系统中最重要且常被忽视的决策之一，但排行榜上的最佳模型往往并非实际部署中的最佳选择。

Method: 开展基准测试研究，评估商业API嵌入模型T3EM与广泛的开源替代方案在英语检索任务中的表现，并将其置于涵盖分类、聚类、语义相似度、重排序、对分类、语料库挖掘和摘要的大规模文本嵌入基准（MTEB）背景下进行分析；同时追踪从嵌入生成、大规模索引与搜索到文档分块策略影响检索质量的完整路径。

Result: 超越了单纯的基准分数，揭示了嵌入模型选择如何作为整个检索管道中的一个环节与其他因素相互作用，并得出了一套综合的实用建议。

Conclusion: 提供了根据具体任务需求、延迟要求、成本限制及部署约束来理性选择嵌入模型的实践指南，强调应将模型选择视为完整检索管道的一部分而非孤立决策。

Abstract: Choosing the right text embedding model is one of the most consequential -- and most frequently under-examined -- decisions in building a retrieval or search system, yet the model that tops a leaderboard is rarely the best choice for a given deployment. This report develops a practical, evidence-based framework for embedding model selection, built on a benchmarking study that evaluates T3EM (Text 3 Embedding Model), a commercial API-based embedding model, against a broad set of open-source alternatives on English-language retrieval tasks, and situates these findings within the wider Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) landscape spanning classification, clustering, semantic similarity, reranking, pair classification, bitext mining, and summarization. Beyond raw benchmark scores, the report traces the full path from embedding model to retrieved result -- how embeddings are produced, how they are indexed and searched at scale, and how document chunking strategy shapes retrieval quality -- so that model choice can be reasoned about as one decision within a complete retrieval pipeline rather than in isolation. The result is a consolidated set of practical recommendations for selecting an embedding model according to task, latency, cost, and deployment constraints.

</details>


### [273] [Towards a Relevance Posterior in Neural Information Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23561)
*Andrew Parry,Emmanouil Georgios Lionis,Debasis Ganguly,Sean MacAvaney*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出将现代信息检索系统重新理解为近似后验推断过程，通过解耦查询依赖似然和查询独立先验，实现计算向离线转移并提升检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流信息检索系统将相关性视为推理时的查询条件得分，这种单一视角在神经排序模型计算成本增加及多阶段检索流程扩展的背景下日益局限，且忽视了文档和查询先验的历史价值。

Method: 扩展经典概率检索形式化方法至当代学习系统，引入显式的似然-先验分解机制；利用学习到的查询独立文档效用（先验）与现有排序器进行分数融合，以补充现有排名模型。

Result: 实验表明，该方法仅通过最小化的查询时间计算（分数融合）即可提升有效性：在第一阶段检索中，TREC DL-2019和DL-2020的nDCG@10分别提升高达0.046和0.029；在下游重排序中，对LLM重排序器RankZephyr的提升最大，TREC DL-2020上nDCG@10提升达0.054。

Conclusion: 显式的似然-先验分解揭示了将计算移至离线的新机会，并分离了文档级与交互级信念；该框架为设计明确分配离线先验与在线交互建模容量的检索系统提供了新方向。

Abstract: Modern information retrieval systems typically operationalise relevance as a query-conditional score computed at inference time. This design choice has become dominant such that alternative decompositions of relevance are rarely discussed, despite the long history of document and query priors in probabilistic retrieval and large-scale search. As neural ranking models grow more computationally expensive and retrieval pipelines expand to include multi-stage ranking, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation, this monolithic view of query-time scoring becomes increasingly limiting. We argue that modern information access systems are more naturally understood as performing approximate posterior inference, in which relevance is refined through a staged combination of query-dependent likelihoods and query-independent priors. We extend classical probabilistic retrieval formalisms to contemporary learned systems and show how explicit likelihood-prior decomposition exposes new opportunities to shift computation offline while disentangling document-level and interaction-level beliefs. We present empirical evidence that incorporating query-independent document utility can complement existing rankers and improve effectiveness with minimal query-time computation (solely score fusion). Concretely, a learned prior improves first-stage retrieval through rank fusion (up to 0.046 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2019 and 0.029 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020) and also improves downstream re-ranking, with the largest gains observed for the LLM re-ranker RankZephyr (up to 0.054 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020). Finally, we discuss how this decomposition connects to broader information access and outline research directions for designing retrieval systems that explicitly allocate modelling capacity between offline priors and online interaction.

</details>


### [274] [Melo: A Production LLM-Powered Music Recommendation Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23718)
*Shijia Wang,Da Guo,Qiang Xiao,Fanghui Bi,Weisheng Li,Dongjing Wang,Chuanjiang Luo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了部署在网易云音乐上的LLM驱动推荐代理Melo。针对工业级应用中实体幻觉和长尾退化两大痛点，提出了推理时实体 grounding 和反思性重试机制。A/B测试显示播放列表留存率提升2个百分点，核心参与度提升超1分钟；离线实验验证了错误识别率的显著降低及有效的流程恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在工业规模下，LLM音乐推荐系统的瓶颈不在于模型的智能程度，而在于系统检测和从模型错误中恢复的能力。主要面临两个生产故障模式：一是实体幻觉（Agent基于直播目录或用户行为索引不支持的解释做出承诺），二是长尾退化（过度约束的请求退化为通用的热门推荐）。

Method: 构建了一个由提示词和状态机驱动的确定性五节点状态图架构，而非微调控制器。具体采用两种互补机制：1. 推理时实体接地（Inference-time entity grounding）：复用生产搜索索引作为验证原语，在下行传播前对实体决策进行 gate 控制；2. 反思性重试（Reflective retry）：将断裂工具链中的失败原因言语化并反馈至下一步规划，使系统能放松或修正约束而非盲目回退。

Result: 线上A/B测试显示：主要播放列表留存指标提升超过2个百分点（pp），核心播放列表参与度指标提升超过1分钟。离线消融实验显示：三层接地栈使评估集上的实体误识率降低了7.8 pp；触发会话分析显示反思性重试在5.8%的会话中触发，其中59%实现了进程级恢复。

Conclusion: 大规模LLM音乐推荐的进步不仅依赖于模型本身，同样依赖于能够捕获和纠正模型错误的、可命名的、可剥离的运行时机制（runtime machinery）。这是一个值得社区进一步验证的假设。

Abstract: We describe Melo, an LLM-powered music recommendation agent deployed on NetEase Cloud Music. Melo is structured as a deterministic five-node state graph over heterogeneous tools, with a prompt- and state-machine-driven orchestration policy rather than a fine-tuned controller. At industrial scale, the bottleneck is not how smart the brain is but how the system detects and recovers from the mistakes that brain makes. Two production failure modes drove the design: entity hallucination, where the agent commits to interpretations unsupported by the live catalog or user-behavior index, and long-tail degradation, where over-constrained requests collapse to generic popular fallbacks. We address them with two complementary mechanisms. Inference-time entity grounding repurposes the production search index as a verification primitive that gates entity decisions before they propagate downstream. Reflective retry verbalizes failure reasons from a broken tool chain and feeds them into the next planning step, so the system can relax or revise constraints rather than fall back blindly. A one-month online A/B test across NetEase Cloud Music's playlist surfaces reports an over 2 pp lift in a primary playlist retention metric and a lift of over one minute in a core playlist engagement metric. Offline ablation isolates a 7.8 pp reduction in entity misidentification from the three-layer grounding stack on our evaluation set, and a triggered-session analysis on our evaluation set shows reflective retry firing on 5.8% of sessions with 59% process-level recovery. Our deployment experience suggests that progress on LLM-powered music recommendation at this scale depends as much on the named, ablatable runtime machinery that catches and corrects the brain's mistakes as on the brain itself: a hypothesis we offer for the community to test.

</details>


### [275] [Breaking the Loop: An Empirical Comparison of Strategies for Novelty and Freshness in YouTube Music](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23749)
*Srivaths Ranganathan,Zihuan Diao,Bernardo Cunha,Joshua L. Moore,Robin Dumas,Murat Goksedef,Yanwei Song,Mukai Lu,Gergo Varady,Tracy Pesin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在YouTube Music上进行的A/B测试表明，针对持续训练推荐系统的去偏干预中，服务层干预易被学习循环抵消；架构去偏虽提升多样性但未促进发现且存在集成成本；而基于SNGP的不确定性驱动探索能显著提升新歌曝光，但需权衡参与度与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决音乐推荐系统中因反馈循环导致的“新发布内容”（时效性）和“未收听目录项”（新颖性）被抑制的问题，并探究学术界提出的多种去偏干预在实际连续摄入内容的工业系统中的应用效果及隐藏成本。

Method: 在YouTube Music首页进行离线策略在线A/B测试，评估六个单一干预措施及其组合实验。这些干预措施覆盖四个概念层：服务层、训练层、架构层和探索层，仅修改排序模型或服务层，固定候选生成及其他上游组件。

Result: 1. 服务层干预的效果会被持续训练的学习循环中和；2. 架构去偏降低了流行度主导并提升了多样性，但未创造真正的发现，且伴有隐藏的集成成本；3. 使用谱归一化神经高斯过程（SNGP）头的不确定性驱动探索产生了最大的新歌提升，但伴随着可测量的参与度或多样性权衡。

Conclusion: 实际工业系统中应用学术去偏方法面临独特挑战，不同干预层级具有不同的效果与隐藏成本。建议根据具体目标（如追求新歌曝光还是多样性）选择合适的干预层级，并充分考量其带来的副作用及集成复杂度。

Abstract: Continuously trained ranking models in music recommenders fall into feedback loops where previously consumed items dominate recommendations. This suppresses two distinct content classes: new releases (temporal freshness) and unlistened catalog items (novelty). Industry practitioners have a wide menu of interventions available, ranging from serving-time heuristics, training-data reweighting, architectural debiasing, to uncertainty-driven exploration, each of which are well understood in academic settings. But live systems offer challenges with continuously ingested content, interconnected components, and practical limitations that counteract the findings from academic research.
  We report results from off-policy online A/B tests for six interventions and a combination experiment across four conceptual layers (serving, training, architecture, exploration) on the YouTube Music homepage. All interventions modify the ranking model or the serving layer that consumes its scores; candidate generation and other upstream components are held fixed. We discuss key takeaways from our results: first, serving-time interventions on continuously trained systems are neutralized by the learning loop. Second, architectural debiasing reduces popularity dominance and improves diversity but does not create discovery, while carrying hidden integration costs. Finally, uncertainty-driven exploration interventions with a Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Process (SNGP) head produce the largest new-release lift, though they come with a measurable engagement or diversity tradeoff. We close with recommendations on which layer to intervene at, and the hidden costs of each choice.

</details>


### [276] [Escaping the Euclidean Void: Manifold-Informed Flow Matching for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23762)
*Dengzhao Fang,Jingtong Gao,Yu Li,Xiangyu Zhao,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出MIRAGE框架，利用物品共现图作为语义流形代理，修正连续推荐中嵌入空间的欧几里得空洞问题，实现高效准确的序列推荐生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐器优化观测到的用户-物品关系，而连续生成式推荐通过流匹配将初始噪声塑造为目标物品表示。然而，物品目录是离散且稀疏支持的，即使直线路径也会穿过缺乏有效物品语义证据的连续区域（即“欧几里得空洞”），导致模型在稀疏目标上表现不佳。

Method: 提出MIRAGE（Manifold-Informed Rectification framework for Accelerated Generation of Embeddings in sequential recommendation）框架。该方法利用物品共现图作为潜在语义流形的代理，在训练阶段将插值路径状态与局部锚点对齐，重新组织嵌入空间以将轨迹锚定在有效的物品支持范围内。该框架保持原始概率路径不变，仅在训练时使用图信息，从而支持准确且高效的单步推理。

Result: 在四个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，MIRAGE一致优于最先进的方法，在稀疏观测目标上有效提升性能，同时保持稳健的整体准确性。

Conclusion: MIRAGE通过纠正嵌入几何结构中的欧几里得空洞问题，解决了连续生成式推荐中因物品离散性和稀疏性导致的语义断层问题，显著提升了序列推荐的准确性和效率。

Abstract: Conventional recommenders capture users' preferences by optimizing observed user-item relations, whereas continuous generative recommendation additionally learns the trajectory of synthesizing a target item. Flow matching drives this process by gradually shaping initial noise into a definitive next-item representation through intermediate states in a continuous embedding space. However, item catalogs are discrete and sparsely supported, meaning even a straight Euclidean path can cross continuous regions that contain little evidence of valid item semantics. Formalizing this failure as the Euclidean void, we propose MIRAGE, a Manifold-Informed Rectification framework for Accelerated Generation of Embeddings in sequential recommendation, which rectifies the learned embedding geometry around an unchanged straight probability path. By leveraging an item co-occurrence graph as a proxy for the underlying semantic manifold, MIRAGE aligns interpolated path states with local anchors, reorganizing the embedding space to ground the trajectory in valid item support. MIRAGE retains the original probability path and uses the graph only during training, thereby enabling accurate and efficient one-step inference. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets reveal that MIRAGE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, effectively boosting performance on sparsely observed targets while achieving robust overall accuracy. Our code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [277] [ClawRec: A Claw-Native Recommender System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23779)
*Chenghao Wu,Kesha Ou,Xiaolei Wang,Bowen Zheng,Bingqian Li,Enze Liu,Wayne Xin Zhao,Weitao Li,Long Zhang,Sheng Chen,Ji-Rong Wen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出ClawRec，一种原生支持跨平台、多源信息的推荐系统范式。通过维护带证据链接的时序用户状态，根据边际效用选择非冗余推荐列表，并在自建基准ClawRec-SimBench上显著超越基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统局限于单平台边界，仅能观察局部交互并基于孤立候选集进行排序，无法适应用户在多信息源间进行搜索、消费和比较的真实复杂任务场景。

Method: 提出Claw-native推荐系统范式及具体模型ClawRec。核心机制包括：1）构建与跨平台行为关联的、具有时序结构的证据链接用户状态；2）围绕功能性的“来源角色”组织检索；3）依据候选项目的边际效用进行选择，生成对齐用户当前任务且非冗余的统一推荐列表。同时构建了基于具体生活事件序列的评估基准ClawRec-SimBench。

Result: 在ClawRec-SimBench基准测试中，ClawRec表现优于最强基线模型，NDCG@20达到0.6134（提升0.1126），Hit@20达到0.6944（提升0.0854）。此外，该方法还提升了用户状态的质量和时序一致性。

Conclusion: ClawRec成功实现了从“以平台为中心”到“以用户为中心”的推荐范式转变，证明了在跨平台语境下提供统一、互补推荐的有效性，为下一代个人代理驱动的推荐系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Recommender systems have become integral to navigating the modern digital ecosystem. Yet most deployed systems remain confined within single-platform boundaries, observing localized interaction traces and ranking items from isolated candidate spaces. This design is poorly suited to real-world tasks that unfold through searches, content consumption, and comparisons across multiple information sources. Claw-style personal agents, with persistent access to authorized cross-platform context, create an opportunity for recommendation to operate around the user rather than any single platform. In this paper, we introduce Claw-native recommender systems, a new paradigm that moves beyond platform-local ranking to produce unified, complementary recommendation slates spanning diverse sources and content forms. To instantiate this paradigm, we present ClawRec, the first recommender system designed to operate natively in this environment. ClawRec maintains an evidence-linked, temporally structured user state that connects cross-platform behaviors with cross-source recommendations. It organizes retrieval around functional source roles and selects candidates according to their marginal utility, producing non-redundant slates aligned with the user's active task. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce ClawRec-SimBench, a benchmark constructed from sequences of concrete life events and cross-platform behavior trajectories. Experiments show that ClawRec outperforms the strongest baselines, achieving an NDCG@20 of 0.6134 (+0.1126) and a Hit@20 of 0.6944 (+0.0854), while also improving user state quality and temporal alignment. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/ClawRec.

</details>


### [278] [Who Gets Named: Citation Type Predicts Individual Naming by Grounded Language Models, and a Roster Instrument Captures 0.5% of It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23893)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究通过2400次API调用，评估了四大AI模型在推荐个人专业人士时的表现。结果显示，模型倾向于推荐个人（25.8%），且受行业类别和语言影响显著：房地产和汽车行业推荐率最高，英语提示比本地语言更易触发个人推荐。Grok推荐率最高（38.0%），Gemini最低（9.3%）。研究指出，基于固定名册的测量方法仅捕捉到极小部分（0.47%）的AI输出，无法全面反映AI可见性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于AI品牌可见性的研究主要关注模型是否推荐公司及其与声誉的关系。然而，在买家选择具体个人的场景中（如专业服务、房地产等），现有研究缺乏对“个体专业人士”被AI推荐的深入分析。本研究旨在填补这一空白，从更细粒度的层面探讨AI如何识别和推荐个人。

Method: 1. **实验设计**：在2026年7月24日的两小时内，向四个主流AI模型（GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Perplexity Sonar Pro, Grok 4.5）发起2,400次API调用。
2. **变量控制**：涵盖五个迭代轮次、四个欧洲市场和五种查询语言；使用120个具有购买意图的提示词。
3. **数据编码**：采用规则级联编码系统判断回复中是否提及个体专业人士，排除同名美国城市干扰，确保高精度（96.9%）。
4. **统计校正**：考虑提示内聚类效应（组内相关系数0.258），调整有效样本量为407。
5. **对比验证**：构建包含939人的LinkedIn公开名册，与AI输出的姓名进行匹配，以评估传统名册方法的局限性。

Result: 1. **总体表现**：AI模型在25.8%的回复中提及个体专业人士。
2. **行业差异显著**：房地产行业（35.4%）和汽车经销商（32.9%）的个人推荐率远高于保险业（9.1%）（p < 0.001）。
3. **模型差异巨大**：不同模型间存在四倍差距，Grok最高（38.0%），Gemini最低（9.3%）。
4. **引用行为特征**：提及个体的回复更常引用该个人的官网（+2.6个百分点）和行业门户（+4.3个百分点），而非企业自有页面。
5. **语言效应**：英语提示提及个人的概率是本地语言的2.3倍左右（OR=3.14），虽未达严格统计显著性（p=0.074），但趋势明确。
6. **名册匹配率低**：基于LinkedIn的名册仅匹配到0.47%的AI输出中的姓名，表明名册法严重低估并偏差化了AI可见性。

Conclusion: AI在推荐个人专业人士方面表现出高度的情境依赖性，主要受行业类别和输入语言驱动。现有基于静态名册（如LinkedIn列表）的测量方法存在严重缺陷，仅能捕捉到AI生成内容的极小且无代表性的部分。因此，评估AI可见性需超越简单的实体匹配，采用更动态、上下文感知的分析方法。

Abstract: Prior work on AI brand visibility measures the firm: does a model recommend a company, and does that track its reputation. This study asks the question one level down, in categories where the buyer picks a person. It issued 2,400 grounded API calls in one two-hour window on 24 July 2026: 120 buyer-intent prompts, four models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Perplexity Sonar Pro, Grok 4.5), five iterations each, four European markets and five query languages. Every response was coded for whether it named an individual professional, by a rule cascade that never consults a roster and that drops detections resolving to a same-named American city (precision 96.9%, recall 61.7%, so every rate below is a lower bound). All inference corrects for clustering within prompt: intraclass correlation 0.258, effective n 407 against a nominal 2,400. Models named an individual in 25.8% of responses. Category dominates: real estate 35.4% and car dealerships 32.9% against insurance 9.1% (chi-square 159.3, p = 5.8e-8 after correction). Models differ four-fold, from Grok 38.0% to Gemini 9.3%. Citation type predicts naming and citation volume does not: naming responses cite the individual's own site 2.6 points more often (95% CI +1.4 to +3.9) and category portals 4.3 points more often, and cite firm-owned pages at the same rate (44.1% against 45.5%). On nine matched translation pairs, English prompts named an individual in 36.7% of responses against 15.6% for the same question in the local language (OR 3.14, clustered p = 0.074, so the direction is clear and the design cannot close it). A 939-person roster built from public LinkedIn search matched 128 of 27,293 name-shaped mentions (0.47%), 26 of the 939 people were ever named, and the roster-derived rates of 0.0% to 25.4% measure that overlap. Roster-based measurement of individual AI visibility sees a small and unrepresentative slice of what models do.

</details>


### [279] [MEMOIR: Temporal Behavioral Memory for Recommendation Across the Preference-Drift Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23986)
*Younggue Bae*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MEMOIR是一个基于LLM的用户行为记忆框架，通过将交互历史分段并生成语义记忆来增强推荐效果。在Amazon数据集上，其综合性能与最强基线UniSRec持平，但在不同用户偏好漂移程度下表现出显著的性能差异：在偏好漂移极端（高/低）用户中表现优于UniSRec，而在中等漂移用户中略逊一筹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在解决传统ID-based方法难以捕捉用户长期行为演变和语义信息的问题，通过构建具有时间窗口和演化方向的语义行为记忆来提升用户表示的质量。

Method: 提出MEMOIR框架，核心步骤包括：1. 将用户交互历史分割为时间窗口；2. 利用LLM为每个时间段生成语义行为记忆；3. 聚合当前状态、演化方向和预测未来形成单一用户表示。引入保留演化的对比损失及其方向一致性项。

Result: 1. 在Amazon Reviews 2023的Electronics和Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry类别上，MEMOIR与UniSRec在NDCG@10上几乎持平（0.0643 vs 0.0641），四项指标各占优势（MEMOIR胜NDCG@10和MRR，UniSRec胜HR@10和HR@20）。
2. 相比ID-based SASRec，MEMOIR有约18%的相对提升。
3. 消融实验显示，单个组件（如对比损失、方向一致性或时间分割）无法单独解释大部分增益，所有变体在综合NDCG@10上与全模型差距小于2%。
4. 关键发现：按偏好漂移分数分层后，MEMOIR在高/低漂移极端用户群体中在排名质量指标（NDCG@10, MRR）上显著领先UniSRec；而UniSRec在所有漂移层级中在体积导向指标（HR@10, HR@20）上占优，并在中等漂移群体的排名质量上胜出。

Conclusion: MEMOIR的核心价值在于其针对偏好漂移极端用户的强大适应能力，这一分层性能模式比整体接近的得分更具实质性和可复现性。单个架构组件并非增益的唯一来源，而是协同作用的结果。该漂移分层现象的具体成因仍为开放问题，需未来研究进一步探索。

Abstract: We propose MEMOIR, a framework that segments user interaction histories into temporal windows, generates semantic behavioral memory for each period using an LLM, and aggregates current state, evolution direction, and predicted future into a single user representation. On the Electronics and Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry categories of Amazon Reviews 2023, MEMOIR is statistically tied with UniSRec, the strongest baseline, on aggregate NDCG@10 (0.0643 vs. 0.0641), splitting the four reported metrics 2-2: MEMOIR leads NDCG@10 and MRR, UniSRec leads HR@10 and HR@20. An ablation study finds that no single architectural component - the evolution-preserving contrastive loss, its directional-consistency term, or temporal window segmentation itself - individually explains much of MEMOIR's approximately 18% relative gain over ID-based SASRec; all four ablations land within 2% of the full model on aggregate NDCG@10. Stratifying test performance by a composite preference-drift score instead reveals where the gain concentrates: MEMOIR leads on ranking-quality metrics (NDCG@10, MRR) specifically among users at the high- and low-drift extremes of the distribution, while UniSRec leads the volume-oriented HR@10/HR@20 metrics across all drift strata and edges out MEMOIR on ranking quality in the middle band. We report this drift-stratified pattern, rather than the near-tied aggregate numbers or any single ablated component, as MEMOIR's most substantive and reproducible finding, and surface why it holds as an open question for future work.

</details>


### [280] [Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24015)
*John Zhiyuan Zheng,Xian Sun,Xiangyang Mou,Yujunrong Ma,Christina You,Michael Jiayuan He,Hrishikesh Paranjape,Aakarsha Agarwal,Hong Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出Mosaic平台，通过多专家模型协同学习用户嵌入，结合MRM和CRL技术优化信息贡献，并引入无日志评估框架及混合服务架构，显著提升推荐系统的离线和在线效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业界推荐系统中用户表示是关键瓶颈，现有方法多为单一模型或共享主干加任务适配，难以全面捕捉用户行为的多样性特征，亟需一种能整合多种行为侧重点的基础建模平台以提升整体性能。

Method: 构建包含记忆驱动、密集主导、序列相关和CoTrain四种架构的“专家舰队”；开发MRM（多任务关系挖掘）和CRL（余弦冗余损失）以最大化新专家的边际信息贡献；提出CoEval和用户塔零化技术实现无日志嵌入评估；采用混合CPU/GPU在线/离线服务栈以满足不同延迟和新鲜度需求。

Result: 实现了显著的离线NE（归一化熵）提升以及线上业务指标增益，验证了多专家协同机制和服务架构的有效性。

Conclusion: Mosaic作为基础用户建模平台，通过异构专家协作、高效评估机制和灵活的服务策略，解决了复杂用户行为表征难题，为大规模推荐系统提供了高杠杆率的解决方案。

Abstract: User representation is one of the highest-leverage modeling problems in industrial recommendation systems: a single advancement in how users are encoded can propagate across retrieval, ranking, and integrity tasks at platform scale. Prior industrial user representation work builds either a single user model that emits one or more embedding vectors or a shared backbone with task-specific adaptation. In this paper, we present Mosaic, a foundational user modeling platform that employs a fleet of specialists to learn user embeddings. The fleet comprises four architecturally diverse model families - memorization-driven, dense-heavy, sequential-based, and CoTrain models - each focusing on a distinct facet of user behavior. We developed MRM (Multi-task Relations Mining) and CRL (Cosine Redundancy Loss) techniques to maximize the marginal information contribution of each new specialist. We also introduce CoEval and User Tower Zero-Out, new logging-free embedding evaluation framework that improves development velocity while preserving downstream-aligned accuracy. Our hybrid CPU/GPU, online-and-offline serving stack allows each specialist to choose the adequate serving strategy to meet the freshness, latency, and computational requirements. Mosaic delivers consistent and significant offline NE improvements in addition to online gains.

</details>


### [281] [SpecFormer: Mitigating Embedding and Attention Collapse via Spectral-Aware Transformer for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24025)
*Yu Cui,Yi Xu,Jiahao Wang,Hao Zhang,Yu Zhang,Xiaoyi Zeng,Can Wang,Jinxin Hu,Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对Transformer在推荐系统中因数据异构性和长尾效应导致的嵌入与注意力坍缩问题，提出SpecFormer模型。通过可学习的谱软化模块、谱软化注意力机制及谱残差位置编码缓解该问题，显著提升性能并成功部署于工业界真实商业推荐系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Transformer在各领域表现优异，但直接将其标准自注意力机制应用于推荐系统时，性能往往不佳甚至不如简单的推荐模型。本研究旨在揭示这一性能瓶颈的根本原因，即推荐场景特有的严重嵌入和注意力坍缩现象，并解决由此限制模型扩展能力的问题。

Method: 提出SpecFormer（一种谱感知Transformer），包含三个核心组件：1) 可学习谱软化模块，动态平滑输入token嵌入的奇异值分布；2) 谱软化注意力机制，在更均匀的谱分布空间中对特征交互进行建模；3) 基于奇异值泰勒展开的谱残差位置编码，为特征交互提供显式的谱归纳偏置。

Result: 在一个工业数据集和两个公开数据集上的广泛实验表明，SpecFormer显著优于最先进的基础模型。值得注意的是，SpecFormer已成功部署在真实的商业推荐系统中，展现出卓越的扩展能力：堆叠SpecFormer层能有效提升注意力的有效秩（effective rank）和推荐性能。

Conclusion: 推荐数据的异构性和长尾性质导致以少数主奇异值为主导的严重谱坍缩，进而引发前向和后向传播中的恶性循环，限制了模型的深度扩展能力。SpecFormer通过显式处理谱分布特性，有效缓解了嵌入和注意力坍缩，证明了其在提升推荐系统性能和可扩展性方面的有效性。

Abstract: Transformer architectures have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains; however, directly applying their standard self-attention mechanism to recommendation often yields suboptimal performance, sometimes even trailing behind well-designed simple recommendation models. In this paper, we reveal that this performance bottleneck stems from severe embedding and attention collapse unique to recommendation scenarios. The heterogeneity and long-tail nature of recommendation data lead to a severe spectral collapse dominated by a few principal singular values. We further theoretically demonstrate that this triggers a vicious cycle in recommendation model's forward and backward propagation, which accelerates embedding and attention collapse and limits the model's scaling capability with increased depth. To address these issues, we propose SpecFormer, a novel Spectral-Aware Transformer designed for mitigating embedding and attention collapse in recommendation. Specifically, SpecFormer introduces 1) a Learnable Spectral Softening module to dynamically smooth the singular values distribution of the input token embeddings; 2) a Spectrum-softened Attention mechanism to model feature interaction under a more uniform spectral distribution space; 3) a Spectral Residual Position Encoding via Taylor expansion of singular values, explicitly providing a spectral inductive bias for feature interactions. Extensive experiments on one industrial and two public datasets demonstrate that SpecFormer significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, SpecFormer has been successfully deployed in a real-world commercial recommender system and exhibits exceptional scaling capabilities: stacking SpecFormer layers actively improves the attention effective rank and recommendation performance.

</details>


### [282] [ConAlign: Conditional Alignment Framework for Balancing Biased and Unbiased Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24092)
*Jingcheng Zhang,Yihan Wang,Qi Song,Liyin Hong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出ConAlign框架，通过离散门控条件对齐机制，利用少量无偏随机流量在工业级推荐系统中实现实时去偏，平衡了事实准确性与长期用户参与度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决工业推荐系统因观测数据偏差导致的过滤气泡和用户兴趣窄化问题；现有去偏方法因忽视事实性能或计算开销过大，难以在工业界部署。

Method: 提出ConAlign（条件对齐框架），采用基于离散门控的条件对齐机制，选择性地将有偏塔的知识迁移至无偏塔；遵循选择性干预而非普遍修正范式，支持实时流式适应。

Result: 离线实验验证了框架有效性；在快手的大规模在线A/B测试中，显著提升了长期用户参与度和兴趣多样性，且延迟开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: ConAlign是首个成功部署于大规模工业推荐系统的流式去偏框架，证明了利用少量无偏流量进行高效、低延迟去偏的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Industry recommender systems trained on observational data suffer from various biases that create filter bubbles, causing user interests to collapse into narrow categories and severely degrading long-term engagement. While utilizing unbiased uniform data for debiasing has shown promise, existing methods remain impractical for industrial deployment due to limitations such as neglect of factual (biased) recommendation performance and the substantial computational overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConAlign (Conditional Alignment Framework), a conditional debiasing approach for industrial deployment. The key innovation of ConAlign lies in a discrete gating-based conditional alignment mechanism that selectively transfers knowledge from the biased tower to the unbiased tower. Following a selective intervention paradigm rather than universal correction, it seamlessly balances factual accuracy and unbiased preference estimation while supporting real-time streaming adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, ConAlign is the first streaming debiasing recommendation framework successfully deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system that utilizes a small fraction of unbiased random traffic for debiasing. Extensive offline experiments on three real-world datasets rigorously validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Furthermore, large-scale online A/B testing on Kuaishou demonstrates significant improvements in long-term user engagement and interest diversity, with negligible latency overhead.

</details>


### [283] [Strategy-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for LLM-based Auto-Bidding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24232)
*Songyue Cai,Lianyu Wang,Shan Gu,Ziru Xu,Jian Xu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SAGE框架，利用LLM解决广告自动竞价中的轨迹-文本交互浅层及微调成本高的问题，通过参数高效的多模态对齐实现约束下的智能竞价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动竞价方法在利用大语言模型（LLM）时存在轨迹与文本交互浅层、需昂贵微调且难以适应多样约束的问题，阻碍了预训练知识的高效利用。

Method: 提出SAGE框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 位置增强模块：使用时序语义位置嵌入捕捉动态和语义结构；(2) 文本对齐模块：利用门控交叉注意力机制融合轨迹和文本模态，降低长轨迹计算开销；(3) 约束门控LoRA模块：以约束为路由信号，激活少量专家以适应冻结的LLM，实现参数高效微调。

Result: 在大规模自动竞价基准测试中，SAE consistently achieves superior performance，且可训练参数量少于全量微调所需参数的10%。消融实验验证了各组件对整体性能的关键贡献。

Conclusion: SAGE框架通过参数高效的多模态对齐和约束感知机制，有效提升了自动竞价的性能并降低了计算成本，证明了其在复杂动态拍卖环境中的有效性。

Abstract: Advertising bidding has evolved from manual strategies to auto-bidding systems better adapted for large-scale, dynamic auction environments. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning for auto-bidding, existing methods suffer from shallow trajectory-text interactions and require costly fine-tuning, hindering the efficient use of pretrained knowledge under diverse constraints. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE, a novel Strategy-aware Auto-bidding framework Guided by LLMs for Efficient bidding. SAGE introduces a parameter-efficient multi-modal alignment framework for constrained auto-bidding with LLMs. Specifically, SAGE comprises three key components: (i) the position augmentation module adopts temporal-semantic positional embeddings to effectively capture the intrinsic dynamics and semantic structures; (ii) the text alignment module leverages gated cross-attention to align the embedding spaces of trajectory and text modalities, enabling effective multi-modal fusion while alleviating the computational overhead caused by long trajectories; (iii) the constraint-gated LoRA module employs constraints as routing signals, activating only a small subset of experts to adapt the behavior of a frozen LLM efficiently. Extensive experiments on large-scale auto-bidding benchmark demonstrate that SAGE consistently achieves superior performance while tuning less than 10% of the trainable parameters required by full fine-tuning. Ablation studies further validate the critical contribution of each component to the framework's overall performance.

</details>


### [284] [A Model-Driven Pipeline for Data Quality Specification and Operationalization: A No-Code Approach for Domain Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24245)
*Arno Kesper,Lukas Sebastian Hofmann,Markus Matoni,Gabriele Taentzer*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Constrainify的Web应用和QPM元模型，通过基于模型驱动工程的流水线，将领域专家的自然语言数据质量期望转化为可执行的、可复用的质量分析规则，解决了传统方法中技术门槛高、依赖性强且耗时的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在文化遗产等领域，数据质量对可靠分析和决策至关重要。然而，现有数据质量分析严重依赖领域专家和数据工程师的合作：专家能理解业务需求但缺乏技术能力将其形式化，而技术人员难以准确捕捉领域特定期望。这种分工导致流程耗时、技术难度大且存在依赖性瓶颈。

Method: 1. 设计QPM（Quality Pattern Metamodel）元模型，用于定义可复用的质量分析模板；
2. 开发Constrainify Web应用程序，允许用户根据特定概念需求定制这些模板；
3. 构建基于模型驱动工程（MDE）子流水线的工具链，将定制的模板自动转换为可执行的数据质量分析代码/规则。

Result: 成功实现了一套可复用、可重复且领域特定的数据质量分析方案。该方案降低了技术门槛，使得非技术背景的领域专家能够参与质量约束的形式化过程，并生成了标准化的可执行质量分析结果。

Conclusion: 通过结合元模型设计与模型驱动工程自动化，该研究有效弥合了领域知识与工程技术之间的鸿沟，为提升数据质量分析的效率和准确性提供了一种系统化、低代码/无代码的解决方案。

Abstract: High-quality data is essential for reliable analysis, decision-making, and research across domains. This is especially relevant in areas such as cultural heritage, where data is collected and curated manually, making it prone to quality issues like inconsistencies. To improve data quality, the data must be analyzed regularly using systematic quality analyses. Quality analyses validate the conformance of data to domain-specific expectations. These expectations are best understood by domain experts, who can express them using natural language. However, they rarely possess the technical expertise to formalize these expectations into executable quality analyses. Consequently, this process requires domain experts and data engineers, making it time-consuming and technically demanding. The required technical expertise and the resulting dependencies pose a significant challenge. To address this challenge, we present a pipeline for formalizing and operationalizing data quality constraints. We support this pipeline using QPM, a metamodel for defining templates for reusable quality analyses. The web application Constrainify enables tailoring templates to specific conceptual requirements and translating them into executable quality analyses via a tool-chain based on model-driven engineering subpipelines. The result is a set of reusable, repeatable, and domain-specific quality analyses.

</details>


### [285] [OxygenREC-v2: Internalizing Discrimination into Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24255)
*Guo Tang,Hanye Wu,Changjiang Han,Qingyang Li,Ming Zhang,Xiangyu Qian,Yanchen Qiao,Huanjie Wang,Zhi Ma,Zhen Li,Yaqiang Zang,Pinghua Gong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: OxygenREC-v2 是一种生成式推荐模型，通过将判别信号内化到生成过程中（IDGR），解决了行为信号整合难题。它使用日志行为条件化生成和熵感知轨迹优化自蒸馏框架，无需单独的判别目标或奖励模型。在京东大规模平台上部署的3B参数MoE模型显著提升了点击转化率和GMV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式推荐方法在整合点击、加购和订单等行为信号时面临挑战：联合优化生成与判别目标需要精细权衡，而使用独立排序器作为强化学习奖励则存在分布外评分和奖励不对齐的风险。

Method: 提出内部化判别到生成式推荐（IDGR）框架。预训练阶段利用行为指令条件化生成；后训练阶段利用未来交互行为作为特权知识，通过熵感知轨迹优化自蒸馏框架实现无奖励模型的策略优化。整个训练过程保持单一统一的主干网络。

Result: 在京东大规模电商平台上部署了参数量为30亿、激活参数为10亿的混合专家（MoE）模型。在线A/B测试显示，相比前代版本 OxygenREC-v1，OxygenREC-v2 将用户点击转化率（UCTCVR）提高了1.6%至4.4%，将商品交易总额（GMV）提高了2.8%至6.8%。

Conclusion: OxygenREC-v2 成功证明了通过内化判别信号并利用自蒸馏进行策略优化，可以在保持模型架构统一性的同时，有效提升生成式推荐系统的性能和业务指标。

Abstract: Generative recommendation unifies retrieval and ranking within a single model by autoregressively decoding semantic identifier (SID) sequences. Yet reliably incorporating behavior signals from clicks, cart additions, and orders remains challenging. Existing approaches either jointly optimize generative and discriminative objectives, requiring delicate trade-offs, or use a separate ranker as a post-hoc reinforcement-learning reward, risking out-of-distribution scoring and reward misalignment. We propose OxygenREC-v2, a generative recommender that Internalizes Discrimination into Generative Recommendation (IDGR). Rather than adding a separate discriminative objective, OxygenREC-v2 uses logged behavior to condition generation and supervise training. During pre-training, a behavior instruction conditions generation on the target behavior. During post-training, future interaction behaviors are exploited as privileged knowledge in our entropy-aware trajectory optimization self-distillation framework, enabling reward-model-free policy optimization. Throughout both training stages, OxygenREC-v2 maintains a single unified backbone. We implement OxygenREC-v2 as a 3B-parameter, 1B-activated MoE and deploy it on JD.com's large-scale e-commerce platform. Across multiple online A/B tests, OxygenREC-v2 improves user click-through conversion rate (UCTCVR) by 1.6--4.4% and GMV by 2.8--6.8% over OxygenREC-v1.

</details>
