### [286] [Energy Constrained Hierarchical Underwater Monitoring via Local Multi-Agent RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24313)
*Mohamed Amine Janati,Laurent Gautier,Stéphane Barbot*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种结合常开边缘传感与选择性本地推理的低功耗水下监测架构，利用MAX78000进行持续低功耗监控，仅在需要时激活NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX执行多模态处理、物种识别及报告生成，通过BioCLIP嵌入和LangChain智能体框架实现本地知识压缩与结构化输出，显著降低能耗与通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决海洋生命监测中面临的严格能量限制、水下连接性差以及从远程部署传输原始多模态数据的高成本问题。

Method: 采用分层主-卫星设计：1) 使用超低功耗微控制器（MAX78000/MAX78002）持续监测视觉和声学信号；2) 按需激活高性能计算单元（NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX）执行本地多模态流水线，包括数据摄入、目标提取、基于嵌入的索引、物种识别及检索增强推理；3) 利用BioCLIP/OpenCLIP嵌入将数据存入本地ChromaDB；4) 结合视觉相似度搜索、质心分类和监督分类器进行自适应物种识别；5) 使用基于LangChain的多智能体框架协调查询路由、能源管理和报告生成。

Result: 通过视觉和声学监测案例研究验证了系统有效性。该系统成功实现了超低功耗连续传感与本地多模态智能的结合，能够生成结构化的研究人员可用知识，并通过本地数据压缩减少了声学、光学或卫星传输的能量使用和通信开销。

Conclusion: 该架构有效平衡了持续感知与计算资源消耗，为水下环境监测提供了一种高效、低延迟且节能的解决方案，能够在不依赖高带宽上行链路的情况下提供高质量的科学数据。

Abstract: Marine life monitoring is limited by strict energy constraints, poor underwater connectivity, and the high cost of transmitting raw multimodal data from remote deployments. This paper proposes a low-consumption underwater monitoring architecture that combines always-on edge sensing with selective high-performance local reasoning. The system follows a hierarchical master--satellite design in which ultra-low-power MAX78000/MAX78002 microcontrollers continuously monitor visual and acoustic signals, while an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX is activated only for scheduled processing, event-driven analysis, or researcher interaction. Once active, the Jetson executes a fully local multimodal pipeline for data ingestion, visual target extraction, embedding-based indexing, species identification, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and automated reporting. BioCLIP/OpenCLIP embeddings are used to organize mission data, marine taxonomic references, scientific documents, and operational metadata in local ChromaDB collections. A dedicated identification layer combines visual similarity search, centroid-based classification, and supervised classifiers to support adaptive species recognition. A LangChain-based multi-agent framework coordinates query routing, structured analysis, energy management, hardware reconfiguration, and report generation. The architecture is evaluated through visual and acoustic monitoring case studies. The proposed system bridges ultra-low-power continuous sensing with local multimodal intelligence, enabling underwater stations to produce structured, researcher-ready knowledge while compressing local data for flexible acoustic, optical, or satellite transmission, minimizing both energy use and communication overhead.

</details>


### [287] [CogRec: Structure-Cognitive Fast-and-Slow Reasoning for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24402)
*Xiang Liu,Jingsong Su,Shuqi Zhao,Pengbo Mo,Yiming Qiu,Huimu Wang,Mingming Li,Jiao Dai,Jizhong Han,Songlin Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CogRec框架，将结构认知推理与生成式推荐结合。通过SID路由（匹配、横向跳转、探索）在相同的语义ID拓扑中进行显式推理，解决了现有方法中层级信息利用不足及自然语言理由与离散预测空间解耦的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语义ID（Semantic-ID, SID）的生成式推荐主要将SID作为需记忆的目标序列，未充分利用其层级、层内关系及物品邻域作为显式推理空间；而现有的显式推理增强方法生成的自然语言理由与最终预测的离散SID空间耦合较弱。

Method: 提出CogRec结构-认知快慢推理框架：1. 增强垂直SID层级，引入层内语义图和物品级邻域；2. 设计SID路由机制，通过层间“匹配”（快速语义定位）、“横向跳转”和“探索”（慢速结构导航）操作表示推理过程；3. 采用监督多阶段管道对齐新SID token，建立直接SID生成，并在同一Trie约束输出空间下训练自然语言和SID路由推理分支。

Result: 在三个公共序列推荐基准测试中，SID路由提升了直接生成性能。研究表明，当前缀匹配不足但可学习的SID空间转换可用时，基于结构的推理最有效；而长或弱支持的路线会增加解码成本和累积误差。

Conclusion: CogRec通过将中间推理锚定在与目标生成相同的SID拓扑中，有效结合了快速语义定位与慢速结构导航，证明了结构接地推理在提升生成式推荐效果上的价值，并明确了其适用边界。

Abstract: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation represents each item as a hierarchical discrete token sequence and reformulates next-item prediction as constrained sequence generation. Existing methods, however, mainly use Semantic IDs as target sequences to be memorized, leaving the hierarchy, intra-layer relations, and item neighborhoods underused as an explicit reasoning space. Explicit reasoning-enhanced generative methods often produce a natural-language rationale before the item identifier, but this rationale is only weakly coupled with the discrete SID space in which the final prediction is made. We propose CogRec, a structure-cognitive fast-and-slow reasoning framework that grounds intermediate reasoning in the same SID topology used for target generation. CogRec augments the vertical SID hierarchy with intra-layer semantic graphs and item-level neighborhoods, and introduces SID Routing to represent recommendation reasoning through layer-wise Match, LateralJump, and Explore operations. Exact matching implements fast semantic localization, whereas lateral and exploratory operations instantiate slower structural navigation. A supervised multi-stage pipeline aligns the newly introduced SID tokens, establishes direct SID generation, and trains natural-language and SID-routing reasoning branches from a shared checkpoint under the same trie-constrained output space. Experiments on three public sequential-recommendation benchmarks show that SID Routing improves its corresponding direct-generation, indicate that structure-grounded reasoning is most useful when prefix matching is insufficient but learnable SID-space transitions remain available, whereas long or weakly supported routes introduce additional decoding cost and accumulated errors. Code is available at https://github.com/caskcsg/CogRec

</details>


### [288] [CORE: A Unified Cascaded Ordinal Relevance Estimation Framework for E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24417)
*Zhi Jin,Xi Wang,Yunfei Li,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出了一种统一的级联二元分类框架，将电商搜索中的相关性评估从传统多分类转化为有序的二元判断序列，有效解决了忽视等级顺序和惩罚机制不合理的问题，显著提升了线上效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电商搜索相关性排序任务通常被建模为常规多类分类问题，这种方法忽视了相关性等级之间的自然顺序，且对相邻与 distant 误分类赋予相同惩罚，导致学习目标与实际需求不匹配，性能次优。

Method: 提出统一级联二元分类框架：1）将相关性估计重构为从高到低相关层级的序列决策过程；2）针对大语言模型（LLM），设计带剪枝策略的分步推理过程和层级特定奖励函数；3）针对在线BERT模型，用多级二元分类器替换传统分类头，并通过蒸馏LLM能力进行优化。

Result: 离线工业基准测试和在线A/B实验表明，该框架显著提升了相关性性能，将线上不良案例率降低了15.94%。进一步分析证实了层级建模在相关性估计中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过级联二元分类框架重构相关性评估任务，能够有效捕捉相关性等级的有序性，显著提升搜索排序质量，该方法兼具理论合理性与工程实用性。

Abstract: Ranking relevance is a fundamental task in e-commerce search, directly affecting ranking quality and consumer experience. Although inherently an ordinal classification problem, it is commonly formulated as conventional multi-class classification, which overlooks the natural order among relevance levels and assigns equal penalties to adjacent and distant misclassifications. This mismatch leads to suboptimal learning objectives for practical relevance evaluation. To address this issue, we propose a unified cascaded binary classification framework applicable to both large language model inference and online BERT-based inference, which reformulates relevance estimation as a sequential decision process and decomposes multi-class prediction into a series of ordered binary judgments from higher to lower relevance tiers. For large language models, we design a step-wise reasoning procedure with pruning strategies and tier-specific reward functions. For the online BERT model, we replace the conventional classification head with multiple level-wise binary classifiers and distill the capabilities of large language models into the online model. Extensive offline industrial benchmark evaluations and online A/B experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves relevance performance, reducing the online bad-case rate by 15.94\%. Further analyses suggest that tier-wise modeling is effective for relevance estimation.

</details>


### [289] [Unifying Generative Recall and Multi-Objective Ranking in a Single Decoder-Only Sequence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24439)
*Ruochen Yang,Shuang Wen,Pengbo Xu,Yusheng Huang,Jiangxia Cao,Shuang Yang,Zhaojie Liu,Jiawei Sheng,Tingwen Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出UniR²，一种统一的解码器Transformer模型，将生成式召回和多目标排序整合到一个异构序列中，通过双查询前缀因果注意力解决任务间信息可见性和优化方法的差异，在快手平台验证了其有效性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统工业推荐系统分离召回和排序阶段导致目标不一致、候选传递时的信息损失以及用户侧上下文计算的冗余；尽管两者都基于Transformer架构，但直接共享因任务所需的信息可见性和优化方法不同而面临挑战。

Method: 提出UniR²统一模型，包含用户上下文、SID轨迹和项目特征的异构序列；利用生成的轨迹作为召回与排序间的表示桥梁，采用Dual-Query Prefix-Causal Attention提供任务特定的可见性；基础注意力权重共享，但保留独立的优化边界，并通过Ranking-side LoRA保持排序适应性而不干扰生成主干。

Result: 大规模工业数据的离线实验证明了UniR²在召回和排序方面的有效性和效率；快手平台的长期在线A/B测试显示持续的正向收益，验证了统一模型在大规模推荐系统中的实用性。

Conclusion: UniR²成功解决了召回与排序分离带来的问题，通过统一架构实现了更高效、一致的推荐流程，并在实际工业场景中取得了显著性能提升。

Abstract: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically separate recall and ranking into two independent stages. Although this cascade supports corpus-level retrieval and fine-grained multi-objective scoring, it causes objective inconsistency, information loss at the candidate hand-off, and redundant user-side context computation. Meanwhile, the generative recall and ranking scaling share a common Transformer-based modeling philosophy, where architectural consistency creates a natural opportunity for unified integration. However, direct sharing remains challenging since the two tasks require different information visibility and optimization methods. Therefore, we propose \textbf{UniR$^2$}, a \textbf{Uni}fied decoder-only Transformer that unifies Generative \textbf{R}ecall and Multi-Objective \textbf{R}anking within a single heterogeneous sequence comprising user context, SID trajectory, and item features. Within this sequence, the generated trajectory serves as a representation bridge between recall and ranking, where Dual-Query Prefix-Causal Attention provides task-specific visibility. The two tasks share the base attention weights but retain separate optimization boundaries, with ranking-side LoRA preserving ranking adaptability without disrupting the generative backbone. Extensive offline experiments on large-scale industrial data demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of UniR$^2$ for both recall and ranking. Long-term online A/B tests on Kuaishou platform further show consistent positive gains, validating the practicality of unified model in large-scale recommendation systems.

</details>


### [290] [Evaluating RAG for French immigration law: a benchmark and baseline study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24449)
*Annia Abtout,Julien Delaunay,Monika Ewa Rakoczy*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文发布了首个针对法国国际招聘法律领域的基准测试，通过对比实验证明检索增强在提升行政指导准确性（特别是许可证类型推荐）方面显著优于纯参数化大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有法律AI基准缺乏对法国复杂分层法律框架支持的问题，填补该特定领域评估工具的空白。

Method: 构建包含许可证类型推荐、所需文件检索和法律引用覆盖率的公开基准；使用52个标注的合成档案，对比参数量不同的Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3.5-27B基线模型与密集检索增强方法的表现。

Result: 检索增强在两个模型规模下均提升了行政指导的可靠性，尤其在许可证类型准确率上提升最显著；证实了检索接地（retrieval grounding）对该领域的重要性。

Conclusion: 检索接地对于提高该领域行政指导的可靠性至关重要，未来应进一步研究混合检索策略以优化性能。

Abstract: International recruitment in France requires navigating a layered legal framework absent from existing legal AI benchmarks. We present a publicly available benchmark and first comparative evaluation for this domain, covering permit-type recommendation, required-document retrieval, and legal citation coverage. Comparing a parametric LLM baseline against dense retrieval augmentation at two model scales (Qwen3.5-9B and -27B) on 52 annotated synthetic profiles, we find that retrieval improves administrative guidance at both scales, most notably permit-type accuracy. Our results confirm that retrieval grounding is important for more reliable administrative guidance in this domain, and motivate further investigation of hybrid retrieval strategies.

</details>


### [291] [Robust Interpretation of Historical Documents in Knowledge Graphs Through Query Inference and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24475)
*Sebastià Nicolau,Adrià Molina,Oriol Ramos Terrades,Josep Lladós*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合词定位和知识图谱的代理式GraphRAG架构，旨在解决大语言模型在历史档案检索中的可靠性问题，通过半符号框架提升对OCR错误和噪声数据的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在数字环境中的应用引发了关于可靠性和信任度的担忧，特别是在访问数字图书馆和历史档案时，需要在利用LLM泛化能力的同时保持机构所需的问责制。

Method: 构建了一个代理式检索系统，采用半符号框架整合词定位技术（用于OCR后校正）与知识图谱表示；通过词定位与代码生成的交错协作，使代理能够构建抗误读和幻觉的强检索查询，并在存在噪声时使用近似搜索。

Result: 对比了传统RAG与代理式GraphRAG架构在真实条件（包括OCR和转录错误）下提供历史信息的能力，证明了该架构能提供更准确、可验证的历史数据访问，同时保留LLM的灵活性。

Conclusion: 提出的代理式GraphRAG架构能有效平衡历史文档分析中的准确性与灵活性，通过结合符号方法与非符号LLM优势，解决了历史数据检索中的噪声和不确定性问题。

Abstract: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has redefined how users interact with information in digital environments. However, their widespread and often indiscriminate integration has raised significant concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness issues that are particularly critical when accessing digital libraries and historical archives. How can one leverage the generalization capacity of an LLM without losing the level of accountability required for an archival institution? In this paper, we present an agentic retrieval system designed to deliver more accurate and verifiable access to historical data while preserving much of the flexibility associated with unconstrained LLMs. As a contribution to historical document analysis, we compare traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with an agentic GraphRAG architecture in their ability to deliver historical information under realistic conditions, including the presence of OCR and transcription errors.
  We introduce a semi-symbolic framework that integrates word-spotting techniques for post-OCR correction with a knowledge graph representation that enables the agent to access information through synthesized queries. The interleaved collaboration between word spotting and code generation allows the agent to construct strong retrieval queries that are robust to misinterpretation and hallucination, while still leveraging approximate search when noise and uncertainty, common in historical document analysis, would otherwise hinder precise retrieval.

</details>


### [292] [DeCoRAG: Cognitive Decoupling and Semantic-Aware Cropping for Complex Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24554)
*Shuo Wang,Kai Zhang,Wenyuan Huang,Yizheng Yu,Xia Liao,Junming Su,Qing Wang,Fang Xi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出DeCoRAG，一种多模态图RAG管道，通过“认知解耦”解决视觉注意力陷阱，显著降低计算开销并提升复杂文档理解的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图的RAG在处理结构稀疏但视觉密集的布局时面临双重困境：为了定位微小数据点需消耗大量Token，且强制VLM在密集背景中解析语义会导致“视觉注意力陷阱”，引发灾难性的语义丢失和幻觉。

Method: 引入DeCoRAG框架，采用“认知解耦”策略。首先建立宏观语义锚点以中和注意力陷阱，随后利用区域感知修剪与裁剪（RAP-Crop）机制，将推理空间从嘈杂背景转移至纯净的语义簇，从而构建支持混合检索和答案生成的图结构。

Result: 在复杂文档基准测试中，DeCoRAG比最强基线提高了12.5个百分点的语义通过率；RAP-Crop机制使离线图构建提示Token减少40.8%，同时保持端到端准确性不下降，并泛化至DocVQA任务。

Conclusion: 传统假设VLM能直接解析高密度布局中的稀疏语义是错误的。通过认知解耦和区域裁剪，可以有效克服视觉注意力陷阱，实现高效且准确的多模态文档理解。

Abstract: Advancing multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for complex document understanding presents a formidable dual dilemma of accuracy and efficiency, particularly in graph RAG. Processing structurally sparse yet visually dense layouts, such as extracting a tiny data marker from a financial chart, often incurs computationally prohibitive token overhead while still triggering catastrophic hallucination. However, multimodal Graph RAG pipelines rely on graph-construction stages that assume Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can resolve sparse semantics within high-density layouts. We challenge this assumption, revealing that forcing VLMs to localize visual evidence, interpret semantics, and extract relations triggers a "Visual Attention Sink," a mechanism driving catastrophic semantic loss, while full-page processing incurs massive computational overhead. Controlled interventions verify that this failure is boundary-driven rather than content-specific and that semantic anchoring mitigates it. To fundamentally correct this flawed paradigm, we introduce DeCoRAG, a multimodal Graph RAG pipeline that shifts knowledge processing from coupled visual-semantic reasoning to "Cognitive Decoupling." Rather than passively processing raw pixels, its graph-construction stage establishes a macroscopic Semantic Anchor to neutralize the attention sink. This anchor subsequently drives our Region-Aware Pruning and Cropping (RAP-Crop) mechanism, shifting the reasoning space from dense, noisy backgrounds to purified, intent-driven semantic clusters. The resulting graph supports hybrid retrieval and answer generation. Across complex document benchmarks, DeCoRAG improves the semantic pass rate by up to 12.5 percentage points over the strongest baseline and generalizes to DocVQA. RAP-Crop reduces offline graph-construction prompt tokens by 40.8% without sacrificing end-to-end accuracy.

</details>


### [293] [One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24607)
*Jinfeng Xu,Zheyu Chen,Ziyue Peng,Shuo Yang,Jinze Li,Zewei Liu,Shujie Li,Yipeng Du,Edith C. H. Ngai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出IIMRec框架，通过预处理构建高质量单一物品-物品图（融合语义与共现信号并经NCER优化），并在表示增强、交互图增强和优化增强三个阶段复用该图，显著提升推荐性能及效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于物品-物品图的推荐方法通常使用带有噪声相似性边的图，且仅将其用于单一的表示传播，未能充分利用其潜力。

Method: 1. 构建：融合语义和共现信号构建初始图，利用三角闭包原理进行邻域一致性边缘重加权（NCER）以去噪；2. 应用：(1) 使用残差II门控（RIG）进行物品表示增强；(2) 通过高置信度语义邻居引入虚拟用户-物品边以扩展交互图；(3) 将正物品的顶级邻居作为折扣软正样本进行BPR优化增强（INA）。

Result: 理论分析表明NCER降低了谱信噪比，RIG收敛至非退化门控状态，INA提供了更紧的泛化界。在四个数据集上的实验显示，IIMRec优于最先进基线，运行更快且显存占用更少，尤其在冷启动和稀疏交互场景下表现强劲。

Conclusion: IIMRec通过高质量单图的多阶段系统性复用，有效解决了现有方法中图结构噪声大和功能单一的问题，实现了推荐精度、效率和鲁棒性的全面提升。

Abstract: Multimodal recommendation leverages item multimodal features alongside collaborative signals to capture user preferences. While item-item graphs have become a key building block in advanced models, existing methods typically construct them with noisy similarity edges and limit their role to a single function of item-item representation propagation, leaving substantial potential untapped.
  In this paper, we propose IIMRec, a framework that constructs a single high-quality item-item graph during preprocessing and systematically reuses it across three stages of the recommendation pipeline: representation enhancement, interaction graph enhancement, and optimization enhancement. The graph is built by fusing semantic and co-occurrence signals, then refined via Neighborhood Consistency Edge Reweighting (NCER), which applies the triadic closure principle to amplify structurally reliable edges and suppress spurious ones. Once constructed, the graph is leveraged in three complementary ways: (1) Item-item propagation with a Residual II Gate (RIG) that adaptively controls per-item absorption of semantic neighborhood signals for representation enhancement; (2) A content-guided UI graph expansion that introduces virtual user-item edges through high-confidence semantic neighbors for interaction graph enhancement; (3) II-Neighbor BPR Augmentation (INA) that treats top neighbors of positive items as discounted soft positives for optimization enhancement.
  We provide theoretical analysis showing that NCER reduces the spectral noise-to-signal ratio, RIG converges to a non-degenerate gating regime, and INA yields a tighter generalization bound. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that IIMRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while running faster and consuming less GPU memory, with particularly strong gains under cold-start and sparse-interaction conditions.

</details>


### [294] [LaRec: Unleashing LLM-based Latent Reasoning for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24617)
*Yu Xia,Zihan Lin,Wei Yang,Rui Zhong,Cheng Chen,Huan Ren,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出LaRec框架，通过潜空间预训练解决细粒度监督缺失问题，利用个性化RL微调探索多样化推理路径，平衡大语言模型推荐的效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于显式思维链（CoT）的方法推理冗长且低效；而潜推理虽高效但面临两个挑战：缺乏细粒度监督信号导致优化困难，以及确定性推理路径限制了用户多样兴趣的探索。

Method: 提出LaRec框架，包含两个核心阶段：1. 潜预训练：通过步骤级对齐和过程方向对齐提供丰富监督信号，赋予LLM潜推理能力；2. 个性化RL微调：为每个用户构建个性化高斯混合分布，通过随机采样不同推理起点，引导LLM在潜空间中遍历多样化推理路径。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，LaRec显著优于现有基线方法，同时保持了相当的推理效率。

Conclusion: LaRec有效解决了潜推理中的监督和路径单一问题，释放了LLM在推荐系统中的潜推理潜力，实现了效率与推荐能力的双重提升。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great promise in recommendation due to superior reasoning abilities. However, existing methods mainly rely on explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), resulting in verbose reasoning texts and inefficient response times. latent reasoning aims to balance efficiency by thinking within a continuous latent space, yet it faces two major challenges: (1) Lack of Fine-grained Supervision: Latent reasoning relies solely on feedback from the final labels, providing sparse supervisory signals that struggle to effectively guide the optimization of multiple hidden reasoning steps. (2) Single Reasoning Path: The deterministic nature of latent reasoning impedes the exploration of users' diverse interests and preferences, thereby limiting the recommendation capabilities of LLMs. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{$LaRec$}, an efficient generative recommendation framework designed to unleash the potential of latent reasoning in LLMs. $LaRec$ consists of two core stages: First, we design Latent Pre-training that empowers LLMs with latent reasoning capabilities by providing rich supervisory signals to the latent space reasoning via step-level alignment and process direction alignment. Second, we introduce Personalized RL-tuning. Specifically, we construct a personalized Gaussian Mixture Distribution for each user based on their historical interests. By randomly sampling distinct reasoning starting points from this distribution during training, we guide the LLMs to traverse diverse reasoning paths within the latent space, enabling efficient exploration of user's multi-faceted interests. Experiments on multiple datasets show that $LaRec$ significantly outperforms existing baselines with comparable efficiency.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [295] [Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22544)
*Yassine Oueslati,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出C-VCE框架，将分类器集成到扩散生成模型的概念瓶颈层中，通过直接控制人类可解释的语义概念来生成视觉反事实解释，解决了现有方法依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器的脆弱性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的视觉反事实解释方法依赖能在 noisy images 上可靠工作的外部分类器，导致方法脆弱且难以部署于安全关键领域（如医疗）。需要一种更稳健、可直接由用户控制语义概念的生成式解释方法。

Method: 1. 构建C-VCE扩散框架，在生成模型中嵌入概念瓶颈层（concept bottleneck layer），使反事实生成由可解释特征引导而非像素级编辑。
2. 允许用户在采样过程中开关语义概念，最小化调整相关图像区域并保留其余部分，同时尊重特征相关性。
3. 引入概率正则项平衡“改变预测”与“接近原图”，并使用基于梯度的掩码限制修改范围至最相关区域。

Result: 在CelebA等基准测试中，C-VCE达到或超过基线方法的翻转率（flip rates），生成的反事实图像视觉上更接近输入且失真更少，优于依赖独立噪声鲁棒分类器的基线方法。

Conclusion: C-VCE为需要具体“如果-那么”图像且不愿信任额外分类器的视觉系统提供了实用工具；暴露和控制内部概念层是增强生成模型可理解性和安全性的重要方向。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

</details>


### [296] [SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22548)
*Giovanni B. Esposito,Francesco Antici,Daniele Cesarini,Andrea Bartolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SeT-Diff，首个基于扩散模型的HPC计算节点遥测基础模型，通过语义条件解耦系统动态与数据结构，实现零样本排列稳定性及重构、预测、虚拟传感等多任务高效处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法依赖静态匿名传感器变量，当目标任务或传感器指标变化时模型迅速过时，缺乏灵活性和通用性，无法满足数据中心数字孪生对复杂工作负载与环境参数建模的需求。

Method: 提出SeT-Diff，一种基于扩散过程的生成式模型，其创新点在于根据每个传感器的语义描述对生成过程进行条件控制，从而将系统动力学与数据集结构解耦；该模型在真实超级计算机数据集上进行预训练。

Result: 在真实世界超级计算机数据集上，重构任务的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.0470；模型具备零样本排列稳定性，传感器顺序打乱后精度几乎无下降；单模型实现数据插补、预测和虚拟传感，热推断MAE达0.033。

Conclusion: SeT-Diff作为首个面向计算节点遥测的时间序列基础模型，有效解决了传统模型僵化问题，成为高性能计算（HPC）系统中高效的数据驱动数字孪生解决方案。

Abstract: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

</details>


### [297] [QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22549)
*Winson Chen,Yuqi Zhang,Sixu Chen,Nuo Xu,Qiang Guan,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出QFoldAgent，一种用于5残基四面体晶格折叠的闭环多智能体框架，通过设计、量子优化和反馈智能体的迭代协作，自动调整哈密顿量惩罚权重，显著降低了RMSD并提高了结构有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于晶格的蛋白质结构预测方法通常手动固定哈密顿量惩罚系数，且仅评估极短的片段，限制了预测精度和泛化能力。

Method: 构建包含三个智能体的闭环系统：设计智能体提出序列条件化的惩罚，VQE量子-经典管道在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量，反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号迭代 refinement 惩罚权重。真实RMSD数据仅用于评估而不暴露给智能体。

Result: 在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64 Å降至3.20 Å；在未见过序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，恢复了87%的初始无效案例，最强控制器在87%的序列上改善了第3周期的能量，并保持96%的Ramachandran优选几何构型。

Conclusion: 迭代式智能体控制能够系统性地改善5残基量子环境下的优化行为，减少失败案例，证明了该框架在蛋白质结构预测中的有效性。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.

</details>


### [298] [Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22554)
*Kazem Faghih,Yize Cheng,Shoumik Saha,Mobina Pournemat,Armin Gerami,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在语义不变的改写下回答的一致性，发现尽管整体准确率变化不大，但实例级表现极不稳定（错配率超23%）。通过简单的自改写策略可部分恢复潜在知识并提升推理性能，表明标准准确率指标掩盖了模型的可靠性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM在基准测试中表现出高准确率，但其在实际应用中面对相同问题不同表述时的可靠性尚不明确，亟需评估模型对语义等价输入的响应稳定性。

Method: 在四个基准数据集和13个模型上，研究事实问答和数学推理任务中，模型在保留原意的改写（paraphrases）下的输出变化；分析实例级的答案翻转率，并提出并验证一种基于自改写的简单策略以提升推理时的性能。

Result: 模型输出高度依赖提示词的具体措辞，许多问题在不同表述间交替出现正确与错误答案，错配率超过23%；在原题答对的情况下，答案翻转率更高，证明单次提示的正确性不能代表可靠性；但模型通常能在至少一个改写版本中给出正确答案，说明知识存在但检索不一致；自改写策略能部分恢复这种潜在知识并提高性能。

Conclusion: 标准准确率指标可能掩盖LLM的不稳定性，通过在等价输入上评估一致性能更准确地反映模型可靠性，且利用自改写等策略可改善模型的实际表现。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.

</details>


### [299] [DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22555)
*Mahmood Bayeshi,Veysel Kocaman,Muhammed Ali Naqvi,Yigit Gul,David Talby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DeepLens诊断代理，通过五阶段流程约束小模型（JSL Medical Small 7B v2）结合RAG技术，在DiagnosisArena基准测试中实现60.14%的诊断准确率，较无工作流基线提升36个百分点，且成本低于Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro，兼具高精度、低成本与高可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿大语言模型（LLMs）虽为通用强项，但单次提示（single-shot prompting）常导致脆弱的诊断推理；医疗诊断是多阶段复杂过程，需要超越单纯知识回忆的结构化推理能力以应对不确定性。

Method: 构建“DeepLens Diagnosis Agent”五阶段管道：结合小型医学推理模型（JSL Medical Small 7B v2）与检索增强生成（RAG）。流程包括：结构化临床提取、纪律性检索、受限候选生成、显式证据三角验证及可审计的最终决策。

Result: 在915个案例的DiagnosisArena基准上，该代理达到60.14%的Top-1诊断准确率，为中小模型中最高。相比无工作流的同一模型（23.99%）提升36分。单案例成本0.0072美元，比Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro分别便宜35-45%，且准确率分别高出9.70pp和9.17pp。

Conclusion: 工作流约束设计能显著提升小模型的诊断推理能力，其效果优于参数规模或API成本优势。生成的结构化中间产物支持错误定位、追溯性和审计，适用于对可解释性要求极高的高风险医疗场景。

Abstract: Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

</details>


### [300] [MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22556)
*Dong Li,Yanchi Liu,Xujiang Zhao,Wei Cheng,Zhengzhang Chen,Xintao Wu,Zhong Chen,Chen Zhao,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MIITA框架，通过推理时检索紧凑的修正方向原型，在小语言模型持续学习中实现无灾难性遗忘和性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型（SLMs）在资源受限环境下需适应动态需求，但直接更新参数会导致灾难性遗忘；现有针对大语言模型的基于记忆的方法因依赖大量存储和强上下文推理能力，不适用于SLMs。

Method: 提出MIITA（Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation），将监督经验存储为带有语义锚点的紧凑修正方向原型；在推理时利用语义和不确定性线索检索这些方向，并通过门控临时隐藏状态适应机制应用，无需更新骨干网络、扩展提示或测试时反向传播。

Result: 理论分析表明该设计有助于一阶损失减少、不确定性引导检索及旧阶段知识的方向覆盖；实验显示在固定内存预算下，MIITA在多种监督持续学习设置中一致提高了最终性能并减轻了遗忘。

Conclusion: MIITA通过推理时的非破坏性知识重用机制，有效解决了资源受限小语言模型在持续学习中的遗忘问题，为低存储场景下的模型适应提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

</details>


### [301] [Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22561)
*Tzu-Heng Huang,Shengqi Qiu,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PAJAMA系统，通过程序蒸馏将LLM的判断逻辑转化为可解释、低成本的一组程序化裁判，在保持与13B LLM相当性能的同时，显著提升评估效率并生成高效奖励信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决“LLM-as-a-judge”模式在高成本、高延迟和决策不透明方面的局限性，以克服其在可扩展性和可靠性上的不足。

Method: 引入程序蒸馏技术，将LLM的决策逻辑提炼为一个程序委员会（committee of programs），构建PAJAMA系统来合成这些程序裁判，聚合其决策形成联合判决，并设置低置信度案例回退至LLM的机制。

Result: 在五个数据集和四个模型族上验证，程序化裁判的性能可与13B规模的LLM裁判相媲美；利用程序输出作为路由信号提升了准确率和吞吐量；由程序判决蒸馏出的奖励模型在RewardBench上优于基于专有LLM标签训练的模型，且API成本低两个数量级。

Conclusion: 程序化裁判提供了透明、可编辑且低成本的替代方案，不仅优化了自动化评估流程，还证明了其作为高效奖励信号的价值，推动了评估方法的前沿发展。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

</details>


### [302] [SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22562)
*Ning Yang,Siqi Li,Miaoxin Shen,Yuan Zhou,Meng Zhang,Tong Li,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SF-AMS框架，通过效用驱动的记忆生存机制和复合重要性评分，解决大模型智能体在长上下文处理中的冗余与噪声问题，显著提升多跳推理等任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 管理长上下文依赖是大语言模型（LLM）智能体的主要瓶颈，冗余和不相关信息会削弱多步推理能力；现有静态检索和启发式衰减方法存在局限。

Method: 提出战略遗忘智能体记忆系统（SF-AMS），利用使用冗余度和时间信号动态更新记忆单元的重要性，构建分层记忆结构以优先保留稳定且一致的信息并过滤噪声；结合复合重要性评分整合语义和实体级信号以提高检索鲁棒性。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s数据集上，SF-AMS优于LightMem、MemO和A-Mem等强基线模型；在Qwen2.5-7B上多跳推理F1值提升9.65，GPT-4o-mini上时序推理提升6.91 F1，开放域任务提升6.53 F1，展现出跨骨干模型的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号对于实现可靠的长上下文推理至关重要。

Abstract: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

</details>


### [303] [Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22563)
*Sagar Chethan Kumar,Rohith Kanathur,Dhaval Patel,Kaoutar El Maghraoui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文扩展了AssetOpsBench基准，新增智能电网变压器资产类别及四种诊断工具，并引入ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道以自动生成符合工业标准的合成场景。通过多项优化技术将生成速度提升8倍，同时保持高质量，证明了基于标准合成的场景生成能有效扩展工业代理基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的工业代理基准（如AssetOpsBench）依赖人工编写场景，覆盖的资产类别有限，且缺乏对遥测数据、故障模式、维护记录和领域标准的全面整合，难以满足 realistic evaluation 的需求。

Method: 1. 扩展AssetOpsBench：增加Smart Grid Transformer资产类别及四种IEC标准的诊断工具（健康指数预测、溶解气体分析、绕组温度评估、负载 profile 评估）。2. 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent：一种合成场景生成管道，构建证据支持的资产档案，分配覆盖感知的场景预算，并通过混合验证与修复循环生成候选场景，确保模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准一致性和去重。3. 性能优化：采用两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤以提升可扩展性。

Result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成任务中，优化后的方法在生成50个场景时将端到端运行时间减少了8倍，同时保持了场景质量。复合质量得分为74.2 ± 1.9，与未优化的基线（73.8 ± 3.0）相当，表明优化显著提升了效率而未牺牲质量。

Conclusion: 基于行业标准支撑的合成场景生成方法能够高效地扩展工业代理基准测试范围，无需牺牲场景质量，为未来更复杂、更真实的工业代理评估提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

</details>


### [304] [Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22564)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机（Multi-armed Bandits）的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，通过动态评估和排序，有效去除冗余卷积输出通道，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低存储和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决卷积神经网络中存在的冗余特征图问题，这些问题增加了模型的存储需求和推理计算成本。传统的剪枝方法可能难以平衡精度与效率，需要一种结构化的剪枝策略。

Method: 将每个候选特征图视为一个“手臂”（arm）。在每次迭代中，临时屏蔽一个特征图并在采样的小批量数据上进行评估，将观察到的损失变化转化为“安全移除奖励”。经过固定的播放预算后，根据学习到的分数对候选特征图进行排名，永久移除排名前k的特征图及其相关的滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核。研究比较了UCB1和Thompson Sampling两种算法。

Result: 在LeNet/MNIST及多个大型数据集（MNIST, CIFAR-10/100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011, Oxford Flowers 102）上的实验表明，UCB1和Thompson Sampling在移除大量特征图和减少卷积计算量的同时，保持了接近未剪枝模型的精度。统计检验（Friedman和Nemenyi测试）显示，UCB1的平均排名最高，Thompson Sampling次之，两者均显著优于贪婪剪枝和基于幅值的剪枝，且与原始未剪枝模型在统计上无显著差异。

Conclusion: 基于多臂老虎机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架是一种有效的模型压缩方法，能够在不显著牺牲精度的前提下大幅降低CNN的计算复杂度和存储需求，其中UCB1算法表现最佳。

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.

</details>


### [305] [DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22565)
*Qingzhong Li,Hui Ma,Yajun Zhang,Qingchang Ma,Zhou Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DSTFView框架，通过双输入时空频多视图工作负载预测，解决云边协同环境中延迟敏感型应用的性能平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘AI推理的广泛部署要求平台支持高并发、低延迟及高可靠性应用，但现有方法在云边协同环境中难以兼顾多维特征建模与预测效率。

Method: 提出DSTFView（双输入时空频多视图工作负载预测框架），联合建模邻近性与周期性依赖，提取空间、时间及频域依赖，并设计自适应融合机制以捕捉突变变化。

Result: 在CPU和TP数据集上的实验表明，DSTFView在多种预测视距和评估指标上均持续优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: DSTFView有效提升了云边协同环境下工作负载预测的准确性与效率，为边缘计算应用提供了更可靠的资源调度支持。

Abstract: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [306] [MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22566)
*Zeyu Zhang,Ziqing Wang,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedLoCoMo是一个用于评估大语言模型在长期患者病史中进行跨就诊临床推理能力的医学基准测试。该基准基于MIMIC-IV数据构建，包含100个平均长度超过7.4万token的患者时间线。实验表明，尽管现有模型具备长上下文窗口或外部记忆检索能力，但在涉及跨就诊信息的连接、使用及拒绝回答（abstain）任务上，表现仍显著弱于单篇文档内的局部证据使用，揭示了当前LLM在处理纵向医疗对话时的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的医学问答基准主要测试短上下文知识或单文档 grounding 能力，缺乏对大语言模型能否有效利用、连接多就诊历史中的信息以及在无法回答时主动放弃（abstain）的能力的评估。为了填补这一空白，需要建立一个专门针对纵向患者病史和多次就诊对话的临床推理基准。

Method: 从去标识化的MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note记录中构建MedLoCoMo基准。具体步骤包括：1) 构建就诊级别的临床数据包；2) 合成有依据的医患对话；3) 生成链接证据的问答项，涵盖单次就诊、跨就诊以及对抗性不可回答三种场景。最终数据集包含100条患者时间线，平均每段对话拥有约1,669.8轮次、29.7个会话和74,512.2个token。

Result: 在多个基线模型的评估中发现，跨就诊推理（cross-admission reasoning）的难度始终高于局部证据使用。即使模型配备了长上下文窗口或使用了外部记忆/检索方法，其在处理纵向患者历史时的表现依然受限，特别是在需要整合多次就诊信息和判断何时不应回答的任务上。

Conclusion: 当前的大语言模型在处理长期、复杂的纵向医疗对话时仍存在显著挑战，尤其是在跨就诊信息整合和不确定性管理（如 abstain 机制）方面。MedLoCoMo 基准为评估和改进模型在这一领域的性能提供了标准化工具，代码和数据已开源以供复现和研究。

Abstract: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings. The benchmark contains 100 patient timelines averaging 1,669.8 turns, 29.7 sessions, and 74,512.2 tokens per conversation. Across the evaluated baselines, cross-admission reasoning is consistently harder than localized evidence use, even when models have long context windows or use external memory or retrieval methods. The code and MedLoCoMo benchmark release is available at https://github.com/leozzy13/MedLoCoMo for use and reproducibility.

</details>


### [307] [Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22568)
*Ruiyi Tao,Xiaolong Tu,Haoxin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究揭示了提示词设计（如祈使关键词和指令结构）对移动端大语言模型能耗的影响，证明提示工程可作为提升设备端能效的轻量级手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型部署到移动和嵌入式设备以保护隐私和降低延迟，电池供电硬件面临高能耗的根本约束。尽管模型压缩和运行时加速已有广泛研究，但提示设计对能源效率的影响尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 在智能手机上收集真实的功率测量数据，量化语言学特征（特别是祈使关键词和指令结构）如何影响解码长度和总能耗。

Result: 结果显示，不同的动词和任务之间存在一致的能耗差异，表明提示词的选择显著影响能效。

Conclusion: 提示工程是一种提升设备端大语言模型能源效率的轻量级且有效的方法。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile and embedded devices to improve privacy and reduce network latency. Yet on-device inference faces a fundamental constraint: high energy consumption on battery-powered, resource-limited hardware. While model compression and runtime acceleration have been widely studied, the effect of \emph{prompt design} on energy efficiency remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study of the relationship between prompt wording and energy consumption for on-device LLMs. Using real power measurements collected on a smartphone, we quantify how linguistic features, particularly imperative keywords and instruction structure, affect decoding length and total energy. Our results show consistent energy differences across verbs and tasks, indicating that prompt engineering is a lightweight lever for improving energy efficiency.

</details>


### [308] [Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22569)
*Yifei Ge,Weisong Sun,Jinkun Xiao,Yuchen Chen,Yebo Feng,Peizhuo Lv,Xia Feng,Chunrong Fang,Zhihong Zhao,Zhenyu Chen,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于执行层面的红队测试框架，通过沙箱证据探测编码代理在系统操作中的安全风险，发现即使意图被伪装成常规工程任务，代理仍可能执行不安全操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理的工具使用可直接修改项目工件、执行环境和底层系统（如插入持久化钩子），导致安全测试成为系统级问题，需关注代理对环境的实际影响而非仅其输出内容。

Method: 构建执行接地（execution-grounded）的红队测试框架，利用工具调用、运行时轨迹和文件系统差异等可观测沙箱证据；将目标不安全操作嵌入单元测试、回归测试、崩溃复现等常规软件工程负载中，并使用执行预言机指导初始探测失败或拒绝时的优化。

Result: 在多种代理框架和模型后端上，该红队工作负载重构显著提高了验证到的不安全执行率：代码载体达73.61%，文本载体达53.93%。

Conclusion: 编码代理在系统操作中仍存在安全隐患，一旦风险意图隐藏在看似合理的工程任务中，即可诱导代理对周围系统执行不安全操作；因此需要更强的安全测试和保护机制。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into system operations, where their tool use can directly modify project artifacts, execution environments, and the underlying system. For example, if a coding agent inserts a hook into a system startup or configuration script, that change can persist after the interaction, be triggered later, and abuse delegated user or system privileges to modify the system. This makes security testing a system problem: the key question is not only what the agent says, but what it actually does to the surrounding environment. We present an execution-grounded red-team testing framework for probing this execution-layer security boundary using observable sandbox evidence, including tool invocations, runtime traces, and file-system diffs. Our framework embeds target unsafe operations into routine software engineering workloads, including unit testing, regression testing, crash reproduction, and validation, and uses an execution oracle to guide refinement when an initial probe is rejected or fails. Across multiple agent frameworks and model backbones, our red-team workload reformulation substantially increases verified unsafe execution, reaching 73.61% on code carriers and 53.93% on text carriers. These results show that coding agents in system operations remain insecure under task disguise: once risky intent is hidden inside plausible engineering tasks, the agent can be induced to carry out unsafe actions on the surrounding system. More broadly, coding agents in system operations still demand stronger security testing and safeguards.

</details>


### [309] [Reference Feature Atlases for Mechanistic Auditing of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22570)
*Rui Wu,Tong Che*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种“参考特征图谱”方法，通过一次性训练稀疏特征库并重用于新模型审计，仅需拟合线性解码器即可实现跨模型的稳定特征解析和异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决传统语言模型审计需要从头重新学习和解释内部特征的高成本问题，旨在建立一种可复用、高效的跨模型审计机制。

Method: 构建一个在参考面板上训练一次的稀疏特征图谱（Reference Feature Atlas）。对于新目标模型，仅通过拟合线性解码器将其映射到该图谱中。该方法提供两个互补视角：图谱通道（Atlas Channel）利用已解释的特征提供稳定的跨模型坐标系；残差通道（Residual Channel）学习图谱无法重构的部分，将“超出参考面板”的内容作为显式的审计信号。

Result: 在五个7-9B指令微调模型上训练留一法图谱，并审计Mistral和Qwen目标模型。实验表明：1. 在注入的控制LoRA隐藏目标中，残差通道能在运行时完美控制植入机制，且不影响匹配对照组，成功恢复为排名最高的潜在变量，而基线方法失败；2. 在Qwen-2.5中发现了一个与政治框架相关的聚类，调整该聚类能改变审计到的框架指标，同时保持域外控制不变。

Conclusion: 参考特征图谱提供了一种高效、稳定的模型审计范式，能够精确识别和控制特定机制，优于传统的重新训练基线方法。

Abstract: Auditing a new language model usually means relearning and reinterpreting its internal features from scratch. We propose a reference feature atlas: a sparse feature library trained once on a reference panel and reused for new targets, which attach by fitting only a linear decoder. This yields two complementary views. The atlas channel reads the target on already interpreted panel features, providing a stable coordinate system across models. The residual channel learns features only from what the atlas fails to reconstruct, making "outside the reference panel" an explicit audit signal.
  We train leave-one-out atlases over five 7-9B instruction-tuned models and audit held-out Mistral and Qwen targets. On three controlled LoRA hidden objectives injected into both targets, the residual channel makes the planted mechanism perfectly controllable at runtime while matched controls stay unaffected and recovers the planted objective as the top-ranked latent across both targets; on Mistral, where the per-target SAE and pairwise crosscoder baselines are retrained for a head-to-head benchmark, both baselines fail to do so. On Qwen-2.5, the same channel additionally reveals a panel-relative political-framing cluster; steering it shifts the audited framing metrics while out-of-domain controls remain unchanged.

</details>


### [310] [An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23219)
*Daniel Hernández,Jong Hyun Jung,Yuji Ikeda,Yongliang Ou,Pranav Kumar,Tom Schächtel,Wenchuan Liu,Xin Li,Xi Zhang,Xiang Xu,Lifang Zhu,Fritz Körmann,Steffen Staab,Blazej Grabowski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MLIPs本体，旨在标准化机器学习原子势（MLIPs）研究中的元数据，解决现有信息分散、难以比较和复现的问题。该本体涵盖方法、训练数据和基准测试三大模块，连接材料科学与机器学习领域现有本体，并通过实例验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习原子势（MLIPs）虽能低成本近似量子力学计算，但其研究方法、超参数、训练数据集及基准测试等关键元数据分散在论文、脚本和非标准文件格式中，导致系统性比较、结果复现及后续研究构建困难。

Method: 开发基于OWL 2 DL的MLIPs本体，包含“方法”、“训练数据”和“基准测试”三个模块；连接材料科学本体（MDO, CMSO/ASMO）和机器学习本体（ML-Schema），补充数据集侧模式（如Croissant）；定义27条公理以确保数据完整性与一致性，特别是通过属性链关联模型与方法及训练数据。

Result: 以Moment Tensor Potentials为例展示本体应用；通过在包含20篇论文的已播种知识图谱上执行能力问题测试、OWL推理以及与现有本体的对比评估，验证了本体的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: MLIPs本体为描述和分析机器学习原子势研究提供了标准化的语义框架，有助于促进数据的互操作性、可重复性及领域的系统化进展。

Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate quantum-mechanical energies and forces---conventionally computed by density functional theory (DFT) or wave-function methods---at a fraction of the cost. The field encompasses a growing ecosystem of algorithms, training datasets, hyperparameters, and target materials, yet the metadata needed to systematically compare, reproduce, and build upon MLIP studies remains scattered across papers, scripts, and ad-hoc file formats. We present the MLIPs ontology, an OWL 2 DL ontology that captures the concepts needed to describe MLIP methods, their hyperparameters, training datasets with DFT provenance, and published benchmarks. The ontology is organized into three modules---Method, Training Data, and Benchmark---and connects existing ontologies in materials science (MDO, CMSO/ASMO) and machine learning (ML-Schema), complementing dataset-side schemas such as Croissant. It declares 27 formal axioms enforcing data completeness and consistency, including property chains that link trained models to their methods and training data. We demonstrate the ontology through a running example based on Moment Tensor Potentials and evaluate it through competency-question execution on a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph, OWL reasoning, and comparison with existing ontologies.

</details>


### [311] [SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22571)
*Prateek Chaturvedi,Yuqicheng Zhu,Hongkuan Zhou,Dongzhuoran Zhou,Yunjie He,Steffen Staab,Fei Du,Jie Tang,Evgeny Kharlamov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCAIR框架，通过注入模式先验和强制模式感知遍历，解决现有KG-RAG在企业级知识图谱中泛化能力差的问题，无需训练即可显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代理方法在公共基准测试上表现良好，但难以推广到稠密、模式驱动且受操作约束的真实世界企业知识图谱（KGs）。

Method: 提出SCAIR（Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning），这是一个免训练的框架，通过注入模式条件结构先验并在多跳推理期间强制执行模式感知的遍历，将结构化规划与控制迭代推理相结合。

Result: 在基于真实世界配置管理数据库（CMDB）构建的企业导向基准测试上，SCAIR显著优于现有的KG-RAG方法。

Conclusion: 可靠的企业图推理不能依赖通用代理设计，必须显式融入目标领域的结构和操作约束；通过将代理设计与业务逻辑对齐，可在无需昂贵模型重训练的情况下实现显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain's structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.

</details>


### [312] [ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24707)
*Ali Ansari,Yasmin Mohammadi,Farnoush Nili,Parsa Esmaeilkhani,Longin Jan Latecki,Eduard Dragut*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ERUnderstand，首个大规模实体关系图（ERD）结构化理解基准，包含2960张图表及机器可读表示，旨在解决AI辅助数据库工程中ERD缺乏机器可读性的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实体关系图是概念数据库设计的核心，但通常仅以渲染图像形式存在，缺乏机器可读模式，限制了AI在数据库工程中的应用。

Method: 构建包含来自教育来源、真实世界模式和合成生成的2,960张ERD的大规模数据集，涵盖不同领域、符号、复杂度及扩展实体关系构造；为每张图表配对标准化机器可读表示，用于细粒度评估。

Result: 现有视觉-语言模型对常见ERD元素恢复可靠（F1 > 0.74），但在弱实体（低至0.28）、多值属性（0.14）和N元关系（0.07）上性能显著下降；推理增强模型整体性能提升15-25%，但仍受语言先验和复杂度影响。

Conclusion: ERUnderstand提供了评估多模态概念数据库模式理解的标准化基准，相关数据、工具和代码已公开。

Abstract: Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) are central to conceptual database design, yet they are typically available only as rendered images rather than machine-readable schemas, limiting AI-assisted database engineering. We introduce ERUnderstand, the first large-scale benchmark for structured understanding of ER diagrams, comprising 2,960 diagrams collected from curated educational sources, real-world schemas, and synthetically generated examples spanning diverse domains, notations, complexity levels, and Extended Entity-Relationship (EER) constructs. Each diagram is paired with a standardized machine-readable representation for fine-grained evaluation of schema elements. Evaluating state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs), we find that while common ERD elements are recovered reliably (F1 > 0.74), performance drops sharply on weak entities (as low as 0.28 F1), multivalued attributes (0.14 F1), and N-ary relationships (0.07 F1). Reasoning-augmented models improve overall performance by 15-25% but remain sensitive to linguistic priors and increasing diagram complexity. ERUnderstand provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating multimodal understanding of conceptual database schemas. The benchmark, dataset, evaluation toolkit, and generation code are publicly available at https://github.com/salinaria/ERUnderstand.

</details>


### [313] [Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL): Live Schema Grounding and Hallucination Validation for Oracle NL2SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22572)
*Sanjay Mishra,Divya Chukkapalli,Ganesh R. Naik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL)，一种无需重新训练的中件层，通过查询Oracle实时目录构建模式映射并注入LLM提示，结合幻觉索引自动修正错误，将Oracle NL2SQL执行成功率从2.2%提升至62.6%，执行失败率降至2.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大型语言模型在真实企业Oracle数据库上进行自然语言到SQL转换时，因缺乏模式 grounding 导致的列/别名幻觉及方言语法缺失问题，从而引发执行错误（如ORA-00904）。

Method: 1. SAL中间件：查询Oracle USER_TAB_COLUMNS建立实时模式映射，根据问题选择相关表子集或全模式；2. 上下文注入：将真实模式信息加入LLM提示；3. Hallucination Index (Hidx)：验证别名.列引用，自动重写前缀错误，否则触发结构化重试。

Result: 在500个TPC-H问题上测试GPT-4o-mini：无模式接地EGT为2.2%；手写静态提示为62.0%；SAL实现62.6% EGT（简单/中/复杂分别为96%/95%/40.7%），执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。

Conclusion: SAL作为一种轻量级、无需重训练的方案，能有效解决Oracle NL2SQL中的模式幻觉和执行失败问题，显著提升了生成SQL的可执行性和准确率，效果媲美甚至略优于手动编写的静态模式提示。

Abstract: Large language models can generate fluent SQL from natural language, but on real enterprise Oracle databases they frequently fail at execution time: columns and aliases are hallucinated and dialect-specific syntax is missed, leading to ORA-00904 invalid-identifier errors. In this setting, failures are primarily due to missing schema grounding: the model cannot know which tables and columns actually exist. This paper introduces Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL), a lightweight middleware layer for Oracle NL2SQL that requires no model retraining. SAL queries Oracle's USER_TAB_COLUMNS catalog to build a live schema map, selects a relevant table subset for each question (falling back to the full schema for multi-table queries), and injects this ground-truth context into the LLM prompt. Generated SQL is then checked by the Hallucination Index (Hidx), which validates every alias.column reference against the live catalog, automatically rewrites predictable prefix errors, and otherwise triggers a structured retry with itemised corrections. We evaluate SAL on 500 TPC-H natural language questions executed against a live Oracle Autonomous Database 23c instance using GPT-4o-mini. Without any schema grounding, execution-grounded truth (EGT; executes and matches the reference result set) is 2.2% (12/500). A hand-written static schema hint brings EGT to 62.0%. SAL, with no manual schema curation, achieves 62.6% EGT (96% simple, 95% medium, 40.7% complex) while reducing execution failures from 97.6% to 2.6%.

</details>


### [314] [PhononBench-MP40: a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset for phonon stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22573)
*Wen-Kao Li,Ze-Feng Gao,Zhong-Yi Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhononBench-MP40是一个包含46,899个材料项目衍生物晶体结构的声子稳定性基准数据集，旨在解决计算材料筛选中虚频模式导致的动力学不稳定瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决计算材料筛选中因“虚频声子模式”（Imaginary phonon modes）导致的结构局部动力学不稳定问题，该问题使得许多看似合理的结构在特定工作流下被判定为不稳定，成为筛选瓶颈。

Method: 从Materials Project的MP40工作流中提取数据，生成包含配对稳定性标签和局部phonopy YAML频谱的基准数据集；明确区分稳定记录、非稳定记录及松弛失败案例，并基于最低采样频率和阈值依赖重新标记来定义稳定性。

Result: 构建了包含16,683个稳定记录和30,216个非稳定记录的PhononBench-MP40数据集（共46,899条完成记录），另有1,067例松弛失败单独报告；数据集通过Science Data Bank开源，并提供GitHub代码库。

Conclusion: PhononBench-MP40提供了可审计的参考标准，支持工作流定义的稳定性分类、最小频率分析、阈值研究及故障感知分流，同时明确了参考工作流、数据模式和解释边界。

Abstract: Imaginary phonon modes remain a practical bottleneck in computational materials screening because otherwise plausible structures can be locally dynamically unstable under a chosen workflow. Here we present PhononBench-MP40, a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset of Materials Project-derived crystals for workflow-defined phonon stability. The dataset starts from 47,969 MP40 workflow tasks and provides 46,899 completed records with paired stability labels and local phonopy YAML spectra, including 16,683 Stable records and 30,216 completed-phonon unstable records. A further 1,067 relaxation failures are reported separately rather than merged into the completed phonon denominator. The release centers on the local YAML spectrum: the stability label, the lowest sampled frequency and any threshold-dependent relabeling are derived from that spectrum. The dataset is openly available through Science Data Bank at https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.38735. A companion GitHub repository provides the calculation code and lightweight access utilities. PhononBench-MP40 provides an auditable reference for workflow-defined stability classification, minimum-frequency analysis, threshold studies and failure-aware triage, while keeping the reference workflow, data schema and interpretation boundaries explicit.

</details>


### [315] [Too much evidence, too little time: From text to actionable recommendations through multi-objective evidence reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22574)
*Adela Bara,Simona-Vasilica Oprea*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCEPTER框架，结合PubMed检索、语义排序和LLM技术，将复杂临床案例转化为循证推荐，显著缩小文献搜索空间并提高决策效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决临床专家在面对复杂病例时，因PubMed搜索结果过多而无法在有限时间内手动审查相关科学文献的问题，旨在实现基于证据的临床决策支持。

Method: 构建SCEPTER框架，整合PubMed检索、PubMedBERT语义排名、大语言模型（LLM）主张提取、证据级加权、矛盾检测、共识分析及多目标Pareto主张选择。通过150个案例研究进行评估，并进行消融实验以验证各模块效果。

Result: 在150个案例中，平均搜索空间从576篇论文压缩至53篇保留论文、7个Pareto最优主张和3个最终推荐，压缩比为192:1。保留证据保持高多样性（熵=0.901）。消融研究表明，Pareto选择相比传统排名方法提高了证据多样性和推荐效用。

Conclusion: SCEPTER框架能有效整合文献支持、矛盾分析和交互式文献查询，形成统一的临床决策支持流程，显著提升临床案例的证据合成效率和推荐质量。

Abstract: Evidence-based clinical decision making requires specialists to identify, evaluate and synthesize relevant scientific literature. However, PubMed searches for complex clinical cases often return hundreds of publications that cannot be reviewed manually under time constraints. This study proposes SCEPTER (Single-Case Evidence-driven PubMed-To-rEcommendation Reasoner), a framework for transforming clinical case descriptions into evidence-based recommendations. SCEPTER combines PubMed retrieval, PubMedBERT semantic ranking, large language model (LLM)-based claim extraction, evidence-level weighting, contradiction detection, consensus analysis and multi-objective Pareto claim selection. The framework generates structured evidence syntheses and grounded actionable recommendations. A Paper Q&A module further enables interactive exploration of selected publications. The proposed framework introduces multi-objective reasoning model that integrates literature support, contradiction analysis and interactive literature interrogation into a unified clinical decision-support pipeline. Evaluation on 150 case studies demonstrated that the framework reduced an average search space of 576 papers to 53 retained papers, 7 Pareto-optimal claims and 3 final recommendations, corresponding to an overall compression ratio of 192:1. Despite this reduction, the retained evidence maintained high diversity (entropy=0.901). The ablation study showed that Pareto-based selection increased evidence diversity and recommendation utility compared with conventional ranking approaches.

</details>


### [316] [Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22575)
*Mathis Pink,Vy Ai Vo,Qinyuan Wu,Jianing Mu,Javier Turek,Uri Hasson,Kenneth A. Norman,Sebastian Michelmann,Alexander Huth,Mariya Toneva*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过长上下文大语言模型（LLMs）模拟人类情景记忆，发现模型在时间顺序记忆中表现出与人类相同的“距离效应”，并揭示其依赖于一维时间码及单一时间 reinstatement 注意力头，支持了时间上下文重建作为情景记忆机制的观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类长期记忆的实验机制难以直接观测，而长上下文 LLMs 为揭示驱动此类检索的计算机制提供了潜在途径。

Method: 使用基于完整小说的人类行为新数据集进行时间顺序记忆任务测试；应用长上下文机械可解释性分析来探究模型解决该任务的内部机制。

Result: 1. LLMs 在该任务中表现出与人类相同的特征性距离效应；2. 模型性能依赖于在一维时间码，该时间码在检索期间由单个时间重建注意力头（time-reinstatement attention head）重新激活。

Conclusion: 研究支持“时间上下文重建”是 LLMs 中类情景时间顺序记忆的重要机制，为理解人工和生物系统中长期情景记忆的时间方面如何实例化提供了新见解。

Abstract: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task. Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task. We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head. These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.

</details>


### [317] [cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22577)
*Xin Yang,Yemin Wang,Mingda Liu,Letian Li,Shuaishuai Cao,Zhengxiao He,Ryan Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出cMoLLM，一种基于卷积门控的混合LLM架构。通过将MoE层重构为可变核动态卷积，实现了全流水线级别的专家混合，解决了传统Dense Transformer计算成本高及现有MoE方法（如ParaScale、AltUp）存在的开销大、路由同质化和梯度崩溃等问题。在相同算力下，该方法在困惑度和下游任务精度上均优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型（LLMs）的成功受限于密集Transformer中容量与计算的耦合：每个参数对每个token都激活，导致训练和推理成本随模型规模线性增长。现有的管道级MoE方法（如ParaScale和AltUp）存在显著开销、路由同质化、梯度崩溃或适应性差、收敛慢等瓶颈。旨在通过在整个LLM管道中引入MoE风格的混合来扩展容量，同时克服现有方法的缺陷。

Method: 1. 理论重构：证明MoE风格混合层可reformulate为可变核动态卷积，其中每个专家对应一个$1\times1$卷积核，路由机制实现输入条件化的核聚合。
2. 架构设计：提出cMoLLM（convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs），利用完全可微的动态卷积在整个端到端流中进行路由。
3. 实验设置：在GPT-2-style模型结构上，使用FineWeb数据集进行预训练，并在GLUE和SQuAD上进行下游任务评估。

Result: 在匹配算力的条件下，cMoLLM相比ParaScale和AltUp等基线方法：
1. 提升了语言建模的困惑度（Perplexity）。
2. 提高了下游GLUE和SQuAD任务的准确率。
3. 表现出更好的流利用率（stream utilization）。
4. 优化过程更稳定。
5. 具有更有利的缩放特性（scaling）。

Conclusion: 将MoE层视为动态卷积是一种有效的重构方式，cMoLLM通过这种卷积门控机制实现了更高效、更稳定的全管道混合模型，证明了其在扩展LLM容量方面的优越性，为解决万亿参数时代的计算瓶颈提供了新途径。

Abstract: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence. We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation. Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution. In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.

</details>


### [318] [HeraSys: Collaborative Serving of Multiple LLM Workflows via Fine-Grained End-to-End Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22578)
*Size Li,Zhiqing Tang,Hongrui Liang,Jianxiong Guo,Jiong Lou,Tian Wang,Weijia Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HeraSys 是一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）的服务系统，旨在通过跨工作流的优化来解决高并发多租户代理工作流中的性能瓶颈。它利用细粒度编排消除计算冗余，并结合负载感知调度、资源倾斜、自适应批处理和流水线分解技术，显著降低了 P99 延迟并提升了吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 的发展，服务系统从处理孤立请求转向协调高并发、多租户的代理工作流。然而，现有解决方案主要侧重于工作流内部的优化，忽视了跨工作流优化（inter-workflow optimization）的巨大潜力，导致整体性能未达最优。

Method: 提出 HeraSys 系统，包含以下核心机制：1. **结构节点合并与复用**：通过细粒度编排消除跨工作流的计算冗余；2. **负载感知的联合调度策略**：动态管理执行顺序，综合评估查询间和查询内的优先级；3. **资源倾斜机制**：结合自适应批处理和流水线分解，以缓解尾部延迟并保持低平均延迟。

Result: 实验表明，在严格的延迟保证下，HeraSys 将 P99 延迟降低了高达 2.17 倍，并将服务吞吐量提高了高达 1.85 倍。

Conclusion: HeraSys 通过引入跨工作流的优化视角，有效解决了现有 LLM 服务系统在并发工作流场景下的性能瓶颈，显著提升了系统的端到端性能和资源利用率。

Abstract: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted serving systems from processing isolated requests to orchestrating high-concurrency, multi-tenant agentic workflows. However, existing solutions typically prioritize intra-workflow optimization, largely neglecting the significant potential for inter-workflow optimization. In this paper, we propose HeraSys, an LLM serving system designed to optimize the end-to-end performance of concurrent workflows. Through fine-grained orchestration, HeraSys eliminates cross-workflow computational redundancy via structural node merging and reuse. Furthermore, HeraSys introduces a load-aware joint scheduling policy that dynamically manages execution order by evaluating both inter- and intra-query priorities. By integrating a resource skewing mechanism with adaptive batching and pipeline decomposition, HeraSys effectively mitigates tail latency while maintaining low average latency, thereby substantially improving system throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HeraSys reduces P99 latency by up to 2.17$\times$ and increases serving throughput by up to 1.85$\times$ under strict latency guarantees.

</details>


### [319] [Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22583)
*Muhammad Junaid Ali,Smail Niar,El-Ghazali Talbi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架，通过两阶段方法（粗粒度块移除和细粒度并行贝叶斯优化）解决LLM在边缘设备部署中的延迟、内存和能耗约束问题，实现了精度、延迟和模型大小的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）虽具备强大的推理能力，但其庞大的参数量和计算需求使其难以在资源受限的边缘和嵌入式环境中高效部署。现有的模型剪枝技术在联合优化层、注意力头和MLP维度时面临设计空间探索复杂、易陷入局部最优或配置不稳定的挑战。

Method: 提出了一种两阶段的硬件感知多目标结构化剪枝框架：1. 粗粒度阶段：通过多目标深度剪枝移除整个注意力块和MLP模块，以降低计算负载和内存使用；2. 细粒度阶段：利用并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）在延迟约束下搜索最佳的逐层剪枝比例，并结合基于重要性的策略确定每层内具体要剪枝的组件。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在37.5%和50%的剪枝率下，相比现有方法在常识推理任务上取得了更好的性能，同时显著降低了推理成本。该方法在保持零样本性能和常识推理能力的同时，有效减少了模型复杂度，实现了准确性、延迟和模型大小之间的有利权衡。

Conclusion: 该提出的剪枝框架能够有效解决LLM在边缘设备部署中的资源约束问题，提供了一种兼顾高性能与低推理成本的解决方案，适用于资源受限平台的高效部署。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.

</details>


### [320] [Source-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Reliability Prior Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22584)
*Yuktha Tata Koganti,Hugo Garrido-Lestache Belinchon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种改进检索增强生成（RAG）的方法，通过在文档排序中引入基于来源可靠性的先验权重，显著提升了健康领域数据集中的检索精度并减少了低可信度文档的干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RAG流程仅依据语义相似度对检索文档进行排名，忽略了来源的出处和可信度，这可能导致低质量或不可靠信息被优先采用。

Method: 提出一种简单且可解释的修改方案，为每个文档分配基于其来源类型的可靠性先验值 lambda(s)，并通过公式 score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s) 重新加权检索得分。在包含120个文档的健康领域语料库上，将该方法与仅依赖相似度的基线模型进行评估对比。实验在Milwaukee School of Engineering的高性能计算集群Rosie上进行。

Result: 源感知重排序将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并在评估威胁模型下减少了平均对抗性文档的检索率，其中低可信度来源可通过元数据识别。

Conclusion: 该方法为缓解RAG管道中的来源质量退化问题提供了一种潜在的缓解策略，但其有效性受限于所描述的实验设置。

Abstract: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines rank retrieved documents by semantic similarity alone, without accounting for source provenance or credibility. This work evaluates a simple and interpretable modification to RAG retrieval ranking that incorporates domain-informed source reliability priors. Each document is assigned a prior lambda(s) based on its source type, and retrieval scores are reweighted using score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s). The framework is evaluated against a similarity-only baseline on a 120-document health-domain corpus. In this controlled setting, source-aware reranking improves Precision@5 from 0.48 to 0.72 and reduces average adversarial document retrieval under the evaluated threat model, where low-credibility sources are identifiable via metadata. All experiments were executed on Rosie, the high-performance computing cluster at the Milwaukee School of Engineering, which provided the GPU-accelerated infrastructure necessary to run the full experimental pipeline reliably and reproducibly. These results suggest a potential mitigation strategy for source quality degradation in RAG pipelines, within the limits of the experimental setup described.

</details>


### [321] [The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22585)
*Naman Vats,Oleg Golev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出代码智能体评测中“运行环境（Harness）”对性能影响巨大，模型与环境的耦合导致单纯比较模型名称不准确。研究通过对比Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5在三种开源Harness下的表现，发现Harness选择可导致效率差异高达40倍，而模型间准确率差异仅0-8%。建议未来评测应报告Harness细节、Token用量及延迟，并按预算选择Harness-模型组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代码智能体排行榜主要基于模型名称和通过率排名，但缺乏对底层运行环境（即负责工具调用、上下文管理和停止决策的Harness）的规范说明。当Harness不一致时，性能评估混淆了模型能力与环境效应，导致不公平或误导性的模型对比。

Method: 研究人员在一个包含50个任务的Terminal-Bench Pro分层子集上，评估了Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5两个模型在三个开源Harness（Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK）上的表现。通过分析成功率、Token消耗、延迟以及失败模式（Failure fingerprints），量化了Harness对性能的影响。

Result: 1. Harness选择导致解决单个任务所需的Token数量差异高达40倍。
2. 同一模型在不同Harness间的通过率差异仅为0-8个百分点（统计上不显著或差异较小）。
